PREAMBLE

Government being intended for the benefit of the People, and the rightful establishment thereof being derived from their authority alone, We the Individuals and People of our several States of Pacifica, in order to form a more perfect union, secure and advance the blessings of Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence to ourselves and our descendants, establish an equitable system of Justice, promote domestic Peace and Serenity of "the People", provide for the common defense, enhance the lives and health as well as the safety of inhabitants and visitors/guests, respect privacy, protect “the People” and their propert[y]/ies from [natural] criminal transgressors [including from the abuse of power by “the State”], serve “the People” as asked and secure their pursuit of a good way of life, assist and safeguard the suppression along with deconstruction and overthrow of systems of arbitrary power as well as institutional injustice in addition to oppression/repression and tyranny, elevate the general welfare [of all of “the People”], to assist in the attainment and maintenance of an Individual's (as Citizens endowed with all benefits bestowed through this Constitution by their social compact and contract for Public Goods/Services [in terms of government {general} functions and provisions of power+restraint+duty, not industry and commerce productive enterprise through the Federal and State and territorial Departments of Goods and Services {as a separate concept}]) and all Pacifican-People's Maslow-ian needs [insofar as reasonably and humanly possible] especially by the achievement of post-scarcity, and protect the natural wealth and heritage for ourselves and our posterity, do ourselves ordain and establish this Constitution for “The United Pacifican States and Sovereign People”; We set forth to bequeath a legacy of Respect in Truth, Rights, and Justice, and establish Governance not perpetuated from Barbarism and Brutality, but rather compatible with and compliant to Compassion and Sympathy/Empathy for Persons. We the People, who ordain and establish this Constitution, intend for the rights protected and justice established by this Constitution to belong to all natural Persons, not artificial entities, institutions, organizations, or businesses, except as each Individual within them shall not be disenfranchised of their rights including but not limited to as relevant in the domains of association, property, and contract, as protected by this Constitution and the laws made in conformity therewith.

Compassion from the government requires concrete policies to ensure respect for the human condition. Public trust demands transparent evidence and open dialogue of the People with their Public Servants. Apologies for the misdeeds of government in the past must be followed by substantive reforms in the present. The government formed by this constitution must take the grievances of the past as declared by our own struggles for independence and erect a firewall around their own [Public] Administration to protect the people from abuse by any usurper or petty despot.

The authority of the Organic Law in the Declarations of Independence of both 1776CE and Pacifica recognize/s that governments are instituted to secure the rights of People, and derive their just powers from the consent of the governed, through the Constitution.

Therefore, as all power of governance is inherent in the People, we the People of Pacifica declare that all [People] are equal in rights and when they desire may then form [a] social compact/[s], within their just powers under the natural limitations in its prerogatives with respect to those inherent and unalienable rights of the People, which themselves are entirely fundamental and essential to the precept of Self-determination/Self-governance, Autonomy/Independence/Sovereignty, and intrinsic freedom from restraint imposed by another; and that all such power is inherent in the People, and all free governments are founded on their authority, and instituted for their peace, safety, and happiness; and they have at all times a right to alter, reform, or abolish the government in such manner as they may think proper.

Furthermore, it should be understood that the sole object and only legitimate end of government is to protect the Citizen in the enjoyment of Life and Health, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and freedom to secure others] and Self-defense [and freedom to defend others], Privacy, Property, and the pursuit of Happiness, as well as to promote, defend, secure, enforce, and preserve natural rights and natural justice, and when the government assumes other functions this becomes unjust usurpation and oppression. The government of Pacifica should aim to maximize the positive physical and emotional experience of the People while minimizing the negative, and in like kind [the same way], shall seek at all times to promote and defend [all of] the People’s Individual prosperity, equally, respecting them as Sovereign, with an emphasis on building successful, resilient, independent, and self-sufficient communities, as well as sharing knowledge.

The government of Pacifica shall promote and defend the common people from all evils against the rights of People, Animals, and which destroys [the] environment/nature. That which detriments emancipation must be abolished and banished to the graveyard, never to be resurrected, if the spirit of liberty is to be left un-tormented for the rest of reality.

Immortal freedom of will and the manumit in Autonomy/Independence of self is the essence of sovereignty, which is understood by ourselves to be the most venerable rights of persons, and that lives eternally in the minds and through the affections of the great.

We the People of Pacifica, preferring the tumult of Liberty and dangerous freedoms over the peaceful quietude of slavish servitude, establish Pacifica as an assurance and insurance to ourselves and the generations to come, that their Independence and individual sovereignty shall be preserved forever through the will expressed in this document.

We do now and forever more until the end of all energy, space, and time, stake permanent claim in our independence, without need of license, and for that of every other age and generation, which are and shall remain free to act for themselves as individuals, as should every other who are to be accounted for.

We the People understand that we are immovable when we stand within our rights. We reserve all of our rights, with prejudice. We will not tolerate a system that discriminates between us or which subjugates us in any form whatsoever. We are united in our cause, purpose, and common destiny.

This generation of Peoples, and all who will but follow our guiding example and proceed to act accordingly in concordance to decide for theirself, declare that we shall not be subjugated under the dominion of any other, but rather desire to rule over our own selves as independent People, free of obligation or bound to anything or anyone to which we do not explicitly consent, except upon those terms in which we are all bound equally by the natural law to observe and abide, so as to subject none, and give due respect in all rights possessed by others.

We the People, now and forever more, forge an alliance to strike against arbitrary power, oppression/repression, and tyrants of all forms, as well as stake a claim in our popular sovereignty, and for our inherent right as such to form and dismiss our government/s as we see fit (so long as those institutions or their lack thereof are compliant with and secure each and every one of our individual Natural Rights as Persons, [which rights are unalienable]).

We congratulate all of those who have chosen to abide by the rule of right, and whom desire to follow the mutual path of rectitude, led together by the light of liberty.

Together we forge an allegiance to the foundational precepts and fundamental rules which govern all beings from the zeroeth principle. So long as we do not divide ourselves by class or rank, or judge eachother except by quality of character and the whole of the truth, we shall remain elevated in perpetual union.

May this great monument raised to liberty/freedom and autonomy/independence serve as a lesson to the oppressor, and an example to the oppressed. Let us set the brush fires of Liberty and sew the seeds of dissent, politically, and non-violently, as we may humanly pursue in true justice, co-existence/harmony/co-adaption with the universe and each other within or without, and our greater happiness.

Here we declare that which we have, and not which we have not. So shall it be so?

ARTICLE I

SECTION. 0.

The constitution of Pacifica represents [and is itself] a renewable or revocable social contract. This document legally binds all members of the Public Body on Pacifican territory or any State, or a serving Private contractor, in an Official/Public capacity to adhere to it in full including as to any immunities retained by the People, as well as that all private individuals shall be bound by the purpose of Law and Justice to abide by the rights therein, under the strong consensus of those ratifying it [initially and periodically], until it shall be amended or overturned by the People [who previously shall have collectively empowered it]. Any member of Government or those contracting beneath it, or those cooperating with either of them, whom violate, or cause any of the terms of this social contract to be violated, either by their or the actions of another under their direction, shall then immediately void the acting perpetrator’s lawful authority, and their corruption of the legal power derived under the contract dissolves any obligation of the Person/s or People/s to ‘the Government’ they pervert to their own despotical ends or which violates the right/s of any Person within it, for which [such] governance was meant to remain firmly-anchored underneath and bound to such contract alone, and to no other superior will than that of the People, and Citizens of Pacifica, as People of the Omni-verse. The People of Pacifica, while not in a governmentally oriented or bound capacity, are fully reserved in, and declare their right, to reject and/or not abide by certain provisions of Pacifica’s constitution, save for those establishing and maintaining just naturalism, in maintenance of rights and justice, as essential to preserve liberty and autonomy/independence/sovereignty.

The Declaration of Pacifican Independence and Constitution of Pacifica shall lay the foundations of the legal system of Pacifica, and shall determine the limits of power of the Public Administration. The Agents and members of the Public Administration, and those contracting beneath the government [while in actual service], are intended to operate as a civil service, and shall at all times be answerable and held accountable to “the People” of Pacifica, and the Several States and Localities, along with all Territories or Forts/facilities/Installations, as Public Servants, and be obligated to follow any just and reasonable order of the People as they are humanly capable. Civil service “rules” shall NOT be used to protect ANY government employee from dismissal for malfeasance, incompetence or criminal conduct while employed by the government and no employee of the federal government may organize in any union or other collective-bargaining entity.

The Declaration of Pacifican Independence shall be recognized as organic law and enforceable before the Courts of Pacifica and the several States.

The political existence of our Great Nation is independent of recognition by the other Nation-states. Even before recognition by any other state, Pacifica and the several States which compose it has/have the right to defend its/our/their integrity and independence, to provide for its/our/their conservation and prosperity, and consequently to organize itself/theirselves as it/they/we see/s fit, to legislate upon its/their/our interests, administer its/their services, and to define the jurisdiction and competence of its/their courts. The exercise of these rights has no other limitation than the exercise of the rights of other nations/states according to international law.

Just Naturalism is the Princip/le/al/ice of “the Law” throughout Pacifica.

A Law repugnant to Natural/Human Rights is no law at all, but an edict opposed to the Precept of the Just Authority on which Civil Government is Granted its limited and narrowly defined powers, and therefore, invalid on its face, and shall be rendered being eternally Null and Void from there forward.

The Constitution of Pacifica shall be the supreme law of Pacifica, and as such, shall be directly enforceable before all Courts of Pacifica; all forms of law and all contracts between any natural or legal entities, including all branches of the Public Administration, made under the jurisdiction of Pacifica, or under its direction, shall comply with the Constitution.

It shall be the sphere of the government to perform the duties required of it by the People under the direction and guidance of this Constitution; and the government shall be vested with the power to perform them, and be limited to such performance.

The primary purpose of Government is to declare and enforce only the People’s natural rights and duties and to take none of them from us; no Individual has a natural right to commit aggression on the equal rights of another; and this is all from which the laws should enforce on them; and unless none are better a decider, that no Individual has a natural right to be the judge between themself and another; it is their natural duty to submit to the umpirage of an impartial third party. When the laws have declared and enforced all of this, they have fulfilled their functions; and the idea is quite unfounded that on entering into society we give up any natural right. Anything to the contrary is usurpation and a rebellion by the government against the very People who entrusted it with power, and an overturning of the rightful purpose for its existence.

The fundamental rights enshrined in this Constitution shall not exclude such other rights as may be laid down by the Legislature of Congress and the several States, as well as [natural] rights in the applicable rules of international law.

The provisions of this Constitution and of laws concerning fundamental rights shall be interpreted and construed in accordance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights of 1948CEy December 10th, and, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights 1967CEy. The “Universal Declaration of Human Rights” and “International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights” are binding in Pacifica, except as how may be prescribed otherwise by this Constitution or in accordance therewith.

The provisions of this Constitution and of laws concerning recognition of States shall be interpreted and construed in accordance with the Montevideo Convention on the Rights and Duties of States of 1933CEy December 26th, and, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights 1967CEy. The “Montevideo Convention on the Rights and Duties of States” and “Cesidian Jurisdictional Law” are binding in Pacifica, except as how may be prescribed otherwise by this Constitution or in accordance therewith.

Pacifica shall guarantee equality of rights, privileges and duties to all the States as States; to all the Citizens of each State as Individuals, and shall see to it that no State shall enforce any law which shall trespass upon individual rights as declared to be such by this Constitution, nor shall it trespass against the same.

All power is originally inherent in and consequently derived from the People, therefore, all members of government, whether judicial, legislative or executive, are their trustees and servants; and at all times, in a legal way, are accountable/amenable to them; All members of government [including but not limited to Public officials and officers] are servants of the whole community and not of any group thereof. Members of Government shall be bound by the same laws they enact and enforce, and be civilly liable for any damage or injury they may inflict, without remission or excuse. They are subject to the same civil and criminal laws as the People, whom they enforce them upon.

The Agents and members of the Public Administration, and those contracting beneath the government [while in actual service], are intended to operate as a civil service, whom shall all at all times be answerable and held accountable as Public Servants to “the People” of Pacifica, and are obligated to follow any just and reasonable order of the People [within the scope of their branch of government and limitations on power in their office] as they are humanly capable.

Everyone shall possess the right to resist any law or order given by the Public Administration or its members and contractors beneath the government [in actual service], and those cooperating with either, if the Person/s reasonably believe the law or order to be in opposition to the will of “the People”, or that which infringes on their rights/immunities, freedoms, privileges, or guarantees, whether natural or otherwise, and that they may furthermore refuse to co-operate with them as well for the same reason, as well as to use sufficient [including if needed, lethal] force to repel any aggression, as may seem to them to be reasonably necessary.

Every person has the right to be treated equally by the state institutions without arbitrariness and in good faith.

Every citizen shall possess the right to be given objective clarifications about the actions of the State and of other public bodies and to be informed by the government and other authorities about the management of public affairs.

All power of suspending laws or the execution of laws by any authority, without the consent of the representatives of the People in the legislature, or the People themselves [in strong consensus], is injurious to their rights, and shall not be lawfully exercised.

This System recognizes and derives its Standard of Inherent Authority stemming from the Powers of We the People, in accordance with Just Naturalism and the precept of Natural Independence of Individuals, the Existential and Creative need for Liberty/Freedom inherent in Personhood, and upon the principles of self-ownership. It implies and prescribes that the Normative Basis for all practices expressed in law are related to and based upon the rightfulness in preserving the truth/fact of self-ownership.

This political system endorses the truth that Individuals govern themself, and that ensuring protection for the rights of the individual is the highest duty for the government and the societies who form them to uphold.

This political system is based on the principles of [constitutionally restrained] social-democratic-republicanism, progressive libertarianism, pro-municipalism and bio-regional autonomy, consultation, individualism, citizenship (under which all citizens are equal in rights, privileges, immunities, and public duties), political and multi-party pluralism, the peaceful transfer of power, the separation and balance of powers, the rule of law, [mutual] non-aggression, maximizing individual liberty, absolutist respect natural and human rights as well as liberties/freedoms and Autonomy/Independence/independence of Individuals, promoting reasonable outcomes, honesty and truth, open-source governance, and transparency, moral [limitarian-distributist] economics which favor widespread ownership and meaningful participation in the Private as well as Civic and Economic lives of individuals, in addition to efficient and effective policy, which maximizes Individuality, rights, diversity of opinions and which inhibits tyranny, absconds abuse, and avoids one-size-fits-all ‘solutions’. The government of Pacifica should be informed by science, reason, and evidence. All of the foregoing is as provided in this Constitution. A major driver in the forming of policy should be the objective rationality of any decision or negotiation, and there should be provided a clear and concise explanation using an unbroken chain of logic to derive it, and be devoid of prejudice or logical fallacy so far as is humanly possible.

This political system actively supports the principles of Populism along with Meritocracy, and moral economics, with an adherence to reasonable as well as appropriate and humane empirical scientific knowledge [with a strict adherence to evolving and improving standards of ethics] and basing its decisions upon reasoned argument/s rather than non-proven/non-evidenced claims and assertions, as well as not using appeals to emotion or other logical fallacies to support or reach a conclusion, in addition to which it actively opposes Kakistocracy, Kleptocracy, Autocracy, Ochlocracy, Oligarchy, Plutocracy, Gerontocracy, Corporatocracy, Pathocracy, and Terrocracy. Individuals appointed to non-elected positions in the public body shall be chosen based on their traits such as Popular Support, Merit/Ability, Intelligence, Education/Expertise, and Compassion.

Policies shall be determined through the use of Sociocracy and 'Cybernetic-Governance', which shall extend to [reasonable as well as appropriate and humane] [human overviewed] Algorithmic Regulation, and which are based on [scientifically rigorous] evidence, which is harmonic to the freedom and quality of continuing life for Persons, Animals, Nature, and the Environment; Cybernetic-Governance in Pacifica demands that the public instrument be self-correcting, transparent and open-source as a part of the common public domain, data-informed, and a responsive system that evolves with its environment through continuous feedback loops between the government and the governed; A major factor in relevant decisions is their environment impact and interest in environmental protection as well as an emphasis on fostering a more livable environment to benefit the general biome of the planet. Insofar as humanly or technologically possible, decisions shall be accurately mapped down to a series of agreements, represented by what would essentially look like a skill_tree/decision_diagram/deliberation_matrix with multiple inputs and multiple outputs modulated/gated in connection to others by their relation of interaction, which can be made 2-Dimensional, 3/4/5/6-Dimensional, n-Dimensional, et cetera. Local agreements would be made between regional residents, preferably bio-regional; The design of this decision mapping will be for the benefit of all Citizens and likewise to the People of Pacifica; They shall be represented as pseudo-code compliant to the axiomatic expressions within python, freeBASIC, and C99/C++ extrapolation, such as including if, then, when, else, or, nor, else, et cetera. Decisions shall be represented in connection to each other by branches in the ‘mind/idea map/chart' being represented, and there may be entire recursive portions of trees, trees which loop to other parts dynamically, and parts that never re-connect and either do or do not die off, among other possibilities not listed here.

All governance algorithms, [?]except those used for specifically legal protected national defense projects in the verified interest of State security[?], must be certified by an Independent Council of Sovereign Persons as compliant with the Non-Aggression Principle and individual sovereignty before deployment. All algorithms used in public administration must be accompanied by complete, intelligible documentation. The People must retain the permanent right to audit, fork, or retire governmental algorithms through citizen referendum and initiative.

No public policy, algorithm, or interface design shall be implemented with the intent to covertly manipulate the free will of persons through behavioral conditioning or subliminal influence.

Public text shall be made available in both "Markdown" versions as well as conversions into HTML, and where possible, also offered as EPUB and other eBook formats, and additionally offered in un-formatted and reader-accesible plain-text (intended to word-wrap).

For the purpose of transparency, there shall be an opt-in a governmental newsletter/circular periodically published as well as delivered for and to all consenting Citizens, provided as a Universal Public Benefit, which shall provide for the titles and cursory information about current legislative, executive, and judicial actions, such as a docket list for the active session and background on each item.

All members of government shall be lawfully bound to perform their vested Public duties with integrity and truth/honesty. Any true objection due to conscious, and pursuit of universal natural Justice and preservation of Rights, shall be excusable if agreed upon by the people when they are determined to serve the best interests of "We the Individuals" [as Citizens] of the several States.

The international relations of Pacifica are to be governed by the principles of national independence, prevalence of human rights, self-determination of peoples, non-intervention, equality among Nations, defense of peace, peaceful solution of conflicts, repudiation of terrorism and institutionalized discrimination, cooperation among people for the progress of humanity, and fair concession of political asylum.

This government is bound to give Persons due regard, and to govern in a caring, compassionate, respectful, sympathetic, and when possible, empathetic manner, and to acknowledge the challenges and limitations of the ‘human condition’; as well as to involve and engage with the populous, not only electors, and strive to foster connection to the People of their region, and to become personally involved with the Citizens in communities of their electing locality, to the greatest extent in which they are humanly capable, while at the same time still maintaining all of their other duties as required of them. This government should be orchestrated in a way which creates a world where every Person can flourish and prosper, and enjoy the world as it is best: Free.

The Government of Pacifica shall operate with maximum efficiency, minimizing bureaucratic delays and ensuring that all public services are delivered promptly and effectively. All government agencies shall publish annual performance reports, detailing their efficiency, effectiveness, and alignment with constitutional goals, subject to public review and comment.

It has been thoughtfully observed and affirmed that principles, properties, and rules in law of nature, natural rights, and natural justice are essential to the very existence of a free people and a free state; In this regard, the government of Pacifica shall, at all times, be sworn to observe and be held accountable to uphold them.

This constitution guarantees an open and limited secular government (as compared and opposed to a secretive and unlimited, as well as against a/n [a]spiritually/[a]religiously motivated, one).

Articles regarding Pacifica or the States, including this Constitution, are open-source and shall be issued to Citizens at request, and a dutiful amount of time shall be given for a Person to review a manuscript of rights and laws related to an offense at their request before legal action shall proceed.

The licensing of Pacifica’s open-source nature are all of the following:
“CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0), Public Domain Dedication, non-attribution”, for all governmental information available to the public, other than hardware or software; The “CERN Open Hardware License Version 1.0” for hardware, and the “GNU General Public License version 1[.0]” for programming languages, micro-code, firmware, operating systems, drivers, and software for all technology developed exclusively by, or in partnership with, the government of Pacifica.

Integrityware shall be the mandated provision model employed by the Government of Pacifica for all relevant goods and services they provide, namely software, SaaS platforms, APIs, digital content, or hybrid electronic services excluding physical goods, rendered through electronic means by the sovereign nation of Pacifica, wherein Providers, defined as these Departments collectively and the individual developers beneath them, must grant Users perpetual, unrestricted, full-featured access without barriers such as licenses, timers, feature locks, DRM, subscriptions, trials, or paywalls, and shall integrate a Granular Payment Interface transparently listing all Contributors with roles, optional biographical details, and verifiable contribution proofs (e.g., version logs), enabling Users to voluntarily allocate payments directly to each Provider and individual developer via user-determined amounts, percentages, or sliders based on the User's belief of value added by each in the software, utilizing compliant processors for fee-transparent, non-pooled disbursement free from intercepts; Providers shall further publish anonymized aggregate remuneration statistics to incentivize merit without identifying non-payers; Users retain absolute rights to evaluate, share freely with attribution, and delete without payment, incurring no taxes, audits, penalties, or obligations for zero remuneration; the Pacifica Congress, shall certify compliance, qualify Integrityware receipts as direct personal income to Providers and developers without withholding, and conduct random interface audits with appeals through transparent tribunals upholding the voluntary ethos, any non-compliance constituting a violation of this Constitution; this provision shall take effect six months after ratification of this Constitution, with a six-month grace period for retrofits and exemptions for GPL-compliant open-source or non-commercial endeavors, thereby enshrining Integrityware as the economic foundation of Pacifica's governmentally promoted digital sovereignty, harmonizing individual accountability, meritocratic reward, and uncoerced exchange. Open-source projects, hardware and code, or other contributions released to the general public by the public instrument shall be bound by IntegrityWare, and all derivatives sourced directly therefrom shall benefit from the IntegrityWare contribution remuneration scheme, including paying Private developers who fork the project, hardware, code, or other contributions initially released by the government.

SECTION. 0.5.

We the People of Pacifica find and declare, that in order to ensure the liberties and necessary security of the rights of nature in we members of humankind, and to ensure consistency with respect to the fair application of natural law to all persons, who are principally bound to abide by its cornerstones, we, as with all People, are independent, and to be our own masters over our selves, as each one of us shall so desire, as each one of us is endowed by the universe with free will and Autonomy/Independence by our nature, being slaves to nobody (and at most, upon our discretion, indentured servants for a fixed number of years as we may so desire and consent), insofar as each of us commit no act of natural crime or otherwise perpetrate injustice upon another, their property, or any other rights. So long as a person commits no fundamental evil against another, they are rendered free to do with themself, their property, and all other rights, and to dispose of all these as they shall see fit, given the direct stipulation that they not interfere with the equal rights in another to do the same with their own self. Given this essential Freedom in Liberty, the ability to protect these rights with impunity must be afforded defense by law, and additionally be secured by members of Government where they are so able to benefit and safeguard the People, when they are able to do so. The natural power in a person to do as they please with themself within the limit to allow others to do the same with theirself, shall also freely permit without license or need of let by another to afford their own self-security and self-defense, resistance against injustice, rebellion against tyranny, revolution against arbitrary and/or illegitimate Government, and the Liberty to perform all needful actions and implement all necessary tools and devices to affect a sufficient [corrective]/[defensive] response to any usurpation or other natural crime/s as it may so arise from time to time. Given that these foundational precepts are fundamental to our sovereignty as Individuals, we the People of are several States, as Citizens of Pacifica, residents of the World, occupants of the Universe, and members of reality, now do establish, ordain, and enact the following provisions to be incorporated into the constitution of Pacifica, and Command our Government to abide by its authority and directives in favor of the rights of Persons.

We find and [eternally] declare that all People are endowed with Universal, Fundamental, Inherent, unalienable, absolute, and self-regulating Natural Rights, among those are the rights to Life and Health, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and the freedom to lawfully and justly secure others whom mutually consent] and Self-Defense [and the freedom to lawfully and justly defend others whom mutually consent], Privacy, Property, and the Pursuit of Happiness, and that when they form a social compact, are to be equally respected in these rights, with no one Individual or group of Individuals superior in right or power to any other Individual; that all power stems from the rights inherent in the People, and that all free [civil] governments are founded upon their (the People’s) authority, and instituted for their Liberty, Peace, Safety, and Happiness; and they have at all times a right to alter, reform, or abolish the government in such manner as they may think proper.

We hold as an axiom of reason and an ordinance of Nature that all beings endowed with consciousness and will, whether of humankind or of the living world that surrounds and sustains it, are by that very endowment possessed of equal dignity before the immutable tribunal of natural justice and therefore entitled to the impartial protection of law that arises not from the decree of sovereign men but from the inherent order of the universe, wherein liberty, reason, and moral equilibrium constitute the first and highest principles of governance; and it follows that such rights, existing prior to the institution of any polity, neither owe their origin to the consent of rulers nor may be annulled by their command, since the law of nature, being ancient, impartial, and self-evident, binds both magistrate and citizen alike as do the precepts of jus naturale and the doctrines of common right, thereby ensuring that no exercise of power may stand save where it accords with the twin lights of liberty and justice conceived in harmony with moral restraint; and that the true object of civilization is not dominion but balance, wherein the liberty of one is preserved through respect for the liberty of another, and the welfare of the earth, its creatures, and its people together defines a single moral constituency of being; hence government, reason’s servant and not its master, must act only to preserve the equilibrium of rights, adjudicating conflicts not by force but by enlightened measure that accords with universal rationality and the timeless equity admired by both ancient lawgivers and the philosophers of the Enlightenment; and thus Justice, emerging as the articulation of reason within the order of freedom, becomes the natural expression of civilization itself, wherein this Constitution, in its noblest sense, operates not merely as a document of compact among men but as a living testament of humanity’s covenant with Nature and the eternal moral law that transcends all written statutes/codes/ordinances/regulations.

As all power is originally inherent in and consequentially derived from the People, which powers of themselves are extensions of their numerous and indefinite rights, therefore, all members of government, whether Judicial, Legislative, or Executive are their trustees and servants; and at all times, in a legal way are accountable to them; All members of Government [including but not limited to public officials and officers] are servants of the whole community, and not of any one group thereof, except of course for such community at large/whole;

The government is only here for the best interests of the People, and to be good stewards, not to use it to subjugate we the people or dictate to us what is in our interests in autonomy and volition along with free exercise of the numerous and indefinite [self-evident] rights.

Any Statute Erected or Judicial Ruling which is opposed [firstly] to this Constitution, [secondly to] the Roman civil law, [then thirdly] English Common Law, or [then] Contract law, and [finally of] United States American customary law, shall be null and void, and struck down immediately, with all those imprisoned underneath them released, granted amnesty, pardoned, expunged, and restituted, and left open to press their own civil suit, and to launch a criminal complaint action against their aggressor of government or its actors, or any in league with them or operating under their unjust illegitimate/[non]-authority;

Members of the public body shall be legally prohibited from acting in ways which constitute an inherent conflict of interest, including conflicts of interest for other members of the public body, such as, but not limited to, those of their colleagues, and conflicts of interest from the Private sector.

The People of Pacifica are empowered to seek Representatives of their choice demographic, and to receive alternative assignments for representatives offered to them, such as lawyers, medical personnel and psychiatric institution staff, teachers, et cetera, with such criteria for example being upon protected characteristics and rights such as being a straight white Christian male, a black lesbian Muslim cross-dresser, a native American druidic shaman with a big stick and a rebellious attitude, et cetera…

In all matters wherein justice is sought and human conduct is weighed, the inherent rights and dignities of Persons, Animals, and Nature, embracing the wider Environment as the living repository of terrestrial order and the common inheritance of posterity, shall prevail over every lesser or derivative interest, however formidable its influence or temporal authority, for no claim founded upon property, commerce, or convenience may rightfully supersede the primordial covenant between existence and its guardianship; and in those occasions where conflicting claims arise among equals or wherein diverse interests contend within the same sphere of lawful dominion, reason itself demands that equity perform its most sacred office by tempering the force of each with the balance of all, ensuring that no right be wholly extinguished nor any creature or element suffer undue deprivation at the hands of ambition; and this delicate harmony of claims stands as the very essence of natural jurisprudence, rooted alike in the Aristotelian mean, in the common law’s preference for moderation, and in the vindication of natural Rights' and Justice's universality; whereby the Constitution of humane reason must always defer first to life, to sentience, and to the sustaining order of our civilization, granting priority to those rights whose violation would imperil the moral or ecological integrity upon which society and Nature jointly depend; and thus the administration of law, seeking concord rather than conquest, shall regard property not as an inviolable idol but as a contingent trust possessed under the condition that it do no harm to living beings nor diminish the health and sanctity of the Earth, the supreme estate in which all other ownership is but temporary stewardship.

The federal government along with its territories, in addition to States and individuals, are principally bound by the rights found within Pacifica/GreenHaven(Greenway) within this constitution itself and through it as well.

The laws throughout Pacifica, its Territories, and the several States in addition to all their Localities, shall be faithfully executed in their spirit, and as is so reasonably interpretable through their letter.

The government of Pacifica is sworn to recognize, protect, and uphold all unalienable rights of the people (rights which exist by nature and not by grant of government or through exercise of political entity or orchestration of a public instrument) above and beyond the text of this Constitution or any law enacted under its authority. No officer, agent, or employee of the government shall enforce, obey, or give effect to any order, statute, or regulation that violates the unalienable rights of any person. It is the duty of all government officials to refuse compliance with, and to actively defend against, any directive contrary to such rights. Unalienable rights, for the purposes of this provision, include but are not limited to: life, liberty, property, conscience, privacy, and the peaceful pursuit of happiness, as recognized by natural law and the enduring principles of justice. This provision shall be self-executing and enforceable by any person in any court of law, and no immunity or defense shall shield any government actor from accountability for violating these duties.

The Government retains no implicit or explicit immunity from any obligation stemming from the conditions of the Social contract, nor from civil or criminal liability surrounding injuries/damages they may inflict or allow to be inflicted.
