ARTICLE II

SECTION. 0.

There shall be an age limit for all members of the Public Body, not to exceed the age of eighty-five years standard, leap-year adjusted. Typically, upon reaching the statutory age of retirement, or upon retiring, only service in positions without power or authority are acceptable, such as: librarians, school teachers, city workers like clean up staff and mental health or homelessness/unsheltered outreach, or public-network television-broadcast anchors or podcasters.

SECTION. 1.

Election Weekend is the first Saturday and Sunday after independence day and its yearly anniversaries

Federal elections shall be administered by independent, nonpartisan commissions. Attempts by any federal officer to manipulate state election procedures, to solicit falsification of vote counts, or to pressure state officials shall constitute election subversion and be punishable under constitutional law.

To be put on the ballot for election, a Person must be a Pacifican citizen meeting the age requirements set forth here or by the constitution of each State, and have signatures supporting the candidacy from one-twentieth of one percent of the population of the applicable territory, whether of their Locality, State, or Pacifica, as determined from the most recent census. Signatures must be from qualified and registered voters. Party affiliations are not to be mentioned on ballots.

To be deemed eligible for election, the qualifications of any candidate shall be reviewed, tabulated, and verified, by a vote of at least eighteen of a periodically randomly selected grand jury of twenty-four from citizens of Pacifica who are not dependent on public funds for their support, however, this shall not be a selection process, only a confirmation process.

Every candidate for public office for Pacifica, whether it is National, State, or Local, shall be required to take an advanced placement Pacifica history, an advanced placement Pacifica government exam, be qualified as a voter under Pacifica and under the State in which they reside, as well as a complete a comprehensive psychological examination and intelligence quantification test, along with a background check going back twenty years which delves into all aspects of the candidate’s public and private life as is lawful under this Constitution, with the results being released for public review. In addition, they shall be required to take a political quiz, which information collected will be available for prospecting voters to help them discover what political dimensions they correspond to, and what other candidates, issues, bills, or laws they are likely to support or oppose, with the results being released for Public review by the People.

It is prohibited to form a political party that discriminates between Citizens, whether on the basis of age, sex, sexual orientation, body type, color, race, ancestry, nationality or place of origin, language, relationship status such as being with a romantic partner as well as in a marriage or part of a family, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political or ideological beliefs, intelligence, education, capability or disability, medical history, previous condition of servitude, property, economic situation, social origin, social circumstances, social condition/status or other characteristics, personal background, immutable traits, or other condition.

No Person who maintains membership in a secret society, or who takes an oath to protect themselves or another Person from due process of law, nor any Person who espouses a philosophy or [a]spirituality/[a]religion which undermines the secularity of government, the separation and scope of powers inherent to a limited government and a free People, or the rights to due process under this Constitution, shall ever be eligible for a position in the government.

No person guilty of violating the rights of another shall be offered any position of power or authority in government.

No business, firm, corporation, or other commercial entity shall be accepted in making contributions or expenditures in any election of any candidate for public office or to vote upon any ballot measure submitted to the People, so long as such restrictions are consistent with the powers of government and do not limit the freedom of speech or the press.

Campaigning and advertising for all general elections are limited to the period of twelve weeks before election day;-And for all primary elections, limited to the six weeks before the general election period.

No person may transfer election donations to that person’s personal use or to the use of any friend or relative or [non-election] associate/s, after the election for which the donation was made has been decided. All such excess monies must be returned to the donor(s).

To advance democratic self-government and political equality, and to protect the integrity of government and the electoral process, Congress and the States may regulate and set reasonable limits on all election contributions and expenditures, including a candidate’s own spending, and to authorize the establishment of political committees to publicly finance qualified candidates for office, and receive, spend, and publicly disclose the sources of those contributions and expenditures, and for other purposes. All elections shall encourage grassroots participation in the funding of campaigns. This shall not limit the right of a candidate to receive donations directly to their person, but in regards to political expenditures all campaign funds must either come from a candidate's own personal finances or that from donors to their campaign or from the federal and state non-repayable grants available to all candidates who run in an election year.

All candidates for federal office, including the Presidency, shall publicly disclose ten years of tax returns if applicable to their wealth bracket, and financial interests prior to election, and shall continue to disclose annually while in office. Failure to comply shall void eligibility to appear on the ballot.

No person holding or having held the office of President, Vice President, or any federal office of trust shall attempt to obstruct, delay, falsify, or coerce the lawful certification of electoral votes. Any attempt to subvert or intimidate electoral officials, or to summon armed force in opposition to the constitutional transfer of power, shall constitute insurrection and permanently disqualify the offender from public office.

The elections of representatives in the legislature ought to be free and frequent, and all men having sufficient evidence of permanent common interest with and attachment to the Community ought to have the right of suffrage; and no aid, charge, tax or fee can be set, rated, or levied upon the People without their own individual consent, nor can they be bound by any law to which they have not in like manner individually assented for the public good.

SECTION. 2.

Serving as Members of the public body is a privilege and an honor bestowed by the votes of the Citizens of Pacifica, not a career. Members of the public body must leave after their completed term in office and return to their common lifestyle and to the common work force as any other Pacifican citizen. There shall be no lifetime “retirement” salaries, bonuses or benefits provided, except bonuses that may be approved by the votes of the citizens for outstanding accomplishments for the common good of all.

Public office is intended to serve the interests of justice and in the quality of daily life for the People. Any law, order, or action of the government must be in line with the interests of justice, and promotion and protection of the rights of the people, and in the interest of general well-being which does not attract from any right retained by the People. When the government is repugnant to these ends it is the duty of its members to correct the wrong by deposing the others in the public body who only serve in the interest of tyranny whether as mere usurpers or despots.

Salaries of public officials shall be dependent upon the People’s satisfaction as provided by the Citizenry through the local/state/federal official/agent rating system that will be tied directly into ID_verified crypto-based internet-voting system for each citizen

All members of the public body shall receive free publicly funded access to convenient public transportation or receive publicly funded partial re-imbursements for proved cost of fuel/energy for using their personally owned vehicle craft to get to and from work.

All members of the public body shall receive publicly funded partial re-imbursements to the cost of rent for their choice in a dwelling that serves to reasonably limit their travel time to work, given the person would otherwise require a great amount more travel time to remain at their previous dwelling.

All members of the public body shall receive the same quality of free publicly funded health care which is available to all the People of each State, and not be eligible for private health care plans or services while serving the public offices of Pacifica.

No law shall introduce any quotas for any positions within any body of the Public Administration, whether based on age, sex, sexual orientation, body type, color, race, ancestry, nationality or place of origin, language, relationship status such as being with a romantic partner as well as in a marriage or part of a family, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political or ideological beliefs, intelligence, education, capability or disability, medical history, previous condition of servitude, property, economic situation, social origin, social circumstances, social condition/status or other characteristics, personal background, immutable traits, or other condition; all Persons applying for employment with the Public Administration shall be selected solely based on their merit and no other criteria shall be used; standards of all examinations conducted by any body of the Public Administration prior to offering employment shall equally apply to all Persons regardless of age, sex, sexual orientation, body type, color, race, ancestry, nationality or place of origin, language, relationship status such as being with a romantic partner as well as in a marriage or part of a family, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political or ideological beliefs, intelligence, education, capability or disability, medical history, previous condition of servitude, property, economic situation, social origin, social circumstances, social condition/status or other characteristics, personal background, immutable traits, or other condition.

Being an effective countermeasure of negative conduct, quality background investigations shall be conducted of individuals applying to become, appointed, or elected members of the public body, and a record will be kept of actions and productivity by members of the public body.

All members of the public body shall be subject to periodic randomized psychoactive substance tests around every two-to-four days, and psychological evaluations at least once a month; In addition, law enforcement must take thirty-six hours of mental health crisis intervention training every three months; Law enforcement as well as Members of the military and State militia must also take thirty-two hours of de-escalation and thirty-six hours of anger management classes every three months, in time of actual service. All members of the public body employed in a position of authority or power shall be taught the ethical perspective for every training topic as well as take State-of-the-Art ethical dilemma and behavior simulation training. All members of Law enforcement as well as Members of the military and State militia must partake in specialized training for response deployment in various fields in which they operate through, and standardized equipment should be decided and deployed to responding agents and officers. The legislature may define penalties for failure to participate and engage in any of these stipulations, and to penalize use of psychoactive substances detected by results of a positive psychoactive substance test of a member of the public body.

No elected or appointed government official may accept a campaign contribution while in office.

Establish a procedure for the removal of any government official by a majority vote of their constituents, with such a vote REQUIRED to be held if twenty percent of the electorate in the last election asks for it.

SECTION. 3.

Except in an emergency in which recording is impossible, all legislative, judicial, and administrative proceedings, other than trial jury and grand jury meetings, shall be recorded with current State-of-the-Art audio and video (A/V) technologies, archived, and released as Congress, for Federal proceedings, or a State legislature, for State proceedings, or a court of competent jurisdiction, shall direct. Persons present in a legislative conference or court shall not be barred from recording the proceedings except to forbid them from disclosing the members of the jury before the trial is concluded.

Except in an emergency where such publishing is impossible, all legislation drafted and set for a vote by either the Congress of Pacifica or legislatures of the several States Shelby openly documented and published in an internet accessible means, with physical copies available from the library of Congress at cost of production to individuals who seek non-digital versions. All legislation shall be tracked on an open public system that is internet accessible and shows the authors, contributors, sources, and the names of the persons who vote yay or nay on any stage of passage. All court records shall be published openly and public in a similar manner.

All information shall be automatically declassified within 365 days unless proven, by a Citizen’s Independent Tribunal, to directly risk immediate physical harm to the population if revealed sooner.

ARTICLE III

SECTION. 1.

All legislative Powers herein granted shall be vested in a Congress of Pacifica, which shall consist of a Senate and House of Representatives, that shall be responsible for evaluating any potential changes to legislation and submitting independent analysis on whether proposed alterations are in keeping with the standards and laws set forth herein, and in the People through national popular initiatives. The People, through initiative, shall have all lawmaking and budgetary powers granted to Congress under this Constitution; In force of law and in susceptibility to review, including invalidation, by the Judiciary, initiative enactments shall be afforded an equal status to Congressional enactments. Congress shall provide secure, verifiable means for citizens to participate in legislation drafted by the representatives, as well as to propose and vote directly on legislation and bills, subject to constitutional limits and judicial review. In addition to the people's power of initiative, shall be their right of referendum in Congress.

No proposed initiative shall appear on a national ballot without certification by Congress, who shall specify the means for certification and for conducting a vote, by uniform rule. Except as this provision otherwise provides, no initiative shall be certified without its drafters or their representatives having gathered supporting signatures from electors exceeding in number 1.111111111111 percent of the electorate from the most recent presidential election. But Congress may neither require signatures in excess of 5.555555555555 percent of such national electorate nor condition certification upon geographic apportionment of signatories, nor abridging or denying just authority bound political decisions by the People, which otherwise meet the baseline signatory requirements here and are cast by Citizens of Pacifica. Initiative drafters or their representatives shall make a public notice of a proposed initiative, and upon certification, a second public notice.

If certified, initiatives shall be put to a vote in every second year, on the same day as members of Congress are chosen, and on ballots in every State or jurisdiction choosing said members. The People enact an initiative into law when the number of votes in the affirmative outnumbers the number of votes in the negative, these options being the only two afforded.

Declarations of war shall not be made by initiative. The President may submit a treaty for ratification by initiative, the certification signature requirements in this article notwithstanding, but for ratification, the number of votes in the affirmative must account for at least two-thirds of the total votes cast. Congress shall prescribe the manner by which the President submits treaties to initiative and by which such initiatives are certified.

The Congressional elections shall be comprised of every elected political faction and the seats in Congress shall be awarded with respect to the percentage of the population that voted for that faction (without ballot affiliation of their party). Members of Congress shall be rated in consideration to how their vote/s correspond/s to their constituents and the People. All members of Congress and those running or expecting to run for Congress shall make accountable predictions on the effects of legislation being voted on, with their score of accuracy in those predictions as public information made available in voter’s brochures.

No Person shall be a Senator or Representative in Congress, or hold any office, civil or military, under Pacifica, or under any State, who, having previously taken an oath, as a member of Congress, or as an officer of Pacifica, or as a member of any State legislature, or as an executive or judicial officer of any State, to support the Constitution of Pacifica, shall have engaged in insurrection or unjust rebellion against the same, or given aid or comfort to the enemies thereof. However, Congress may by a vote of four-fifths of each House, remove such disability.

No one may serve in the Federal Legislature for more than three elective (or appointive) terms or a combination of three terms in both Houses of Congress.

The Courts of Pacifica and of the several States shall never, by any decision, including indirectly, decide who shall be a member of the National or State Legislature, Executive, or Courts.

Legislative districts and voting precincts shall be determined by open/public mathematical algorithm. Each State shall appoint a non-partisan board shall determine the algorithms used.

Districts represented by members of Congress, or by members of any State legislative body, shall be compact and composed of contiguous territory. The State shall have the burden of justifying any departures from this requirement by reference to neutral criteria such as natural/bio-regional, political, or historical boundaries or demographic changes. The interest in enhancing or preserving the political power of the party in control of the State government is not such a neutral criterion.

Neither the House of Representatives nor the Senate may adopt a rule requiring a supermajority vote.

SECTION. 2.

The House of Representatives shall be composed of Members chosen every second Year by the People of the several States, they shall each be limited to one term of six years.

No Person shall be a Representative who has not attained the Age of twenty-one Years, and after the first two congresses, been twelve Years a Citizen of Pacifica, and who shall not, when elected, be an Inhabitant of that State in which they shall be chosen.

Representatives shall be apportioned among each State which may be included within this Union, according to their respective Numbers, which shall be determined by adding to the whole Number of citizens and excluding the Indigenous population under Sovereign jurisdiction. The actual Enumeration shall be made within three Years after the first Meeting of the Congress of Pacifica, and within every subsequent Term of ten Years, in such Manner as they shall by Law direct. The number of Representatives shall not exceed one for every thirty thousand, but each State shall have at Least one Representative; and until such enumeration shall be made, the State#1 shall be entitled to choose three, State#2 three, State#3 three, State#4 three, State#5 three, State#6 three, State#7 three, State#8 three, State#9 three, State#10 three, State#11 three, and State#12 three.

After the first enumeration required by this Constitution, there shall be one Representative for every thirty-thousand, until the number shall amount to one-hundred, after which the proportion shall be so regulated by Congress, that there shall be not less than one-hundred Representatives, nor less than one Representative for every forty-thousand Persons, until the number of Representatives shall amount to two-hundred; after which the proportion shall be so regulated by Congress, that there shall not be less than two-hundred Representatives, nor more than one Representative for every fifty-thousand Persons.

When vacancies happen in the Representation from any State, the Executive Authority thereof shall issue Writs of Election to fill such Vacancies: Provided, that the legislature of any State may empower the executive thereof to make temporary appointments until the People fill the vacancies by election as the legislature may direct.

The House of Representatives shall choose their Speaker and other Officers; and shall have the sole Power of Impeachment. The Speaker of the House of Representatives shall be elected by a vote of at least three-fifths (3/5) of the total membership of the House.

Each member of the House of Representatives shall represent, as nearly as practicable, an equal number of people, as determined by the most recent census.

SECTION. 3.

The Senate of Pacifica shall be composed of three Senators from each State, nominated by the people thereof, and elected by the state legislature of each State respectively, for six years per term with a limit of one term; and each Senator shall have one vote; The ten States with the greatest population shall be entitled to two additional senators each, and the next fifteen most populated States one additional senator each.

When vacancies happen in the representation of any State in the Senate, the Executive Authority of such State shall issue writs of election to fill such vacancies: Provided, that the legislature of any State may empower the executive thereof to make temporary appointments until the People fill the vacancies by election as the legislature may direct.

Immediately after they shall be assembled in Consequence of the first Election, they shall be divided as equally as may be into three Classes. The Seats of the Senators of the first Class shall be vacated at the Expiration of the second year, of the second Class at the Expiration of the fourth Year, and of the third Class at the Expiration of the sixth year, so that one third may be chosen every second year; and if Vacancies happen by Resignation, or otherwise, during the Recess of the Legislature of any State, the Executive thereof may make temporary Appointments until the next Meeting of the Legislature, which shall then fill such Vacancies.

No Person shall be a Senator who has not attained the Age of twenty-one Years, and after the first two congresses, been twelve Years a Citizen of Pacifica, and who shall not, when elected, be an Inhabitant of that State for which they shall be chosen.

The Senate shall choose their other Officers, and also a President pro tempore, in the Absence of the Vice-President, or when he or she shall exercise the Office of President of Pacifica.

The Vice-President of Pacifica can bring up matters to vote on in the senate.

The Senate shall not have power to try representatives for Impeachment, it shall instead rest within the Federal Supreme Citizen’s High Court. When sitting for that Purpose, they shall be on Oath or Affirmation. When the President of Pacifica is tried, the Chief Justice-Consulate of the Federal Supreme Citizen’s High Court shall preside; In a trial on impeachment of the Vice-President they shall not preside over the Senate; No Person shall be convicted without the Concurrence of two-thirds of the Jury Members from the Federal Supreme Citizen’s High Court present.

The President shall be prohibited from pardoning themselves. Furthermore, the Vice President shall not be permitted to preside over their own impeachment trial.

Judgment in Cases of Impeachment shall not extend further than to removal from Office, and disqualification to hold and enjoy any Office of honor, Trust or Profit under Pacifica: but the Party convicted shall nevertheless be liable and subject to Indictment, Trial, Judgment and Punishment, according to Law.

SECTION. 4.

The Times, Places, and Manner of holding Elections for Senators and Representatives, and the place and manner of holding Elections for President, shall be prescribed in each State by the Legislature thereof and established by Pacifica Elections Commission; but the Congress may at any time by Law make or alter such Regulations, except as to the Places of choosing Senators, in cases when a State shall neglect or refuse to make the regulations therein mentioned or shall make regulations subversive of the rights of the People to a free and equal representation in Congress agreeably to the Constitution. The commission shall receive adequate funding from Congress. It shall establish rules and regulations for uniform national elections consistent with the goal of ensuring that all eligible voters, and only eligible voters, shall be entitled to cast a vote which shall be accurately counted. The (three) commissioners shall be nominated by the president for twelve-year terms, subject to confirmation by a three-quarters vote of Pacifica Senate. Commissioners shall hold their offices during good behavior, and shall, at stated times, receive for their services, a compensation, which shall not be diminished during their continuance in office.

The Congress shall assemble at least once every day of the work week in the most sustainable manner possible, in full view of the public with every word said by every member scrupulously recorded, and using secure electronic means shall be broadcast publicly for all [of the People] to observe, until all items on the docket are resolved.

SECTION. 5.

Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members, and a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business; but a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day, and may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members, in such Manner, and under such Penalties as each House may provide.

Each House may determine the Rules of its Proceedings by vote of a majority of the whole number of its members, provided that such Rules shall take effect three years following their enactment; punish its Members for disorderly Behavior; and with the Concurrence of two-thirds, expel a Member.

Each House shall keep a Journal of its Proceedings, and from time to time publish the same, excepting such Parts as may in their Judgment require Secrecy; and the Yeas and Nays of the Members of either House on any question shall, at the Desire of one-fifth of those Present, be entered on the Journal.

Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days, nor to any other Place than that in which the two Houses shall be sitting.

SECTION. 6.

The Senators and Representatives shall receive a Compensation for their Services, to be ascertained by Law, and paid out of the Treasury of Pacifica. They shall in all Cases, except Treason, Felony and Breach of the Peace, be privileged from Arrest during their Attendance at the Session of their respective Houses, and in going to and returning from the same; and for any Speech or Debate in either House, they shall not be questioned in any other Place.

All terms of legislators’ compensation, including all non-monetary compensation and benefits, shall be ratified by a plurality of the voting populace represented

No Senator or Representative shall, during the Time for which they were elected, be appointed to any civil Office under the Authority of Pacifica, which shall have been created, or the Emoluments whereof shall have been increased during such time; and no Person holding any Office under Pacifica, shall be a Member of either House during their Continuance in Office.

SECTION. 7.

The term of the budget and authorization to raise or direct funds shall run from 00:00:00 in the Federal District State on January first of a calendar year to December thirty-first 23:59:59 in that same calendar year.

In the absence of a budget passed by a majority of both chambers of the Congress and signed by the President, or, following a Veto by the President, passed again by the appropriate margins in each chamber, the government shall have no authority to raise or spend funds, nor to compel labor from any person.

The budget for any year shall be passed by a majority of both chambers of the Congress and signed by the President, or, following a Veto by the President, passed again by the appropriate margins in each chamber before 12:00:00 in the District of Olympus on November 1st of the preceding calendar year.

Citizens can elect to have any portion of their Individual proportional control of the Public funds which are under their direction, allocated to government department[s] and program[s] as they see fit/suitable, and optionally towards reducing the debt of the Nation and/or their State, if such debt exists, as they decide, without the possibility such debt absorption siphoned off for diversion to non-Individual-specified alternative “absorbing deparment[s]/program[s]”. Each department and program shall have spending caps to be determined by the Legislative branch. Once a spending cap is met for any particular department or program, the Citizen’s Individual proportional control of Public funds which are under their direction can then be allocated to one of the other departments or programs that they the Individual Citizen may have chosen. In this case, the People shall retain the right to assess, levy, and pay, their respective proportions of such requisitions, in such way and manner as to which they shall judge best. And in case any Citizen shall neglect or refuse to pay their proportion out of the fraction of Governmental Profits for which their direction was intended, pursuant to such requisition, then Congress may assess and levy such Citizen’s proportion, with an amount of eight-and-two-thirds percent (~8.333%) administered to such Citizen’s birth-state or First State Residence upon Naturalization, as prescribed in such amount for requisition. None of the budgets from any department or project are divertible without a direct vote of the People amounting to three-fifths majority or greater.

All budgets for a given year shall follow the foregoing investment scheme to secure its funds into the future:
All money allocated into the General budget shall go into the National Investment Trust, which will accrue annuities three times the initial input value, before they shall overflow into a fourth fund, and the fourth fund shall fill up until it spills over and inputs annuities into the fifth, from which such annuities generated shall flow over into the fourth; Then the fourth may be spent and replenished by annuity generation from the other four trusts on a yearly budgetary basis as directed by the Legislature or the third branch of Congress through appropriations by the People;
All other budgetary directions issued by the People shall follow the same scheme of partition and separate financialization trusts (apart from the National Investment Trust), of three to a fourth, overflowing into a fifth, before spending of the fourth and replenishment by the fifth and overflow from the prior three, to ensure future security of solvency in the trust;
Any potential access into the first three trusts shall be directed and limited by the People, according to their best preference and wisest decision; In any case where the People may hand power over to a representative to make the choice/s for them in regards to the first three trusts and accessing them for special or emergency purpose, the Congress shall call a referendum on the issue to be voted on by the People, unless in time of catastrophe or war they are unable to convene a vote of the People, then they may act in their full representative form and decide on behalf of the People's best interests.

Pacifica and each State shall provide for an internet connected budgetary drafting, commenting, and ratification system that is easy for Individuals and businesses to use for the purpose of appraising the amount of funds they control for disbursement to Pacifica’s and each State’s government, and to facilitate the transfer of those funds into the Treasury of either. The People shall be free to use alternative forms of managing the governmental budgets, and to abstain from using a specific implementation if their free conscience directs them to do so, though this shall not be construed as to absolve the manager of funds to provide payment of those said funds towards any applicable level of government within Pacifica.

If a budget is not ratified by the appropriate process by 12:00:00 in the District of Olympus on November first of the preceding calendar year, every person, program, policy, or other activity funded by government money or engaged in the raising of revenue or the dispersal of funds, shall prioritize activities that ensure that compliance with Provision two of this section shall be accomplished in an orderly fashion while minimizing harm. This prioritization of activity shall continue until a budget is ratified by the appropriate process or the term of the current budget has expired.

If a budget is not ratified by the appropriate process by 12:00:00 in the District of Olympus on January 1st of the calendar year, the following shall occur:
(a) Every person, program, policy, or other activity funded by government money or engaged in the raising of revenue or the dispersal of funds, shall cease activity. No person apart from duly elected or appointed members of the Congress, the President and Vice President, and the Justices of the Supreme Court, or the People [as may be laid down by this constitution], shall have ability to act with the authority of the Federal Government. No funds shall be spent by any officer, agency, contract agent or other organ of the Federal Government. No revenue shall be raised or collected. These restrictions shall continue until a budget is ratified by the appropriate process.
(b) All persons holding elected or appointed office in the House of Representatives or the Senate shall be sequestered to the Place in which the two Houses shall be sitting. This section shall be enforced by the militia of the Several States in a manner determined by law. These restrictions shall continue until a budget is ratified by the appropriate process.

Nothing in this Section shall prohibit the Congress from supplementing or revising the ratified budget during the year in which it is in effect in order to address unforeseen circumstances.

The Congress shall have the power to enforce this section by appropriate legislation.

SECTION. 8.

For it is surely the plunder of an Individual’s property, the fruits of their labor, and the freedom of volition to voluntarily transact as the Individual, whose rights are affected, with their non-transferable non-negotiable right to revocable fully-informed consent, [that they] may so see fit, in which the collective sucks the lifeblood of the Individual’s own [actual] productivity, for the State’s outrageous justifications for their demands, having imposed force upon a non-aggressing Sovereign person, who had [themself] committed no injustice by exercising their unalienable right to property, Taxation [in General] by Pacifica or on its behalf is hereby abolished;-And, Being that [General] taxation is the legalized plunder of the fruits of one’s labor and personal productivity, by the blood-letting of venomous leeches which suck the sustenance out of the people, and have them converted into meat to be fed to their brethren, taxation upon the General Public by Pacifica or on its behalf is hereby abolished permanently. Not only is taxation abolished by this constitution, but any act, rule, or declaration which resembles in form or function any type of taxation, not explicitly granted by the Constitution, shall furthermore be barred from exercise in power by the government.

No tax, levy, assessment, fee, duty, or other compulsory exaction shall be imposed by Pacifica, its States, Territories, or any public instrument upon any Person, their labor, property, transactions, or privileges, except as explicitly authorized herein and only to the narrowest extent necessary for expressly designated constitutional purposes. All such exactions not specifically authorized by this Charter are hereby declared repugnant to natural rights, self-ownership, and the social compact, save for the constitutionally stipulated and tailored strictly limited impositions, each capped and conditioned.

No tax shall be excessive nor without Representation, even under the pretext of tacit consent, for while tacit consent implies a tiered structure of fiscal duty, it arises not by arbitrary imposition but through the implicit reciprocity of businesses and wealthy Persons benefiting from the stability, justice, and institutional integrity of the public order that safeguards rights, ensures commerce, and furnishes economic opportunities which enable extraction and accumulation, thereby instilling upon them the civil duty to contribute proportionately as a quid pro quo for the systemic equilibrium they enjoy; such contribution supplies the common welfare without demanding direct consent for every levy, since the People possess the right to remain free from excessive or unjust taxation and from fiscal decrees not ratified through their Representative will for the public good, established through strong consensus, and though not every individual must expressly convene or vote upon each tax imposed, they remain collectively endowed to mutual benefit of society by such impositions, and the plurality of civic agreement must define what taxes are tolerable and to what degree they may be implemented, ensuring that no tax becomes absolute, total, or destructive of the self-actualization of the People as free individuals or as associations of citizens who have mutually consented to governance within the boundaries of their natural and civil rights.

The People can donate to the government and direct the funds to where they want them.

SECTION. 9.

All bills must be written by elected members of Congress, not lobbyists.

All Bills for raising Revenue shall originate in the House of Representatives; but the Senate may propose or concur with Amendments as on other Bills. The People may draft, propose, vet, and vote on the budget.

Each bill or joint resolution shall embrace no more than one subject; The subject of a bill or joint resolution shall be clearly and descriptively expressed in the title; An appropriations bill shall not contain any general legislation or change of existing law provision, the subject of which is not germane to the subject matter of each such appropriations bill provided however, that this section shall not be construed to prohibit any provision imposing limitations upon the expenditure of funds so appropriated.

Every Bill must be given adequate time to be read, and be read fully in every word, before which it shall have passed the House of Representatives and the Senate, and shall, before it become a Law, be presented to the President of Pacifica; If they are to read every word and approve they shall sign it, but if not they shall return it, with his or her Objections to that House in which it shall have originated, who shall enter the Objections at large on their Journal, and proceed to reconsider it. If after such reconsideration two-thirds of that House shall agree to pass the Bill, it shall be sent, together with the Objections, to the other House, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if approved by two-thirds of that House, it shall become a Law. But in all such Cases the Votes of both Houses shall be determined by Yeas and Nays, and the Names of the Persons voting for and against the Bill shall be entered on the Journal of each House respectively. If any Bill shall not be returned by the President within ten Days (Sundays excepted) after it shall have been presented to them, the Same shall be a Law, in like Manner as if they had signed it, unless the Congress by their Adjournment prevent its Return, in which Case it shall not be a Law. Any Bill passed shall be subject to the general right of veto by the Citizens as expressed in the referendum; Any Bill vetoed by the Citizens in the referendum shall be considered void and shall not be revived.

No expenditure shall be made, or obligation incurred or committed, by or for the government or any activity under its supervision, except within appropriations enacted by Congress, which shall specify the amount and the department or activity it may support, and which shall not exceed six years.

The word “bills” shall include proposals within bills, and any proposal for raising or receiving revenues or disbursing funds, including for borrowing or lending, shall originate in the House of Representatives, and shall specify rates, amounts, objects, and purposes.

The Citizens of Pacifica must approve all proposed legislation via referendum, by no less than three-fifths majority of all participating voters on a given topic.

Every Order, Resolution, or Vote to which the Concurrence of the Senate and House of Representatives may be necessary (except on a question of Adjournment) shall be presented to the President of Pacifica; and before the Same shall take Effect, shall be approved by him or her, or being disapproved by him or her, shall be re-passed by two thirds of the Senate and House of Representatives, according to the Rules and Limitations prescribed in the Case of a Bill.

SECTION. 10.

Congress shall have power to seek [but not compel] council of qualified professionals in fields relevant to legislation they are drafting, proposing, and voting on for enactment.

Congress shall have the power to seek [but not compel] the commented referendum opinion from the people about drafted legislation before proposal for the regular process of review and potential ratification or denial based upon the rules of procedure prescribed in this Constitution.

All federal rules, ordinances, regulations, acts, declarations, and laws, must be created and passed by Congress or the People, not by the Departments, Agencies, Commissions, Centers, or other Offices underneath them, as are provided for under this Constitution.

Congress shall have Power to Special Month/s or Season/s Designations, and designate nationally recognized days off, in manner that are appropriate to the other constitutionally assigned powers of Congress, as according to this Constitution.

Congress shall have Power to raise revenue, to pay the Debts and provide for the common Defense and general Welfare of Pacifica and its citizens; but no revenue may be layed or increased without approval of two-thirds of both Houses;

For the purposes of funding the Federal government, each State shall be required to contribute a membership fee to the federal government not to exceed the equivalent to one-twelfth (1/12) of one-hundred percent (100%), equaling eight-point-three-bar percent (8.333bar%) of the assessed base value of general budget, determined by the state for such purpose. The contributions paid by the States under this provision shall be deposited into the general fund of the Federal government and shall be used solely for the operation and administration of Federal government functions as prescribed by this constitution. The contribution shall be established as a mandatory obligation of each State and shall be paid annually or as otherwise prescribed by Federal law, by consent of the States or the People through the normal process of representation in Congress assembled or Referendum and Initiative of the People. This provision shall not authorize any tax or financial imposition upon the States exceeding the specified membership contribution fee. The penalty for a state not paying the fee is that they shall not receive distributions of funds from the federal government until such fee and any remaining unpaid fees are satisfied; or, the benefit of Federal protection and Public goods/services rendered in the case of absconding, until restitution is made. Congress has the power to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation;

To establish a Department of Revenue, charged with administering the revenues of the Federal Department of Goods and Services;

To establish a Department of Finance, to serve as the fiscal policy advisory and to promote long term economic sustainability and responsible resource allocation;

To establish a Department of Goods and Services, and shall have Power to establish facilities, as well as procure resources and labor for the manufacturing and retailing of goods or services desired by the public, to pay for Federal expenditures that would had otherwise been funded on theft, otherwise known as collected taxes, and of which such Public Sector businesses shall be operated autonomously in like manner to that of a citizen-owned co-op and worker’s council [bicameral stakeholder system] where the people’s co-op house is the representative branch, and the worker council is the senatorial power, in a profit-for-the-public-good venture; but it shall not have the power to conscript the resources or labor of any person; nor shall it use tax dollars to establish or maintain itself, meaning that the ‘Public sector’ businesses established must be operated on their own revenues at their own expense, with any profits not re-invested into them placed into the general fund of Pacifica; The Treasury are encouraged to accept donations from the People, designated by the People, for the purpose of funding the Department of Goods and Services; ‘Public sector’ business shall be subject to the same laws and regulations as Private business, and neither shall hold an exclusive monopoly to operate within Pacifica. The People shall be free to petition through Initiative or Referendum to engage/produce, query/request, or cease/halt, any Operation, Action, Product, Manufacture, Method, or other Mode of Execution, in the Department of Goods and Services, as so alike shall the Legislature, if in conformity to the will of the People’s Just Authority;

Congress shall have the power to subsidize; They may grant subsidies to an organization, institution, business, company, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity for exemplary practices that serve the commonwealth and benefit the welfare of the environment and the People;

Total outlays for any fiscal year shall not exceed total receipts for that fiscal year. Prior to each fiscal year, the Budget Officer shall transmit to the Congress a proposed budget for the Pacifica Government for that fiscal year in which total outlays do not exceed total receipts; A Bill to increase revenue shall not become law unless citizens approve this Bill in a referendum;

The Congress and the President shall assemble at least once each year to balance the budget and manage the finances of Pacifica;

The Legislature of Pacifica shall have the power to establish and maintain a dedicated Emergency Treasury Fund exclusively reserved for urgent, unforeseen emergencies as defined by law. This Emergency Fund shall not serve as a means to create new appropriations nor shall it replace or supplement the constitutionally authorized budgeting process, but shall remain a distinct treasury account controlled under the existing fiscal procedures. Access to the Emergency Fund shall require either a two-thirds affirmative vote of the Legislature or a formal emergency funding request made by a Commonwealth government demonstrating a narrowly defined exigent circumstance unrelated to other emergency management powers. The use of the Emergency Fund shall be strictly confined to instances of urgent necessity, ensuring accountability, transparency, and legislative oversight of all expenditures drawn from this reserve account. The Legislature shall be responsible for enacting laws that clearly delineate the criteria for emergency fund activation, procedures for fund disbursement, and rigorous safeguards against misuse, thereby protecting the Fund’s integrity and public trust. Additionally, the Legislature shall provide an annual public report detailing the status, disbursements, and remaining balances of the Emergency Fund, thereby guaranteeing ongoing accountability to the sovereign people and their respective Commonwealths. This provision acknowledges that the people remain sovereign over public finances, and the Emergency Fund serves solely as a responsive fiscal mechanism empowering both the Legislature and the Commonwealth governments to meet critical and exceptional needs in alignment with the constitutional budgetary framework found in this document;

To establish a Department of National Treasury. Publicly-owned State Banks of the several States may opt-in to serve as partial-extensions of the National treasury [with the consent of Congress and approval of the President], in that they may hold deposits of Federal government money and legal tender, distribute its money and legal tender for it as Congress shall decide by law, and freely exchange the legal tender for lawful money with all parties operating in a lawful manner with them [including the People of the Pacifica of Sovereign Persons], and vice versa, as well as fungibly in-between notes or moneys, with a one-to-one ratio of interchangeability with each-other in the case of Pacifican dollars, in accordance with this Constitution and the laws in the legislature of Congress and of their State;

Congress shall have the exclusive power to mint and issue the coinage of National Money, regulate the Value and quantity thereof, and of foreign Coin, for the purpose of keeping the average prices of Goods and Services normal and stable;

Congress shall have the power to define lawful money and legal tender only on territory for which it has exclusive jurisdiction, and State legislatures only on exclusively State territory, only within the scope and under the limitations set forth by this Constitution. Neither Congress nor the States or other Territories may make anything lawful money or legal tender that does not consist of, or is backed by Rhodium, Palladium, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Nickel, Copper, Cannabis, [Pure] Water/DiHydrogenMonoxide, Energy, Greencash, ComputeTime, or alloys or combinations of them, neither use anything but [?]bills of credit [or stablecoins backed by these credits][?] to pay its debts, nor use anything but fully-reserved representative legal tender notes or constitutionally lawful money to repay for and recover issued Bills of Credit [or their stablecoins], or accept anything but fully-reserved representative legal tender notes, lawful money, or Pacifican National Bills of Credit [or their stablecoins] for all debts, public charges, and dues;

Congress shall have the exclusive power to mint and emit National Bills of Credit in the form of negotiable promissory notes, as well as regulate the Value and quantity thereof, to provide payment for the national expenditures, which resources for the liability were not raised through the other powers granted by the People to the Federal Government; Emitted Bills of credit (which are currency, not money, or representative notes), may not exceed 8.333333333333%, in number, the gross value of notes representing the total National money supply; No bills of credit shall be issued by Pacifica, without the assent of two-thirds of the Senators and Representatives present in each House;

The minting, management, and emission, of the Pacifican National Currency, being Commodity Money, Representative note Legal Tender, and Bills of Credit fiat, shall be vested exclusively within Congress, and they shall NOT be empowered to contract with any entities external to [the several levels of] Pacifica’s or the several State’s Public government/s to perform such duties;

In recognition of the foundational principles of transparency, accountability, and economic democracy integral to the sovereign People of Pacifica, Congress (or through Just Authority, the People of Pacifica) shall be vested with the exclusive power and solemn duty to institute a comprehensive and immutable transparency framework governing the Treasury, all Publicly-owned State Banks, and any federal fiscal appropriations or expenditures, thereby ensuring financial operations are conducted with maximal openness and irreversible public scrutiny; this framework shall empower the People, their elected Representatives, and independent third-party bodies alike with inherent, constitutionally guaranteed authority to initiate, conduct, and report upon audits of all monetary and financial activities, encompassing, without limitation, the issuance, backing, and circulation of national currency, representative notes, bills of credit, allocation and utilization of federal funds, state banking transactions, and congressional spending, coupled with the establishment of a centralized digital verification system whose protocols, security features, and participatory governance mechanisms are subject to democratic approval via direct or representative vote, thereby mandating that all audits, including expenditures, deployed funds, receipts, and evidence of serviced public projects, are transparently accessible in real-time or near-real-time electronic formats to enable citizen-led oversight and participatory governance in economic justice; to this end, Congress (or 'the People', through Just Authority) shall establish or designate an autonomous Congressional Audit Authority, supplemented by a People’s Audit Commission and an Independent Auditor Council, each empowered to perform audits independently while fostering mutual corroboration through the centralized system ensuring authentication and anti-fraud measures; these institutional divisions shall operate under statutory mandates to preserve the sanctity of economic liberty, to prevent concealment or obfuscation of data by any governmental or financial entity, including State Banks and the Treasury, and to guarantee protections of privacy consistent with constitutional rights against unwarranted logging and surveillance while maintaining transparency of economic flows and public resource management, fostering a society devoted to wide and fair ownership of productive assets; moreover, Congress shall promulgate regulations requiring that all data relevant to public fiscal activity, federal and state bank transactions, and budgetary deployment be published in formats comprehensible and usable by the People for independent verification and that institutional respondents cooperate fully with audit requests across all governmental tiers without exception; the system shall also include a voter-approved mechanism to update auditing standards and verification protocols in response to evolving technological capabilities and economic needs, ensuring that the People of Pacifica retain control over the integrity of their economic governance, that financial power is distributed equitably, and that no entity wields opaque influence over monetary policy or public expenditure without the full and continuous consent and informed participation of the governed, upholding the highest ideals of constitutional governance and economic justice in service of Pacifica’s sovereign populace;

To provide for the Punishment of counterfeiting the Securities and current Coin of Pacifica;

To regulate banks and financial institutions, public exchanges, and private insurance;

To establish uniform Laws on the subject of Bankruptcies throughout Pacifica;

To regulate Commerce with foreign Nations, and among each State, and with the Native Tribes;

To establish a Department of Public Works and Internal Improvements, tasked with producing construction and infrastructure projects, such as highways, dams, ports, and interstate-networks, financed by public funds and constructed by the government for the benefit or use of the [general] public;

To establish an Independent Efficiency Commission to review and recommend reforms to government processes, regulations, and agencies, with a mandate to modernize, reform, and maximize government productivity while eliminating redundancy and reducing administrative costs without compromising constitutional protections. The money saved by this commission, funded by those government savings and not by deficit spending, shall be redistributed to the Citizens of Pacifica [except those of high income] as a dividend payment kicked back to them, as direct disbursements.

To establish a Department of Commerce, concerned with promoting economic growth. Among its tasks are gathering economic and demographic data for business and government decision-making, and helping to set industrial standards. This organization’s main purpose is to create jobs, promote economic growth, encourage sustainable development and improve standards of living for all Pacificans. The mission of the department is to “promote job creation and improved living standards for all Pacificans by creating an infrastructure that promotes economic growth, technological competitiveness, and sustainable development, and to foster, promote, and develop the foreign and domestic commerce.”;

The power of Congress to make all laws that are necessary and proper to regulate Commerce among the several States, Native Tribes, or with foreign Nations, shall not be construed to include the power to regulate or prohibit any activity that is confined within a single State regardless of its effects outside the State, whether it employs instrumentalities therefrom, or whether its regulation or prohibition is part of a comprehensive regulatory scheme; The power of Congress to regulate commerce among the several states shall be limited to the regulation of the sale, shipment, transportation, or other movement of goods, articles, or persons, either interstate or internationally; Congress may not regulate activity solely because it affects commerce among the several states; but Congress shall have power to regulate harmful emissions between one State and another, and to define and provide for punishment of offenses constituting acts of war or violent insurrection against Pacifica; The Regulation of Commerce shall not be construed as to impair any of the rights of Natural Persons, Animals, or [the] Environment/Nature; The Legislatures of the States shall have standing to file any claim alleging violation of this provision; Nothing in this provision shall be construed to limit standing that may otherwise exist for a person;

Congress shall have power to regulate artificial intelligence only to the extent necessary to secure the equal rights, liberties, and safety+security of the People, to prevent serious harm to persons, property, animals, other life, the natural environment, and the free exercise of rights, and to preserve fair, open, and accountable conditions in the public use of artificial intelligence. Congress shall not create systems of prior permission, general licensing, mandatory registration, or blanket permit requirements for lawful artificial intelligence development, publication, distribution, or use. Any regulation shall be narrow, evidence-based, and the least restrictive means consistent with the protection of fundamental rights, namely life and health, liberty+autonomy+sovereignty+independence, security,+defense, privacy, property, and the pursuit of happiness. Congress shall have power to require transparency, auditability, disclosure of material safety and operational integrity facts, open technical standards where practicable, and remedies for demonstrable harm or damage, while respecting open-source development, anonymous users and expressive conduct, pseudonymous participation, and the lawful publication of code, models, weights, and research, in accordance to this Constitution. Congress may prohibit or restrict any commercial public-facing artificial intelligence model or system, including free orpaid models released by business interests (free-to-own open-source or public-domain releases excepted), only upon lawful findings supported by evidence that the system presents a serious and unreasonable risk of substantial harm to persons, property, animals, other life, the environment, public safety, public security, or the free exercise of rights.

To establish a Department of Customs and Border Protection, charged with regulating and facilitating international trade, collecting import duties, and enforcing Pacifica regulations, including trade, customs, and immigration, as well as processing all goods, vehicles/crafts, and people entering and exiting Pacifica. The primary mission of the Department of Customs and Border Protection is to safeguard Pacifica’s borders, thereby protecting the public from dangerous People, as well as communicable diseases, and hazardous materials while enhancing the Pacifican global economic competitiveness by enabling legitimate trade and travel;

To establish a Department of Statistics, to serve as the central statistical authority on primary data collection in Pacifica, by conducting censuses and community surveys on different sectors of the Pacifican economy, such as population, housing, agriculture, fisheries, and business. It shall collect, compile, analyze, and publish statistical information on economic, social, demographic, political affairs and general affairs of the people of Pacifica;

The Pacifican Census taking must draw the district boundaries to be: Contiguous; Compact (no gerrymandering); Fair (lakes, rivers, streams, roads, mountains, county lines, school districts, all these geopolitical boundaries inform the district lines, but party lines shall not, nor shall economics); Districts to be As Equal in population across all states as humanly possible; all redistricting at any level must be done by non-partisan committees; If mandatory districting is done away with by federal law, this section applies to any states that choose to district.

To establish a Department of Standards, to fix the standard of weights, measures, languages, encryption of government classified and unclassified-but-sensitive public communication [and Private communications occurring upon the networks of the Public-Instrument], operational security manuals, to provide conversions and translations between these units and languages, and to maintain a fixed number of Atomic Clocks not to exceed one within each State and Independent Territory which is in this Union which are accessible over the several Federal communications networks including the National “Smart/Information Highway” system’s nG cellular systems and from TCP/IP national and global internet systems;

To establish Post Offices, Post Roads, Post Railroads, and Post Airports/Space-Stations; and a Postal Money Order System to meet all the demands of exchange; and a comprehensive, private, and secure messaging, communications, and virtual presence system and/or a series or number of inter-operating systems and/or techniques fit for the needs of the ever accelerating age of information, driven in primary by the Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence of the People [and their naturally un-restrained ability to ask questions, learn, think, create, and share old or new ideas of all kinds, so long as it does not come at the expense of another’s rights], with a primary focus on commonly accessible individual/user-directable and client/person-programmable social/search/automat[i]on-algorithms built on top of a federated system compatible with ActivityPub protocol, in order to optimize the acquisition of desired and relevant and/or related information; and to affix such Postal Rates and Social Media Advertisements for the same as shall be deemed necessary to maintain them for the public benefit. The Postal Office Social Media platform shall clearly and conspicuously label all accounts and content affiliated with state media, including but not limited to media from Pacifica, the United States, Saudi Arabia, and all other countries. The platform shall prohibit and permanently ban all accounts affiliated with state media from any country officially designated as a terrorist state by the government of Pacifica. every participant may at any time pause or permanently terminate discovery, revoke standing consents, block or remove other participants, export their own information in a usable format, delete their profile, sever every linkage to the general Postal Office social-media service or any other system, and require the deletion or irreversible de-identification of information not strictly retained for a separately lawful, constitutionally valid, narrowly defined, and disclosed purpose, with clear notice of each limited category and retention period that cannot immediately be erased, as well as the purpose/intention, extent/scope of it/them; no officer, employee, contractor, algorithm, public instrument, or recipient acting through the Service shall sell, lease, barter, advertise against, profile for unrelated purposes, train upon, commercially exploit, or disclose relationship preferences, private correspondence, contact information, sensitive media, reviews, private notes, safety reports, location information, availability status, identity information, behavioral records, or other intimate information absent the specific and revocable consent of the Person concerned, except pursuant to a lawful court order issued for a legitimate, particularized purpose by a qualified judge of competent jurisdiction holding office during good behavior, supported by the constitutionally required showing, and narrowly describing the Person, information, place, and time period to be searched, seized, compelled, or disclosed; generalized surveillance, bulk collection, persistent tracking, undisclosed monitoring, fishing expeditions (inspection of large amounts of someone’s data or communications merely to see whether something damaging might turn up), backdoor access, compelled account linkage, and secret examination of the Service’s intimate records are prohibited, and no act of enrollment, verification, use, correspondence, account linkage, or consent to a limited feature shall be construed as a waiver of privacy, bodily autonomy, property, due process, freedom of association, freedom of expression, or any other natural or constitutional right retained by the People; the Service shall employ data minimization, strong encryption, secure technical design, access records available to the affected Person where compatible with a valid and narrowly limited court order, accessible interfaces, transparent moderation standards, independent audits, anonymized aggregate public reporting, prompt remedies for official or private misuse, and protections against retaliation, while preserving every Person’s right to form private alternatives, communicate outside the Service, and associate lawfully without public interference; and all rules, procedures, algorithms, contractors, technical systems, and administrative actions employed for the Service shall remain narrowly confined to this voluntary relationship-based public communications service, subject to public audit, constitutional challenge, periodic review, repeal, and continuing accountability to the Sovereign People of Pacifica, and shall never be interpreted to create authority for compelled intimacy, compelled disclosure, social-credit ranking, unlawful surveillance, punishment without due process, or infringement of the sovereignty, privacy, dignity, equal rights, and self-direction of any Person.
