To inaugurate and provide for a system of National Highways, Railways, Bus Terminals, Air-Ports/Space-Stations, Fuel Generation and Distribution Systems as well as Dispensing/Retail Providers/Filling-depot, Electric/Ion Capture/Generation and Vehicle/Craft Charger-Stations, Beam-to-Vehicle/Craft-Energy Transception-Stations and Satellites, and Hyper-Space [but NOT Parallel-time or Hyper-Time] Gateways, based upon the proposition that whatever involves the direct interests of the public should be in the hands and under the control of the people, for the general welfare of the people, and to that end may purchase existing highways, railways, bus terminals, air-ports/space-stations, fuel generation and distribution systems as well as dispensing/retail providers/filling-depots, electric/ion capture/generation and vehicle/craft charger-stations, beam-to-vehicle/craft-energy transception-stations and satellites, and hyper-space gateways at a price to be ascertained by law, but not greater than the same could be constructed for, or construct new ones, as the circumstances shall seem to require; and the system shall be operated either at the cost of maintenance or for the public benefit from the public funds, as the people may direct by law;

To inaugurate and provide for a system of National electronic networks, based upon the proposition that whatever involves the direct interests of the public should be in the hands and under the control of the people, for the general welfare of the people; and the system shall be operated for the public benefit from the public funds, and for limited purposes may be leased access to commercial entities at cost or for a minimal markup, as defined in this Constitution;

To establish a Communications and Public Access Network Commission, which will establish and manage public resources of [inter-state] government networks, and grant or deny commercial use contracts, upon request after review, and to lease their access to the network, at a [uniform] rate equal to their share of the construction, operation, and maintenance costs entailed in providing them service, as determined by the Congress, and at the discretion of the Legislature may be charged an additional uniform amount not exceeding 16.666bar% of the base cost, with such contracts being issued and leases granted for the conduction of regular business activities (not those activities which are subletting access to, or selling services based on core dependency to, the Public network). The Congress shall create a pulseHVDC-driven single-wire global Internet system known as EarthLink, and a satellite-based global and inner planetary UV-assisted pulseHVDC-pumped plasma-channel radiant-transmission communication system called SkyLink; the systems shall be freely accessible and interoperable with legacy equipment from the generation they are deployed on forwards;

Pacifica shall establish and maintain a National Weather Office dedicated to the prediction of weather and the issuance of warnings for severe weather events to protect life, property, and the national welfare. The National Weather Office shall: Be responsible for the collection, analysis, and dissemination of weather data; Provide timely and accurate forecasts and warnings of hazardous weather, including but not limited to hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, and other extreme events; Maintain and advance scientific research, observational infrastructure, and forecasting technology to ensure continuous improvement in weather prediction and risk communication; Coordinate with federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial authorities, as well as academic and private sector partners, to maximize the effectiveness of weather services and warnings. The National Weather Office shall operate as an independent agency under the oversight of Congress, with its leadership appointed by the President and confirmed by the Senate. Congress shall have the power to provide for the funding, staffing, and regulation of the National Weather Office, ensuring its capacity to fulfill its mission as an essential public safety institution. The powers and responsibilities established by this provision shall not be construed to limit or preclude additional federal, state, or local efforts to provide weather services or warnings.

To inaugurate and provide for an [optional] National “Emergency Alert System” that will be used to alert Persons within Pacifica to National emergencies. The “Emergency Alert System” will be required by law to be available for integration or accessibility on/into all commercially-sold radios, or other Commercially-sold communications devices or softwares, that which utilize wireless or wired network connections and are subsequently possible to be connected to the internet, but it shall be required that such “Emergency Alert System” will be possible for the end-use consumer to easily, and fully, in all entirety, disable within the system’s configuration/settings at their own discretion, and not to have such mechanism attempt to bypass the user’s preferences, nor have its removal from source files, if there is any, upon re-compilation, break any of the other functions of the program. This power of Congress shall not exclude the power of the States to require their own State’s “Emergency Alert System”[s] as necessary according to their laws of regulation for Commerce, for any product sold or consumed within their State, as may be prescribed by their constitution, and the Congressional system will be obligated to be capable of broadcasting State and Local alerts, where appropriate, upon request of that State, as may be ascertained by law;

To establish a National Intellectual Monopoly Office, to provide for the promotion of Product Innovation, and development of the Sciences and useful Arts; and for that purpose may secure for limited times, not to exceed a combined total of twelve years, to Authors, Designers, and Inventors, the exclusive right to their respective writings, discoveries, designs, and inventions; or at their (the creator/s'[s]) discretion, to purchase the same for the general benefit of the people;

To establish a Department of Research and Development for Science, Engineering, and Technology, to organize and facilitate the governmental activities into laboratory programs that may be limited by the People, which include but are not limited to: Nano-scale research as well as science and technology development for structural materials and energy harvesting and production purposes, including research on chemicals/molecules and materials which themselves may be radioactive, as well as science and technology development surrounding the areas of quantum-computation and quantum-consciousness technology along with quantum sensors and quantum networking, and wave-structure-dynamic computing; Hardware, Programming, and Software research, as well as engineering and technology development surrounding these areas; Information, Learning, as well as Specific and General Artificial Intelligence in addition to NeuroMorphic System-on-Chip and BioComputing along with bio-machine interface research, theory, and technology development, most specifically in the area of recursively self-improving autonomous code and hardware synthesis, along with simulated consciousness and the creation of truly intelligent Androids; Vehicle/craft and robotic/drone research, as well as engineering and technology development; Exoskeletons, power armors, and human augmentation engineering and development suitable for purpose in the Armed Forces and among the People of Pacifica; Medical science including [healthy] performance enhancement, stem cells and rejuvenation therapies, life extension technology, medical devices, prosthetics, and cybernetic enhancements, so long as it does not infringe on any of the rights of Persons; Developing a unified theory of everything (with the intention of being used in Pacifican governmental physically realistic simulations within hardware and software), with the final product being named “M-Theory”, which shall stand for “Merger Theory”, being named by their dimensionhoods, compositions, and classification/s, in the logical organization of wSExTEyTzS [base_energy_composition] [medium_composition] [theory_classification] (if available), or, W[space-Energy]X[time_Energy]Y[time_Space]Z[space_Space], along with the name/s of the composition of base energy, as well as the name/s of the composition of the medium, and the name/s of the classification of the theory (if available); Electrodynamic and warpdynamic spacecraft; Non-polluting energy technology and net-zero waste recycling; Gravito-resonant space-transit and quantum teleportation;

Congress shall establish a National Institute of Future Technologies to coordinate research, set ethical standards for emerging technologies (e.g., AI, genetic engineering, gravity weapons, teleportation tubes, et cetera), and ensure alignment with the principles of individual sovereignty and mutual non-aggression.

To establish a Department of Open-Source Projects and Information, to reasonably support upon request, fund, create, manage, and maintain open-source projects and informative materials of interest for use by the government and general public, upon the discretion of the people, and maintain a public repository of open-source information;

Congress shall establish a National Innovation Fund to provide grants and incentives for research and development in transformative technologies, including but not limited to artificial intelligence, renewable energy, biotechnology, and space exploration, prioritizing open-source and public-domain outcomes where feasible.

To enact a National Archive and Library of Congress to protect the information of the governing of Pacifica, its citizens, and the knowledge of the world. This National Archive and Library of Congress shall be operated in a “non-profit” fashion. Amoung the several/many materials hosted by the archive library, there shall also be an internet file and website archive and a means to download the archive selectively based on several selectable and adjustable criteria determined by the user. There shall also be established a user-generated wiki that is maintained by the people of Pacifica, and any member of the general public may produce a wiki page on a relevant topic or contribute to other pages, in a democratic fashion. There shall be no user or file tracking or tracing performed by the archive and library for data [they freely offer] available to the public, but this shall not interfere with law enforcement powers to remove material which violates the rights of another person or in the narrow case of protecting [limited] Intellectual Monopoly interests;

Congress shall establish and maintain "GovTracker", an open, censorship-free digital platform closely integrated with the Library of Congress and dedicated to the collection, preservation, and public display of photos and audio in addition to videos and multimedia recordings related to government officials, agencies, and military actions both domestically and internationally. GovTracker shall serve as a public oversight tool enabling citizens to upload, share, and access photos and audio recordings as well as videos that document government activities, actions, and behaviors for the purpose of promoting transparency, accountability, and safeguarding against abuse or misconduct by government officials or entities, including law enforcement, military, and administrative agencies. The platform shall not censor or remove videos merely because they are objectionable or politically controversial but shall only remove content that demonstrably violates the law, including material inciting violence, constituting defamation with malicious intent, or containing illegal content, subject to a transparent and judicially accountable process. Off-topic or irrelevant material may be moderated solely to maintain coherence and usability of the public archive but shall not be arbitrarily removed or suppressed, and all removals shall subject to appeal in front of a jury whether through telepresence or in person. Every citizen shall have the right to upload videos, photographs, and other recordings of government actions, and all contributed material shall be publicly accessible, indexed, and searchable through structured metadata including time, location, and identities of government officials involved, to facilitate public review and civic analysis. The technological infrastructure of GovTracker shall employ open, standardized formats for digital preservation, consistent with the Library of Congress’s Recommended Formats Statement and archival best practices, to ensure enduring accessibility, authenticity, and verifiability of submitted materials across time. All files shall be redundantly stored in secure, distributed systems to prevent loss or tampering, and metadata shall be maintained transparently to ensure traceability and authenticity. Oversight of the platform shall rest with an independent board operating under the supervision of Congress and the Library of Congress, with all moderation and removal decisions publicly logged and subject to judicial review. The free exchange of information via GovTracker shall be protected as a form of expression under the right surrounding freedom of speech/communication and information, guaranteeing that the platform remains a protected venue for lawful exchange and government accountability. The Library of Congress shall oversee the archival and technical standards of GovTracker, ensuring that media formats, metadata schemas, and content indexing conform to the highest preservation and accessibility standards applied to public digital archives, thereby maintaining GovTracker as a permanent, publicly accountable record of governmental activity within and beyond the nation’s borders.

Congress shall have Power to establish, secure, regulate, and support an open, interoperable, privacy-preserving and anonymous, cryptographically verifiable, and resilient public-record and publication network for the preservation, authentication, dissemination, retrieval, and long-term availability of lawful writings, data, software, records, and expressions; to provide for their distributed storage, independent verification, and accessibility without dependence upon any single person, corporation, server, gateway, domain, or political subdivision; and to enact all laws necessary and proper to carry this Power into execution, consistent with the liberties secured by this Constitution. The Network shall be maintained as a public trust and open protocol, not as a proprietary platform. Its standards, core software, interfaces, and verification methods shall remain publicly documented, independently auditable, and capable of implementation by public authorities, private persons, enterprises, cooperatives, institutions, and communities. Congress may provide infrastructure directly, procure it from others, or recognize and coordinate voluntary independent providers; but no participant shall be divested of property, compelled to participate, or excluded from lawful competition except under generally applicable technical, security, and service standards. Congress may provide for cryptographically secured record identity, tamper-evident publication, versioned correction, distributed replication, and independently verifiable proofs that storage providers retain data and make it reasonably available over time. The Network shall be designed so that a published record may be authenticated without reliance upon a single host, and so that corrections, redactions, withdrawals of endorsement, and superseding records shall be made through new authenticated publications identifying the prior record, rather than through secret alteration of the historical record. Congress may establish fair and transparent incentives, fees, credits, endowments, public procurement, and other lawful means to compensate providers of storage, retrieval, gateway, verification, relay, and related services. Such measures shall encourage diversified and durable capacity, honest service, technical resilience, and reasonable access, without granting a monopoly to government, a corporation, or any private combination. Public infrastructure operated under this Power shall act as a fiduciary of the People, shall be administered transparently, and shall participate in and encourage any competitive exchange on terms that do not destroy or unfairly displace private enterprise. Not less than 5.55555555555 per centum of the storage capacity federally provided, procured, administered, or made available through the Network shall be reserved for the free or subsidized lawful use of the Citizens throughout the several States. Congress shall provide such reserved capacity through the Department of Goods and Services, or such successor department as law may establish, as a credit to each Citizen’s benefit account under proportional, transparent, non-discriminatory, and technically enforceable rules. That reservation shall be an irrevocable privilege of citizenship, shall be allocated at the point of scheduling or capacity assignment rather than by later accounting alone, and shall not prevent the open sale, lease, contribution, or exchange of additional storage and related services by private, cooperative, institutional, State, or federal participants. Congress may provide for privacy-preserving access and publication methods by which a person may read, retrieve, verify, or lawfully publish a record without routine disclosure of civil identity, reading history, location, persistent account identity, network address, payment history, or other un-necessary personal metadata. Congress may authorize reasonable, content-neutral measures to prevent fraud, abuse, congestion, duplicate claims, and destructive use of shared capacity, provided that such measures are narrowly adapted to technical necessity and do not create a general system of identification or de-anonymization, surveillance, prior restraint, or viewpoint discrimination. The storage, retrieval, gateway, search, indexing, and public-display functions of the Network may be technically and institutionally distinct. The permanence and integrity of an archived record shall not require its universal indexing, promotion, or public display; however, no official authority may secretly alter, falsify, or substitute a cryptographically authenticated record, nor delete or obstruct them without lawful purpose conformal to due process. Congress may establish transparent, reviewable, and lawful rules for official discovery services, public indexes, and government-operated gateways, consistent with freedom of expression, privacy, due process, and equal protection. Congress may coordinate interoperable technical, security, encryption, authentication, storage, service, and settlement standards among the several States and with foreign nations, provided that such standards remain open, auditable, and free from exclusive control by any single entity. The Network may interoperate with publicly or privately operated computing, storage, networking, encrypted-tunneling, and distributed-infrastructure systems, while preserving the autonomy of participating States, the voluntary character of private participation, and the right of persons to offer or obtain lawful services through free exchange. No person shall be compelled to identify themselves in order to read, verify, retrieve, or publish a lawful record through the Network. No law shall require the routine collection, analysis, retention, publication, or disclosure of a reader’s or publisher’s identity, location, reading history, communication metadata, financial history, network address, device information, or publication history as a condition of ordinary lawful use. No person shall be compelled to disclose cryptographic secrets, recovery phrases, private signing keys, or decryption keys except according to the constitutional protections governing private papers and effects. No public authority, gateway, storage provider, relay provider, or index operating under this Power shall impose viewpoint-based discrimination upon lawful expression. No person shall acquire a right, by use of the Network [alone], to publish another person’s private credentials, access keys, protected identifying information, intimate images, confidential records, or other unlawfully obtained personal data. No agency of government shall inspect, retain, condition access to, or disclose the content of private data or communications carried through the Network absent a warrant or lawful order issued according to due process of law. Congress shall exercise this Power as a duty to preserve the technological resilience, economic competitiveness, continuity of self-government, freedom of expression, security of private papers and effects, communication and expression, historical archival, voluntary exchange, and equal liberty of the People;

To establish a uniform Rule of Immigration and Naturalization; Congress shall institute an open, easy, and efficient process for immigration into Pacifica and procuring citizenship thereof; Congress shall implement a program, as part of the adjudication process for immigration benefits, to identify and bar Individuals seeking to enter Pacifica on a fraudulent basis with the intent to cause harm, who are at risk of causing harm subsequent to their admission. Immigrants must have a means to care for themselves for at least two years financially and the skills necessary to secure another job within six months; No person may immigrate to Pacifica who are Likely or Liable to become a Public Charge. All immigrants entering Pacifica shall be required to undergo screening for communicable diseases and checks into their possible criminal record for the equivalence to felony charges (in the least permissive jurisdiction within Pacifica). A conviction of illegal immigration permanently disables the ability of that Person to legally immigrate at a later time, unless the controversy occurred and was settled before their eighteenth birthday or foreign judgment of emancipation, in which case, upon their eighteenth birthday or such emancipation, and thereafter, they are restored the ability to apply for immigration to Pacifica. Persons seeking naturalization shall be required to answer a moderate difficulty quiz regarding an applicant’s understanding of Pacifica’s constitutional text and political processes, as well as testing their comprehension of the underlying aspects which underpin Pacifica’s system of government (Such as but not restricted to: Separation of powers, due process, dut[y]/ies to uphold natural rights, the electoral process, state sector versus private sector business, and duty of the people to resist tyranny), with a requirement to solve at least four-fifths of the questions to pass the entry civics exam, where translation/interpretation services shall be provided where needed [as appropriate and reasonably possible], and to be provided with educational materials upon request for such examination, at cost, or for free digitally on the internet, including practice exams;

All lawfully immigrating aliens seeking naturalization shall be required to undergo an ethnic Pacifican civics exam where they pass four-fifths of examination questions regarding the civil governing process and as to the Powers, Limitations, and Rights of the Government and the Pacifican People. Asylum seekers and refugees must engaging good faith efforts to seek work or training within three months and have a job within six months, unless they are physically or mentally disabled, or else they will face deportation back to their origin country, or, to some other country willing to accept them, in accordance with the principles set forth by this constitution. All migrants who are naturalized are restricted from receiving public welfare for a term of five years after their naturalization, but are not to be restrained from free public healthcare and free public education during such probationary period. Asylum seekers and refugees who do not naturalize are ineligible for public welfare, free public healthcare [beyond emergency care services, which shall be provided without discrimination], free public education, arming and equipping through the provisions of the States, and are expected to take care of themselves. Migrants entering Pacifica without using an official Port of Entry shall be assumed to be entering illegally, and be open to armed resistance by agents who are trained, uniformed and identified, accountable, and that use reasonable along with proportionate force, [under civilian oversight] to repel invasion by armed or violent individuals, or those participating in human trafficking and slavery, terrorism, and other egregious crimes. The People of each independent State are empowered to assist the national and state governments to prevent [an] [aggressive and overwhelming] ingress of illegal immigrants within Pacifica’s National borders, in accordance with the laws of Pacifica, both Constitutional and made in conformity underneath it. While on Pacifican soil, illegal immigrants interacting with members of government possess “the right to due process” including to presentament of an judicially-reviewed warrant, a jury trial, and the right to writs of habeas corpus, and all natural rights as well as all of any other constitutionally protected negative rights of the People within Pacifica (including human rights), with the exception of free ingress and regress throughout the borders of Pacifica and the several States, the several Territories, and numerous Localities, in addition to being barred from the receipt of Citizen-only services such as State-sector business-funded healthcare [except for emergency services] and education, and in the benefit of receiving privileges from Pacifica, the several States, Territories, or Localities.

The inviolability of the border in Pacifica is one of the very important foundations of our National Sovereignty and Peace, expressed under the will of our People, and must remain intact in a Nation of Laws, promoting Justice, and Protecting Ordered liberty, for ensuring the safety and happiness of our People. Those lawfully immigrating who require temporary lodging at the border may be provided shelter for the term of which their immigration is process of being approved, to be billed at cost for the services and resources provided to them after they have attained employment within Pacifica, and they may seek temporary government assistance for housing within Pacifica after their immigration is preliminarily approved while they seek employment, based on availability and funding. The Government of Pacifica is encouraged to strongly prosecute Illegal immigrants, and permanently bar their import, except for those who were minors below the age of legal culpability for a felony within Pacifica, who were brought by an adult, which minor was subsequently deported and later attained adulthood in a foreign country after their deportation, who then later lawfully applies for citizenship thereafter them having attained the Age of Majority. Deportations shall be focused firstly upon illegal aliens who commit serious crimes while within the borders of Pacifica and the several States, secondly upon those who commit minor offenses, and thirdly upon the remainder of unlawful migrants; those illegal aliens who are part of organized crime shall be prioritized before those who commit crimes of independent nature, but the most serious of crimes such as murder and rape shall be prioritized before moderate crimes such as organized smuggling or unauthorized drug production syndicates; the main purpose of enforcement action is to protect the rights of the People of Pacifica, and secondly for the convenience and improvement of each Citizen's good way of life.

To define the status of political asylum by law, and establish a Refugee Resettlement Program to admit foreign nationals into Pacifica. It is the policy of Pacifica to protect its citizens from foreign nationals who intend to commit terrorist attacks in Pacifica; and to prevent the admission of foreign nationals who intend to exploit Pacifica immigration laws for malevolent purposes, or to undermine the precepts of natural rights and just naturalism;

To define and punish Piracies and Felonies committed on the high Seas, and Offenses against the Law of Nations;

To declare War, grant Letters of Marque and Reprisal, and make Rules concerning Captures on Land and Water as well as determine the limits on emergency powers delegated to the president; Pacifica shall not go to war except in self-defense, and permanently renounces wars or acts of military aggression; Congress shall not declare war, without the concurrence of two-thirds of the Senators and Representatives present in each House;

To ensure the military branch shall accept Persons of suitable condition to be received into the armed service of Pacifica to garrison forts, positions, stations, and other places, and to man vessels of all sorts in said service;

To raise and support Armies, but no Appropriation of Money to that Use shall be for a longer Term than two Years;

To provide and maintain a Navy;

To provide and maintain an Air Force and Space Force;

To make Rules for the Governing and Regulation of the land, naval, air and space Forces;

To provide for organizing, arming, and disciplining, the Militia, and for governing such Part of them as may be employed in the Service of Pacifica, excepting governance in cases where the militia may engage in martial law against failures to ratify budgets or other criminal elements of the government in Congress, reserving to the States respectively, the Appointment of the Officers, and the Authority of training the Militia according to the discipline prescribed by Congress, and excepting governance in cases where the militia may engage in martial law against failures to ratify budgets or other criminal elements of the government in a specific State or States;

To inaugurate and provide for an extensive system of National Militia Supply Depots and Armories, to have their keys be held by merit of local elections, by no less than two but no more than five People in each area nearest to their installation, known as the keepers of the keys, to be made known to the Clerk of the Town and/or County Hall of their presence, and be made available to all the People near them Pledged in Loyalty and Defense for their State or Territory in the event of a Military invasion or attack. The keepers of the keys, upon their discretion, may bring a guest or guests in order to sample and inspect the supplies and gear for shelf-stability, function, and “lot rot”; Cycle weapons at the firing range to ensure their proper function; Sample food, drink, and alcohol ingredients and rations for taste-stability and spoilage;-And to ensure the silo remains secure and operational in time of peace for a potential time of war;

To provide for calling forth the Militia to execute the Laws of the Union, suppress [Unjust] Insurrections, and repel Invasions;

When a large number of members are killed or incapacitated, temporary replacements shall be made immediately, to fill vacant seats and to stand in for incapacitated members. Temporary appointments, in cases of both vacancies and death, shall be selected from a succession list drawn up in advance by the member who holds the seat, or, if no such appointment/s shall be made, be made by Gubernors. In the case of incapacitated members, replacements shall stand in for the incapacitated member until the member recovers, the member dies and the vacancy is filled, or until the end of the term. Congress may provide by law for the additional details, if any, of the temporary appointment procedure in legislation. Any accompanying legislation should contain the following: 1) exactly when the procedure for the emergency method of temporary appointments shall begin and end; 2) the qualifications of the temporary replacements; 3) the method of appointment; 4) limitations on the length of service of the temporary appointees.

To establish a Department of National Security to serve as a ministry of internal affairs;

Congress shall establish a Federal Investigative Service, operating under the Executive Branch Police Powers with the authority to investigate and arrest individuals or groups suspected of interstate and Federal crimes, in accordance with the enumerated powers of congress and the due process rights of the defendants and their potential victims/s Congress shall appoint a Head of the FIS (Federal Investigative Service) for a non-renewable term of six years, which Head of the Federal Investigative Service[s] shall appoint or remove FIS agents/officers operating beneath them in rank. The Head of the Federal Investigative Service may remove agents/officers at any time; Congress may overturn appointments and removals of agents/officers in the Federal Department of Investigations. The law enforcement mission of the Secret Service is "The mission of Pacifica’s federal investigative service shall be to defend the natural rights and liberties of the People, preserving ordered liberty and justice in accordance with natural law, common law, and the constitutional compact"; The Investigative Law Enforcement Purpose is to arrest individuals for inter-jurisdictional and Federal level crimes, which are not being managed by the Secret Service of Pacifica;

Congress shall establish a Secret Service operating under the Department of Homeland Security; Congress shall appoint a Head of the Secret service for a non-renewable term of six years, which Head of the Secret Service shall appoint or remove Secret Service agents/officers operating beneath them in rank. The Head of Secret Service may remove agents/officers at any time; Congress may overturn appointments and removals of agents/officers in the Secret Service. The protective mission of the Secret Service is to ensure the safety of both Federal, Territorial, State, or Local members of the Legislative, Executive, and Judicial branches, their immediate families, former presidents, their spouses, and their minor kids under the age of sixteen, major candidates and their spouses, and foreign heads of state; The protective mission includes protective operations to coordinate manpower and logistics with state and local law enforcement, protective advances to conduct site and venue assessments for protectees, and protective intelligence to investigate all manners of threats made against protectees; The investigative mission of the Secret Service is to safeguard the payment and financial systems of Pacifica from a wide range of financial and electronic-based crimes. Financial investigations include counterfeit Pacifica securities, legal tender, coin, and bills of credit, bank & financial institution fraud, mail fraud, wire fraud, illicit financing operations, and major conspiracies; Electronic investigations include Cybercrime, network intrusions, identity theft, access device fraud, credit card fraud, and Intellectual monopoly crimes;

To establish a Extraterrestrial/Exobiological Intelligence Recovery and Relations Agency (shortened as EIRRA) for astrobiological entities and drones or probes visiting Earth from foreign worlds or interdimensional substrate, and to establish transparency through disclosure with the General Public regarding all unidentified anomalous phenomena and transmedium objects/craft as well as encounters with off-planet non-human intelligence in addition to communication with off-world intelligence, and to investigate and also make active pursuit of recovering crashed objects of interest to this agency and biological or non-biological entities where possible, and announcing all discoveries why the agency to the General Public, as well as disclose all past, present, and Future interactions with uap's and foreign high-level non-human intelligence, in addition to publicly announcing the status of diplomatic relations between Pacificans and alien life-forms along with UAP storage and potential reverse-engineering and research developments, making active attempts to detect and communicate with off-world intelligence, so long as such operations do not violate the 'prime directive' of Pacifica, which governs interplanetary and transdimensional relations between Pacifica and foreign or non-terrestrial life-forms by somehow interfering with their development. The agency is obligated to maintain peace between Pacifica and extraterrestrials and other worldly non-human intelligence [and their machines];

To exercise exclusive Legislation in all Cases whatsoever, over such District (not exceeding an area consistent with the base of a square being twenty-four kilometers) as may, by Secession of particular States, and the Acceptance of Congress, become the Seat of the Government of Pacifica, and to exercise like Authority over all Places purchased by the Consent of the Legislature of the State in which the Same shall have previously been, for the Erection of Forts, Magazines, Arsenals, dock-Yards and other needful Buildings. The [Federal] District shall be named Olympus;

Congress shall have power to prescribe the terms of removal of Individuals holding offices created by specific statute, and requiring the consent of the Senate for appointments, including standards of good behavior for judges, but the President or other executive officers shall have power to remove officers they have the exclusive authority to appoint for positions for which there is no specific term of service;

To secure the equal right to the exercise of all common rights;

To maintain the equality of all citizens before the laws;

To establish a general system of Criminal Jurisprudence and of Pacifican Civil Law, and Departments for each;

Congress may provide Courts for the several Territories;

To constitute Tribunals inferior to the supreme Court;

Congress shall have power to make all laws which shall be necessary and proper to secure to the citizens of each State all privileges and immunities of citizens in any other of the several States, and to all Persons in each State equal protection in the rights of Life and Health, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and freedom to secure others] and Self-defense [and freedom to defend others], Privacy, Property, and the pursuit of Happiness;

Congress shall have power to enact statutes to punish official misconduct, including the violation of the rights, privileges, or immunities of any Person, abuse of discretion, violation of any oath or affirmation, dereliction of duty, failure to supervise, or conduct unbecoming;

To establish a Department of Reformatory and Criminal Labor;

To make all Laws which shall be necessary and proper for rehabilitating criminal code offenders by the Government of Pacifica or any Department or Officer thereof;

To recognize the Secession of States;-And

To make only those Laws which shall be necessary and proper for carrying into Execution the foregoing Powers, and all other Powers vested by this Constitution in the Government of Pacifica, or in any Department or Officer thereof, but all laws passed by Congress shall expire within twelve years after being passed.

Congress shall erect no Compan[y]/ies of Merchants or Cartel/s with exclusive advantages of commerce.

Congress shall have power, on territory under its exclusive jurisdiction, and State legislatures, on territory under their exclusive jurisdiction, at their discretion, to forbid weapons within penal facilities, courthouses, and government offices, provided that they provide for a secure system for checking in weapons on entry, and return them to the owner upon leaving, and in such case, they are required by law, under penalty of life imprisonment without the possibility of parole, to guarantee the safety of [all] Persons within against all injury they might be able to avoid by having the means to defend themselves or others, being liable for any injuries or deaths that may befall those disarmed in accordance with such potential prohibition.

Congress shall have the power of eminent domain only on territory for which it has exclusive jurisdiction, and State legislatures only on exclusively state territory. State legislatures must consent to Congress taking by eminent domain any parcels within their territory. No taking by either Congress or a State legislature shall be for any purpose other than public use for a period of at least eighteen years.

The Congress are empowered to lease or purchase land from states who consensually enter agreement, and the congress may additionally sell that same land back to the State/s or Citizens of Pacifica at another time, and may produce homestead rules and release land to citizens for their own personal use to own and pass on again and again in the course of their [the Citizen’s] and their family’s lives, through inheritance as an heirloom, except if no relative whether by blood or marriage is available for designation through will, then upon the death of the owner, it shall be auctioned at State sale to another Citizen as a standard piece of real estate, through the Treasury or State banks. Households will be limited to one homestead, but there is no limit to how many households in a family may stake and obtain a stead. The land which the Federal government owns may be designated as national park or refuge, or, as a commercial parcel for operations under the department of Goods and Services, or for any other purpose consistent with the Powers conferred to Congress, but it may not be used to expand the boundaries or add territory to the Federal District of Olympus. Land designated for national parks shall be controlled by the bureau of Forest and Land Management. Land intended for governmental industry and commerce under the Department of Goods and Services, and Land for sale shall be held by the treasury of Pacifica.

The power to establish, maintain, and regulate national networking infrastructure to serve the public interests of the People and their several levels of government shall be explicitly divided among the Federal, Territorial, State, and Local sectors. This division of authority shall be defined by this Constitution to ensure that each level of government may develop, operate, and secure networking infrastructure as necessary to execute its constitutional powers and promote the public interest of State Security. No level of government shall monopolize or unduly restrict access to networking infrastructure necessary for the execution of the foregoing powers or the protection of public interests, except as required for legitimate security purposes and as defined under this Constitution. The right of the people to form their own network infrastructure and operate businesses for the same purpose shall be respected through law.

The power to establish, maintain, and regulate Public energy infrastructure to serve the public interests of the People and their several levels of government shall be explicitly divided among the Federal, Territorial, State, and Local sectors. This division of authority shall be defined by this Constitution to ensure that each level of government may develop, operate, and secure energy infrastructure as necessary to execute its constitutional powers and promote the public interest of State Security. No level of government shall monopolize or unduly restrict access to energy infrastructure necessary for the execution of the foregoing powers or the protection of public interests, except as required for legitimate security purposes and as defined under this Constitution. The right of the people to form their own energy infrastructure and operate businesses for the same purpose shall be respected through law.

Congress may not enact a law unless it pertains to only one subject. Congress is prohibited from putting anything in a bill that is not mentioned or contained within the title of the bill.

Congress shall have power to authorize officials of Pacifica to execute court orders.

Congress has power to authorize itself or committees of itself to operate as a grand jury for the investigation of public matters, including the issuance of subpoenas, and to authorize courts to enforce its subpoenas and orders to provide information.

Congress shall have authority to criminally punish fraud only when committed on the territory of Pacifica over which it has exclusive jurisdiction.

Congress shall have power to prescribe the penalty for contumacy, but no judge shall have power to punish by fine, imprisonment, or other penalty, other than by incarceration for a period not to exceed seven days per court session, without conviction by a jury in a trial in which another judge shall preside.

Congress shall establish a target population for Pacifica for the purpose of assuring a high standard of living and quality of life for its citizens. The target population shall not be higher than can be continuously sustained by proven reserves of domestic natural resources utilizing existing technology, or by trading such excess resources for others not available domestically. Also, the target population of Pacifica shall be below the level that, if applied globally, is determined by science to pose no threat to the global environment. The Congress shall establish immigration quotas consistent with achieving the target population. The Congress shall also enact policies that, while leaving People free to choose the size of their families, encourage the population to move toward and stabilize at the established target level. The target population shall be reviewed by Congress annually and shall be retained or adjusted as necessary.

The Department of Defense budget cannot exceed the total of all of the States’ public education funding.

The power to raise an army, navy, or other military force, and militia, is only to hire volunteers, not to conscript the unwilling. Congress shall make no law requiring service in the army, navy, the militia, or any civil service.

No soldier shall be enlisted for any longer term than four years, except in time of war, and then for no longer term than the continuance of the war. A soldier may re-enlist of their own conscience.

The People of Pacifica shall enjoy the right of safety from terrorist attack. To enforce this provision, Congress shall have the power to establish special military courts solely for the prosecution of Persons accused of terrorist acts.

Congress shall have power to punish for disclosure of state secrets properly so designated by a court of competent jurisdiction, but it shall also have power to punish the concealment of official misconduct under the guise of state secrecy.

That each year every member of Congress shall spend at least one consecutive day and night in a standard cell inside a randomly selected Federal prison that is located inside their State.

Congress shall not make any law that applies to the Citizens of Pacifica that does not apply equally to the Members of the Federal government; and, Congress shall make no law that applies to Members of the Federal government that does not apply equally to the citizens of Pacifica.

Should any member of congress step down, a Supplementary Election shall be held within thirty days.

Congress shall have the power to regulate by law the filling of vacancies that may occur in the House of Representatives and Senate in the event that one-fourth or greater number of the members of either the House of Representatives or the Senate are killed or incapacitated. Congress shall allow the Gubernor or the legislature of each state to appoint temporary replacement senators and representatives. Within ninety days of the event that one-fourth or greater number of the members of either the House of Representatives or the Senate are incapacitated or killed, a special election shall take place to replace them. A member that has been incapacitated may reclaim their office at any time after such member determines that they are no longer incapacitated. All appointments of both the House and Senate shall expire automatically after the special election is held.

Congress shall not alter, modify or interfere in the times, places, or manner of holding elections for Senators and Representatives or either of them, except when the legislature of any State shall neglect, refuse, or be disabled by invasion, attack, or unjust rebellion to prescribe the same.

Congress shall have the power to regulate matters that are in the national interest, but federal enactments shall pre-empt State law only in instances of direct conflict, or where the preemptive force of such enactment is made explicit by statute, or is based on a considered finding by an agency to whom Congress has delegated the authority to make such determination.

The Congress shall promote the welfare of the [whole] People by acting to secure equal economic opportunity [irregardless of outcome] for all.

Congress shall have power to regulate or prohibit substances or actions which are likely to cause resource degradation or depletion or injury to People, animals, or the environment, across State, territorial, or national borders, but not those confined within the borders of a State or territory.

Congress shall have power to grant conditional supplemental assistance to State budgets for use in programs that the Federal Department deems of Public Need, Mutual Benefit, and Appropriate to remedy a malady, such as supporting State wildlife preservation and welfare programs.

Congress may not require any State or Local official, or private Person, of Pacifica, to expend any resources without providing such resources, or make the provision of resources conditional on performing actions Congress does not have the power to command, except for militia organization, training, and operations, or for specific performance on a voluntary contract.

Congress shall not have power within non-State territory in excess of powers provided to the legislature by the constitutions of at least three-fourths of the states, being those that delegate the least power to their governments on the same subjects.

Congress shall have exclusive legislative jurisdiction over coastal waters from the 4.848 kilometers out to 22.224 kilometers, and over airspace at or above one-half of a kilometer above the highest terrain features, including the power to regulate the movement of vehicles/craft through such territory. States shall have jurisdiction for land above the low-tide mark out to a distance of 4.848 kilometers into the sea, and airspace below one-half kilometer above the highest terrain features. Terrain features include but are not limited to buildings and natural entities like trees and rocks.

Congress shall have exclusive legislative jurisdiction over the allocation of broadcast bands for inter-jurisdictional radio wireless transmissions as well as single-conductor/single-wire and radiant wireless transmissions whose configuration and energy level are excessive enough to which they can potentially or will cause a measurable/demonstrable amount of damage to Persons, Animals, Property, or to the environment (except those which are confined [through measurability] entirely within a state); The lawful purpose for regulations and licensing of equipment at levels beyond those which may potentially or will cause a measurable/demonstrable amount of damage to Persons, Animals, Property, or to the environment, shall extend only to those reasons, and NOT to seek the prevention of interference with, or inconvenience caused by, neighboring equipment, nor to serve as a mechanism to regulate or restrict in any other way, the speech or other content of the transmissions, including of encrypted audio, data, and other information; They shall have the power to designate specific and limited sections of the radio spectrum for transmission of emergency services, and punish transmitting violators operating in these restricted bands if damage or injury results due to their interference.

Congress shall not have power to disable a right or penalize any person on the basis of an administrative or due process proceeding in another jurisdiction, or lack thereof, or an administrative or due process proceeding in the same jurisdiction that does not explicitly disable the right as part of the final order of the court, upon conviction by a jury for a crime or a unanimous jury verdict finding dangerous incompetence.

Congress shall pass no law, rule, regulation or ordinance that applies to Pacificans or lawful aliens residing legally in Pacifica that does NOT also apply in equal measure to MEMBERS of Congress and/or their families.

Congress members MAY contribute to personal, individual retirement accounts from which they may draw upon retirement, but no treasury funds shall be used to provide lifetime retirement for any member of either House of Congress under ANY circumstances beyond what has been authorized and contributed to by the People’s allocation through the treasury to their and their Congressperson’s State Social Security system plus normal interest.

Congress SHALL PASS NO LAW regulating the ownership oruse, nor ordering the confiscation, or destruction, of any just weapon, ammunition, munition, any armor of defense, or attachments and accessories, or any of the like thereof.

Any law by which Congress delegates rulemaking to the Executive Branch must automatically expire after two years, unless Congress sets an earlier expiration date.

There shall be provided for sunset provisions on federal agencies and programs, similar to the Texas sunset provisions. This means that agencies and programs are reviewed periodically to ensure they are still meeting the needs of the people, and that any improvements can be made so that the agencies and programs get better over time. Some programs would be reviewed every twelve years (12 annum) or so, and some would require review every legislative session. Without re-approval by the legislature, the agency or program shall be abolished.

Every bill enacted by Congress shall expire by default at two (2) years after enactment, not to exceed ten (10) years by specification otherwise, unless re-enacted, or, sooner repealed, or unless it is constitutionally mandated.

All legislation created shall require it only surround a single-subject within it/them.

Those provisions which declare that Congress shall not exercise certain powers be not interpreted in any manner whatsoever to extend the powers of Congress. But that they may be construed either as making exceptions to the specified powers where this shall be the case, or otherwise as inserted merely for greater caution.

They should be vested with the authority to make all Laws which shall be necessary and proper for carrying into Execution the foregoing Powers, and all other Powers vested by this Constitution in the Government of Pacifica, or in any Department or Officer thereof.

SECTION. 11.

Congress shall establish an Agency of Disease Control and Prevention (ADCP):

To develop national standards for diagnosing diseases;

To serve as a diagnostic testing laboratory, and for providing research into eradicating infectious diseases/pathogens;

To co-ordinate operations with State Medical facilities for testing, quarantine, and treatment of infectious diseases/pathogens;

To publish and disseminate scientifically rigorous public health information of interstate significance that enables policy-makers, researchers and practitioners to be more effective; it aims to improve health, particularly among disadvantaged populations;

To disseminate accurate and honest public news on the State of Epidemic, Pandemic, and Endemic diseases/pathogens

To act as a directing and coordinating authority on public interstate work towards health through disease/pathogen prevention and control, to promote research, along with ensure valid and productive technical cooperation towards developing cures for known and future diseases/pathogens;

To act as the directing and coordinating authority on public interstate health work;

To promote technical cooperation among public entities;

To assist State Governments, upon request, in strengthening health services;

To furnish appropriate public technical assistance, and in emergencies, necessary aid, upon the request or acceptance of the State and Local Governments of Pacifica;

To make recommendations for public/state protocols to reduce the risks of contracting and spreading communicable diseases/pathogens which may be voluntarily used by consenting Individuals on a basis consistent with their conscience and personal conviction, and leaves them free to choose their own course of action. Congress and their advisors upon legislative consent of the Congress and/or “[we] the People’s” (constitutionally restrained) just authority, may provide non-binding advice to the People on how to prevent the spread of communicable diseases/pathogens, and provide legally-non-binding recommendations/advice to sectors of the population, industry, and commerce, which they believe may assist or achieve this end;

To stimulate and advance public work on the prevention and control of epidemic, pandemic, endemic, and other diseases/pathogens;

To promote and coordinate public biomedical and health services research;

To promote improved standards of teaching and training in the health, medical, and related public professions;

To establish interstate, and stimulate the establishment of intrastate, standards for public biological, pharmaceutical, and similar products, and to standardize public diagnostic procedures;

To work in conjunction with Public medical professionals of the several States upon their consent to propose conventions, agreements, and regulations, and make recommendations, about interstate nomenclature of diseases/pathogens, causes of death, and best public health practices;

To develop, establish, and promote interstate standards concerning disease reducing and treating: foods, herbs, fungi, and bacteria, as well as, vitamins, minerals, ‘nutraceutical’, biological, pharmaceutical, and similar substances, as well as requiring the reporting on all adverse events regarding any of these compounds, which shall be extended to include but not be limited to vaccines and gene therapies;

To Prevent both communicable as well as non-communicable diseases/pathogens in all willingfully participating Citizens and the People of Pacifica and the several states and Territories of, and visitors within, Pacifica;

To direct and coordinate interstate public health efforts between States;

The Agency for Disease Control and Prevention collaborates to create the expertise, information, and tools that people and communities need to protect their health through health promotion, prevention of diseases/pathogens along with injury and disability caused by such diseases/pathogens, and preparedness for new health threats;

The Agency for Disease Control and Prevention is intended to be a non-political and bound to informed voluntary consent wing of Congress, and which has the principle aim and duty to defend the lives and health of Pacificans by remaining scientifically objective, truthfully/honest, and impartial in the dissemination of information; in addition to conferring as much protective and assisting benefit as is reasonably possible, not conferring aid by special circumstance;

Their main areas of work are improving public health systems; as well as health throughout the course of life of Citizens in addition to the People of Pacifica; prevention and protective capacity in/for noncommunicable and communicable diseases; preparedness, surveillance of viral evolution, and mediated response to outbreaks; and supply deployment services to Public agencies, as well as the General Public (being “the People” at large). It is the responsibility of the Agency of Disease Control and Prevention to assess all available data for quality of studies and research samples, create meta-analytical abstracts, and make recommendations out of integrity (with a willingness to admit fault/s and flaws if present, based upon it and in line with the current state of science;

They may perform:
Voluntarist infectiousness testing in conjunction to infection status testing;
[Revocable] Consent-based antibody or cell immunity quantification testing for those who have cleared the disease;
Revocable Consent-based Anonymized data based on municipality for the past and current people who tested positive for the disease;
Funding for public-domain safety studies for traditional, attenuated full body dead’-viral body, replication-incompetent chimera vaccines, (‘ADL-protectant’) viral protein, mRNA, iDNA, and other types of immunological antibody inducing or facilitating protein or gene therapy, publishing their dangers, and to further furnish open-source information on the state of the art public research on vaccine risks and benefits with in depth breakdown of science linked in a wiki on the government website for the agency, including on vaccine driven viral evolution;
Funding for open-source public research and development of traditional, attenuated full body dead’-viral body, replication-incompetent chimera vaccines, by meritable/highly-qualified public and/or private scientific and medical institutions and businesses, as so far is subordinate to the will of Sovereign Persons and due course of just naturalistic principals;
Funding for public development of anti-viral and viro-cidal agents as well as antibiotics and disinfectants by States for their Universal Basic Healthcare deployment, and equally by private chemists;
and
Funding for public vaccine analysis and quantification, safety and efficacy testing, double-blind placebo-compared controlled experiments and studies, and provide Public disclosure of all side effects and their incident rate and predicting factors.

There shall be no mandatory/forced/coerced/compelled contact tracing, though the government has power to perform contact tracing on known infected individuals, so long as meaningful consent is obtained, for the purposes of preventing the further spread of contagious highly injurious or deadly disease. In addition to this, no contact tracing technological systems or programs to adapt existing technology for contact tracing shall be implemented.

SECTION. 11.5.

Sub-Section. 1.

Within the Agency for Disease Control and Prevention shall be established a Pandemic Preparedness Planning Unit, with the responsibilities:

To establish interstate public protocols for dealing with natural outbreaks and biological weapon attacks;

To provide suggestions to congress for regulations surrounding the development and deployment of vaccines by the Public instrument and Private market;

To suggest to and draft biotech regulations for the Congress, for the purpose of preventing the proliferation of weaponizable [and already weaponized] gene sequences, genetic material, and organisms;

To offer non-binding advise to the president and the Gubernors in each state on the best course of action in the event of a national epidemic as well as a global pandemic;

To develop open-source diagnostic methods and tools, as well as treatments for diseases/pathogens including but not limited to [scalable] vaccines and gene therapies, which shall undergo rigorous safety studies before being made available to the public, except for those Individuals who desire experimental medical treatment and who waive all liability on the behalf of the designers, manufacturers, prescribers, furnishers, and administerers of such methods, tools, and treatments;

To aid in coordinating responses to outbreaks of contagious diseases/pathogens, within the limits of the law under the precept of civil government having the primary responsibility of securing the People’s (as Individuals) unalienable natural rights;

To develop and distribute testing kits for communicable diseases/pathogens to the Public sector medical services of the several States, and, upon their discretion, provide for, at an equal exchange, Private sector medical services of first the several States, and then to the world. The People are entitled by this constitution to be first priority to receive testing kits and medical services, and without with-holding or discrimination;

To quickly lab test mailed in and field collected samples for communicable diseases/pathogens upon request from the Public sector medical services of the Several States, and upon their discretion, from the private sector as well, to determine the [whole] genetic sequence of pathogen/disease in identified positive test samples which were lawfully collected, with both the capacity to serve the entire country’s testing and sequencing needs in a national emergency, and to openly publish the results for such tests and sequences after anonymization (for privacy);

To provide free, timely, and accurate laboratory testing for disease/pathogen presence, transmissibility evaluations, and immunity testing with metrics beyond anti-bodies, on volunteering Persons residing within Pacifica for communicable diseases/pathogens, but to not force Individuals to submit to such a test for any reason;

To develop and distribute fast and easy testing self-testing kits for communicable diseases/pathogens, immunity beyond anti-bodies, and transmissibility evaluation, to the People of Pacifica, and develop a [non-mandatory] self-reporting system to assist in the accurate statistic keeping for Pacifica of the persons infected with communicable diseases/pathogens;

To provide for the sequencing of infections to track disease sources and mutations/evolution;

To collect and publish data on outbreaks within Pacifica, through anonymously compiled lists on the number of affected People and their general locations in the community, labeled with the name of the communicable disease/pathogen;

To test off the shelf medicine for effectiveness in treating infectious diseases/pathogens;

To develop, test, manufacture, and stockpile the kinds of suitable protective and treatment gear, equipment, supplies, and resources that Pacifican medical professionals and the citizens of Pacifica will need;

To mobilize resources for those in quarantine and for those undergoing treatment at their homes and State hospitals within the several States, including but not limited to protective gear, Immune-boosting supplementation kits, virocidal as well as bactericidal and fungicidal selective agents, anti-viral as well as anti-biotic and anti-fungal medications, anti-body plasma, mono-clonal antibodies, vaccines, therapeutics, et cetera...;

To deploy medical services upon the individual request of each State;

To dispense financial assistance to States for retrofitting or building new systems and amenities and maintaining such systems, amenities, for controlling in order to reduce the spread of communicable;

To distribute necessary medical treatments and equipment to States without prejudice, prioritizing for those of greatest clinical need;

To establish emergency medical treatment facilities for Pandemics and epidemics with surge capacity, which shall operate upon the explicit voluntary consent with their patients;

To Nationally produce the required essential medical equipment, through the Federal Department of Goods and Services, and freely distribute that equipment to each State’s Public sector medical facilities proportionately according to population;

To incorporate State Security agenda to protect the people from communicable diseases/pathogens;

To provide transparent reporting of and response to outbreaks as a policy;

To investigate into the origins of diseases/pathogens, routes of transmission, methods of protection against serious disease outcomes, Public education in the prevention of disease (as backed by scientific research and data), precautionary measures against [unknown] future threats; and developing treatments for such diseases/pathogens (including therapeutics, vaccines, anti-body infusions, protectants, and immune boosting agents);

To provide immunity level testing in addition to testing for disease;

To tailor clean, safe, effective, and fully disclosed vaccine boosters targeting dominant variants as they arise, in a timely manner;

To provide funding to States for mail delivery medicine for accessibility restricted, elderly, and exigent circumstances, like communities stricken by outbreaks of communicable disease. Tele-medicine will also be offered as an option for clients who feel more comfortable with suitable doctor’s checkups from the home;

To assist in the prevention and control of diseases through accurate education;

Genome sequencing of all epidemic, Pandemic, and Endemic pathogen (disease causing) with permission of the infected patient (consent based); And

To provide fully-voluntary quarantine facilities with surge capacity.

Sub-Section. 2.

Recognizing the fundamental right of individuals to life, liberty, and property, and the necessity for transparent, decentralized, and voluntary systems to ensure community survival in the face of catastrophic events, the following amendments are proposed to the Constitution. These amendments are informed by the principles of individual sovereignty, skepticism of centralized authority, and the imperative for public accountability, as championed by libertarian thinkers and independent media;

The Decentralized Federal Disaster Response and Management Unit, or "FDRMU", shall exist solely to coordinate, not monopolize or impose, disaster response, ensuring that private citizens, local communities, and voluntary associations retain the primary role in relief and preparedness.

All strategic reserves (food, fuel, medical supplies, NBC equipment) must be transparently inventoried and their locations published, ensuring public oversight and preventing government hoarding or misuse.

The FDRMU shall not infringe upon the right of private citizens or organizations to maintain independent reserves or to provide disaster relief.

Strategic reserves of food, fuel, medical supplies, and NBC (nuclear, biological, chemical) equipment shall be maintained in distributed, publicly accessible depots-never centralized under exclusive federal government control, but distributed among the several States.

All citizens, regardless of government or private status, shall have equal access to these reserves during declared emergencies, with transparent, publicly broadcast criteria for distribution.

Any attempt to restrict access based on political affiliation, bio-metric identification, prior conviction, or social credit systems is expressly forbidden.

Nuclear fallout shelters, equipped for nuclear, radiological, chemical, biological, and "zombie" pandemic scenarios, shall be constructed within walkable distance for all population centers, guided by early detection system coverage. Each shelter must include, but are not limited to: NBC equipment for every occupant; weapons and ammunition or equivalent; Independent water supply and recycling systems; Redundant power generation (solar, wind, backup generators); Food stores sufficient for at least six months per shelter occupant, capacity-rated and publicly posted; Numbered personal lockers for each citizen, unlinked to identity, to preserve privacy and prevent government tracking.

Spare clothing for each occupant, suitable for 1-2 years of use, recognizing that citizens may have no time to gather belongings in an emergency.

Shelters and stockpiles are to be managed by local volunteer committees, with regular public audits and livestreamed video feeds of inventory and conditions.

Recognizing the risks of solar cycles and regional seismic threats, strategic food and fuel reserves shall be maintained specifically for grand solar minimum scenarios and the Pacifica Subduction Zone, with at least two weeks of supplies per resident as recommended by emergency management professionals.

These reserves shall be located outside known floodplains and seismic liquefaction zones, with public maps and open access for inspection.

National stockpiles of wildfire-fighting equipment, filters, and synthetic air generation supplies shall be maintained and distributed equitably to both public agencies and private citizens.

A central, open-access government database shall track all reported wildfires, their current status, and include real-time webcam footage wherever available, ensuring radical transparency and public participation in disaster monitoring.

All disaster reporting (earthquake, solar flare, tsunami, hurricane, flooding, blizzard, volcano, et cetera) shall be open to public uploads and citizen science, with the FDRMU operating a network of sensors and weather stations whose data is freely accessible online.

The FDRMU must publicly broadcast, via free-to-air networks and internet streaming, all current disaster alerts and space weather predictions, ensuring no paywalls or censorship impede public access to life-saving information.

The system must be designed to empower local response and voluntary mutual aid, not to centralize control or restrict information flow.

No disaster, emergency, or force majeure event shall be used as a pretext to suspend the Bill of Rights, including but not limited to the First, Second, and Fourth Amendments.

The right to free speech, assembly, and to bear arms shall remain inviolable, and all disaster response activities must be subject to public scrutiny, independent media coverage, and civilian oversight.

All disaster preparedness and response programs must be opt-in at the community and individual level, with no compulsory participation or forced evacuation unless imminent and direct threat to life is proven by clear and convincing evidence.

Local communities shall have the right to manage their own disaster resources and protocols, with federal units acting only in a coordinating and supporting role, never as a command authority.

All contracts, expenditures, and resource allocations related to disaster preparedness and response must be published in real time, with blockchain-based public ledgers for maximum transparency.

Whistleblowers and independent investigators must be protected and empowered to report any misuse, fraud, or abuse within the FDRMU or related agencies.

No citizen shall be required to submit bio-metric data, digital identification, or participate in any government database as a condition for accessing disaster shelters, supplies, or aid.

Distribution systems must be designed to protect privacy and prevent the emergence of centralized control grids, activity logging, or surveillance infrastructure.

The FDRMU shall honor that: "In a free society, disaster resilience is built on voluntary cooperation, radical transparency, and the unyielding protection of individual rights. The government's only legitimate role is to facilitate-not control-the means by which free people secure their own survival."

SECTION. 12.

War is the most grievous failure of diplomacy and the gravest threat to liberty. No just nation shall pursue war for conquest, preemption, coercion, or prestige. Pacifica, as a society founded upon the principles of voluntary association, self-defense, and rightful liberty, declares these Rules of War in order to constrain the horrors of armed conflict, preserve our peace, and defend our people against true aggression.

Sub-Section 1: General Provisions

1.1 Anti-War Doctrine

Pacifica shall not engage in war except: In direct response to an actual invasion, armed attack, or unambiguous act of war against its sovereign territory, people, or legally recognized allies under mutual defense treaties;-And in defense of innocent lives under immediate threat when no peaceful recourse remains.

1.2 Strike-Second Policy

Pacifica shall adopt a strike-second doctrine: It shall never initiate hostilities, including preemptive strikes, assassinations, blockades, or cyberattacks.

It shall only respond to acts of war that are: Clearly attributable; Overt and material; Representing an imminent or actual threat to life, liberty, or territory.

Sub-Section 2: Just Cause and Legitimate Authority

2.1 Just Cause

War may only be waged when:

There has been an unlawful use of force or coercion by another party;

The sovereignty, lives, or rights of Pacifican persons are violated or placed in immediate danger;

All non-violent remedies have been exhausted or are clearly futile.

2.2 Legitimate Authority

Only the Pacifican Federal Assembly, via supermajority and public referendum, may declare war.

No executive or military body shall act unilaterally.

The people must be informed and their consent required in all declarations of war.

Sub-Section 3: Conduct of War

3.1 Proportionality and Necessity

Force used in retaliation shall be strictly proportional to the threat posed.

All military actions must be necessary, never punitive, vengeful, or ideological.

Destruction beyond defensive aims is forbidden.

3.2 Distinction and Non-Aggression

Civilians, non-combatants, and neutral persons shall never be targeted.

Weapons and tactics must be discriminating, capable of avoiding indiscriminate harm.

Nuclear, chemical, radiological, and biological weapons are forbidden.

3.3 Termination and Peace

War shall end immediately when the threat subsides.

No occupation, conquest, or extraction shall occur.

Peace must be pursued at all reasonable opportunities, with no demand for tribute or regime change.

SECTION 4: Forbidden Wars

Pacifica shall never enter a war for: Empire, expansion, or territorial gain; Preemption or speculative threats; Ideological crusades; Economic sanctions, resource acquisition, or trade enforcement; Allied entanglements not consented to by referendum; Civil war, unless secessionists violate the natural rights of others.

Sub-Section 5: Moral Duties in Wartime

5.1 Rights of Conscience

No person shall be compelled to bear arms against their conscience.

Conscientious objection shall be respected in both civil and military contexts.

5.2 Rights of the Enemy

Captured combatants shall be treated humanely and with due process.

Surrendering or incapacitated forces may not be harmed.

Prisoners of war shall have the right to communication, fair treatment, and repatriation when hostilities cease.

Sub-Section 6: Civil and Digital Warfare

6.1 Cyber Retaliation

Cyber operations may only be conducted if they are: Directly proportional, In response to cyberattacks causing material harm, Attributable to a hostile foreign entity, Fully reversible and non-lethal wherever possible.

6.2 Civil Defense

All persons have a right to aid in civil defense if the homeland is attacked.

The Militia of Sovereign Persons, as authorized in the Constitution, shall be mobilized only for defense.

Sub-Section 7: Restoration of Peace and Liberty

At war’s end, full civil rights must be restored without prejudice to former combatants.
