Each State shall establish a Department of Research and Development for Science, Engineering, and Technology, to organize and facilitate the governmental activities into laboratory programs that may be limited by the People, which include but are not limited to: Nano-scale research as well as science and technology development, including research on chemicals/molecules and materials which themselves may be radioactive, as well as science and technology development surrounding these areas; Hardware, Programming, and Software research, as well as engineering and technology development surrounding these areas; Information, Learning, and Specific or General Artificial Intelligence research, theory, and technology development; Vehicle/craft and robotic/drone research, as well as engineering and technology development; Developing a unified theory of everything (with the intention of being used in Pacifican governmental physically realistic simulations within hardware and software), with the final product being named “M-Theory”, which shall stand for “Merger Theory”, depending on whether or not it has been worked out in completion in one go, where all other variations worked out before that which may be merged, being named by their dimensionhoods, compositions, and classification/s, in the logical organization of wSExYEyTzS [base_energy_composition] {medium_composition] [theory_classification](if available), or, W[Space-space]X[time-energy]Y[time]Z[space], along with the name/s of the composition of base energy, as well as the name/s of the composition of the medium, and the name/s of the classification of the theory (if available);

Each State shall establish and maintain a Department of Open-Source Projects and Information, to reasonably support upon request, fund, create, manage, and maintain open-source projects and informative materials of interest for use by the government and general public, upon the discretion of the people, and maintain a public repository of open-source information;

Each State shall establish a Department of Public Broadcasting, responsible for administering recorded and live analog and digital radio and radiant broadcasts, analog and digital television broadcasts, and streaming internet programs both radio and audio-visual, augmented with accessibility and translation capabilities, with the intention of spreading impartial/un-biased, objective, accurate, and non-deceptive public information, including but not limited to Local, State, National, and Global weather and news, general information about history with occasional deep-dives in weekly blocks, as well as to articulating current research by researchers, scientific theories as well as [current (meaning past and present)] reports on the state of scientific discovery and progress by scientists, engineering projects and feats by engineers, [current (meaning past and present)] state as well as development of technology, and futurist predictions by credible [and legitmiate] authorities in a given field, information about and recommendations for open-source projects for viewers to investigate as well as hardware and software for them to use and/or own, general and weapon design, safety, as well as self defense training and weapons disarming and explosive diffusing and propper disposal courses, in addition to public safety and emergency announcements;-and community generated programs from the People, such but not limited to News, Documentries, and Informational or Educdational Broadcasts, with local ads run at scheduled break times for up to eight minutes each hour. Each State will hold all funds collected for the Department of Public Broadcasting in a secure non-divertible trust fund. The Department of Public Broadcasting will work with inter-agency and inter-state departments as deemed reasonable and mutually agreeable by the legislature of each state. The right of People to establish private broadcasting and informational services is guaranteed;

Each State shall establish a Department of Public Education, responsible for administering programs that deal with education, Public information events, and libraries. The Department of Public Education shall be in charge of enforcing educational freedom and autonomy, pupil, and parent’s rights protective law as well as providing for regulation and funding to the programs that it administers. Each State shall not divert funds towards the Department of Public Education, and will hold all funds collected for Public Education programs and services in a secure non-divertible trust fund;

Each State shall establish, at its sole discretion and through the wide latitude of its legislature or the direct initiative and referendum power of its people, a consensual, opt-in system of universal basic childcare, available without compulsion to any parent, guardian, custodian, or next-of-kin who is working, disabled, or engaged in another reasonable life-necessity activity, subsidized at a percentage and through a funding mechanism the state itself determines from constitutionally permissible, non-compulsory revenue sources such as voluntary contributions, Department of Goods and Services proceeds, or state-enterprise profits, consistent with Pacifica's abolition of general taxation; this system shall operate under precisely the same health, safety, and rights-protective regulatory standards that govern private, cooperative, mutual-aid, and other non-public childcare providers, so that public and private providers remain equally regulated with neither preferential treatment nor monopoly, and the people of each state retain the full and continuing authority to establish, patronize, or alter such childcare arrangements, public or private, and to amend the governing regulations at any time by legislative act or initiative, to meet the actual needs and aspirations they hold for their children and posterity; administration shall be delegated to the county level wherever practicable, under rules designed to maximize the rights of parents and children, protect the rights of childcare workers, and respect the rights of the general public; parental authority over a child's upbringing, education, medical care, and custody, including the right to decline the public option or select any lawful alternative without penalty or differential treatment, shall remain fully preserved and unimpaired as a fiduciary trust exercised for the child's own inherent rights; care shall emphasize outdoor and sensory experience, free play, storytelling, and practical skill-building over screen-mediated or highly structured institutional regimens; supplemental support beyond the baseline shall be available upon sincere demonstration of need for children with significant special needs or complex family circumstances, without displacing parental authority or the child's dignity; and Congress shall exercise no power over any such system beyond verifying, through general law of uniform application, that each state meets a minimum baseline of adequacy, without prescribing curriculum, staffing, funding, or administrative structure;

Each State shall establish a Department of Public Labor, to administer a Worker Program for the purposes of alleviating joblessness due to old age, un-employment, illness, and disability, and for hiring Individuals and Families of zero-to-low income, for those People’s benefit. Public sector Jobs are guaranteed for all those whom are eligible, from their State’s Department of Public Labor; each State shall guarantee rational and effective terms of employment for the Persons working through them; Each State will be responsible for furnishing the types of jobs that match the capabilities and capacities of those working under them. The jobs provided by the State will be granted for limited times as a means to get People on their feet while they [are assisted in a] search for a suitable fit in employment from the Private sector, and they are encouraged to immediately accept opportunities to transfer out to a proper job in the Private sector. Workers under the Department’s Program are free to quit their job with the State at any time, but will be required to wait a period of six months before re-applying for State employment. Each State will hold a proportion of funds collected from the work done for the purpose of distributing paychecks to the workers, held in a secure non-divertable trust fund, only accessible for the purposes of low-risk investing for gains in the fund, and for distributing wages to Citizens working under the program;

Each State shall establish welfare programs and services for Individuals and Families of zero-to-low income and those experiencing homelessness or housing insecurity, who are Citizens of Pacifica and Residents of that State. Each State will hold all funds collected for welfare programs and services in a secure non-divertible trust fund, only accessible for the purposes of low-risk investing for gains in the fund and as a Treasury fund for distributing welfare benefits to eligible Individuals. Each County shall receive a portion of the funds based on the number of Citizens in need within that County, and distribute them upon need to municipalities, in order to provide for twenty-four hour (24-hour) homeless/unsheltered service shelters, with which shall [at baseline] furnish food [including but not limited to {common} pet food], clean drinking water, microwave for heating water and food, bathrooms, showers, laundry service, clothes [including but not limited to jackets/coats, hats, and gloves], shoes and boots, bedding [including but not limited to seasonally-appropriate sleeping bags and wool blankets], tents, tarps, rope/cordage, tape/adhesive, tire patches, locks and security items such as chains or proximity/trip alarms, trash bags, batteries and chargers or wall adapters, backpacks, flashlights and camp lamps, hand carts, electricity access, telephone access, computer access, internet access, paper printing, mail service, temporary secure item storage, bus passes, gift cards, writing supplies and stamps, medical supplies, hygiene supplies, and sleeping spaces. Every Citizen of the several States shall have the inherent irrevocable privilege to a basic standard of living, secured through voluntary as well as decentralized means wherever practicable, at a baseline sufficient to ensure access to nutritious food and clean water, adequate shelter, clothing and bedding, hygiene supplies, essential private healthcare, transportation, and the means to participate fully in civil society; To uphold this right, the Legislature of each State shall establish and maintain a system guaranteeing an [unconditional] [phased] basic income sufficient to meet essential living needs, funded transparently through revenues generated by the Department of Goods and Services in their state, as well as administered with respect for individual choice, personal privacy, and with minimal bureaucratic intrusion, to supply progressively-tiered negative income bracketed approach to supply funds to Citizens making up to the mean income level. No Clause of this Provision shall be construed to compel any person to accept income or services against their will, nor shall any private property be taken or any person be compelled/coerced for this purpose except as authorized by this constitution or consensually upon just compensation and in accordance with due process of law. Each State shall also provide for subsidization of existing housing options and also provide for readily-accessible comfortable [non-gentrified] low-income and affordable rent-to-own housing projects that cost no more than thirty-percent of an individual's income [before, at, and after retirement], adjusted based on their ability to pay. The funding, administration, and adjustment of this system shall be governed by principles of fiscal responsibility, local autonomy, and free enterprise; States and Communities may supplement and administer additional forms of voluntary support consistent with this Provision. Each State shall have the power to enforce and implement this Provision through appropriate legislation, provided that no law enacted under this Provision shall infringe upon the natural liberty, self-ownership, or voluntary economic association of any person;

Each State shall have the authority and responsibility to establish and administer, through their respective State Banks or other designated public financial institutions, programs providing subsidized financing for the acquisition of land and the purchase, construction, or placement of semi-permanent or permanent housing for individuals receiving public assistance on the basis of a medically or legally determined disability reasonably expected to persist for the duration of such individual’s lifetime; eligibility for such programs shall require the existence of a bona fide plan for human habitation in a structure not constituting a temporary shelter, and specifically excluding tarps, tents, and lean-tos; such programs shall provide a subsidy not exceeding thirty-five percent of the total cost of the property, inclusive of land where applicable, and shall further provide access to loan financing for the remaining balance, subject to underwriting standards established by State law, provided that no such loan shall exceed fifty percent of the recipient’s projected income over a term not exceeding thirty years, or sixty percent over a term not exceeding twenty years, nor work the crime of usury against the beneficiary; for purposes of this Provision, qualifying housing shall include, without limitation, manufactured homes, trailers, recreational vehicles, watercraft, airplanes, spacecraft, or other mobile or stationary structures equipped with internal accommodations suitable for sleeping, food preparation, sanitation, and ordinary daily living activities, as well as sheds, container homes, tiny homes, and traditional residential dwellings, equipped with standard facilities and capacities, or beyond; such loans may be refinanced, modified, or otherwise administered in accordance with laws enacted by the legislature of each State; and the purpose of this Provision shall be to expand access to property ownership and secure housing for individuals receiving public assistance with permanent disabilities, by enabling pathways to independent living beyond rental or public housing systems while preserving individual autonomy in location and form of habitation.

Each State shall establish and maintain open-access resource libraries stocked with tools, equipment, materials, and productive goods, distributed across regions and localities under subsidiarity, enabling every sovereign person to freely select, use, and thereafter permanently acquire full private ownership of such items as their eternal personal property without cost, lease, or surrender, affirming enduring individual dominion over appropriated resources while preventing enclosure of commons, proletarianization, or dependency. These libraries shall prioritize renewable, sustainable, open-source technologies and post-scarcity production goals via the State Department of Goods and Services’ autonomous public enterprises, ensuring widespread access to means of self-sufficiency without infringing natural rights, imposing coercion, taxation, or State control over Private title. Legislation enacted in conformity herewith may regulate operations tiered to scale, and also accept goods which are donated upon disuse for recycling or reassignment, in favor of distributist equity anchored in self-ownership, non-aggression, and Just Naturalism;

Each State within the Commonwealth of Pacifica, at the discretion of their populace, shall appropriate funds to municipalities and local jurisdictions for the purpose of sustaining civic, charitable, and nonprofit institutions engaged in providing essential support to persons in conditions of hardship, including but not limited to the homeless and unsheltered, the impoverished, the elderly, veterans, and individuals bearing physical or intellectual disabilities as well as debilitating mental disorders, in order to ensure their access to nourishment, shelter, clothing, and other basic necessities consistent with human dignity. In addition to diners and food pantries, there should also be made access to any other additional public resources for the impoverished and vulnerable as directed by the people at the most local level possible to the aid received. Any such institution or organization receiving public assistance under this provision shall operate as a body for public benefit and shall be bound to apply not less than four-fifths of all monies received, whether originating from public appropriation or private contribution, exclusively to the direct relief and advancement of those in need, with no more than one-fifth of such funds being eligible for administrative, managerial, or employee compensation. The administration and oversight of these funds shall be conducted in an open, accountable, and locally participatory manner, reflecting the principle that collective welfare must arise through voluntary cooperation and community stewardship rather than centralized dependency. States and municipalities shall preserve, within the execution of such charitable functions, the autonomy of local communities and the sovereign rights of individuals, ensuring that assistance respects the personal freedom, moral agency, and productive capacity of each recipient. In distributing funds and grants pursuant to this social responsibility, preference shall be given to organizations that demonstrate transparency, self-governance, and equitable use of resources, particularly where such entities contribute to the long-term empowerment, education, and self-sufficiency of beneficiaries. The States may establish reasonable standards and reporting requirements to verify compliance with the expenditure limitations and ethical directives herein, provided that such regulation shall not infringe upon the voluntary nature or decentralized character of participating charities. No part of this Provision shall be construed to permit the accumulation or exercise of disproportionate economic or political power by any private party or public organ under the guise of charity, nor shall it authorize compulsory association or coercive distribution beyond that reasonably necessary for the preservation of life, dignity, and welfare among the inhabitants of Pacifica. The intent of this Provision is to affirm that compassion, freely organized and locally administered, forms a legitimate expression of justice in a republic of sovereign persons, integrating individual liberty with social duty in a balanced and enduring order;

Each State shall establish a voluntary Reunification Assistance Program to provide transportation and transitional support to individuals experiencing homelessness or unshelteredness who demonstrate a verifiable personal connection with family members, friends, or responsible parties willing to receive and support them in securing stable [long-term] housing. Eligible individuals must consent to participation, undergo a basic background screening to address public safety concerns and to ensure that participants are not fugitives from Justice within Pacifica, as well as verify the willingness and capacity of their receiving party through direct communication prior to assistance. The program shall include case management services to facilitate travel arrangements, provide reasonable stipends for food and incidentals during transit, and conduct follow-up evaluations within thirty and ninety days to monitor rehousing stability and well-being. Resources shall prioritize empowering personal autonomy and re-establishing existing social support networks while preventing coerced displacement or punitive relocation. No individual shall be involuntarily transported nor deprived of access to local shelters and services without due process protections. The program shall be designed and administered transparently and subject to periodic independent review by a board and open into investigation by the People to ensure transparency and accountability, harm reduction, along with respect for individual dignity. Ultimately, the People of Pacifica recognize that addressing homelessness and the unsheltered requires both the restoration of community ties and investment in systemic housing solutions while protecting individual liberty, choice, and paths towards private property acquisition and ownership (E.g. rent-to-own);

Each State shall establish a Citizen Safety and Defense Education as well as an Arming and Equipping Program. The program will freely provide for Safety, Defense, and Arms training by military personnel, and at the State’s or it’s Citizen’s discretion, may freely and equally periodically provide Arms and Supplies/Equipment [of the Citizen’s {reasonable} choice] or an equivalent voucher for such Arm/s and Supplies/Equipment to Adult Class Residents of their State who are also Citizens of Pacifica, except under which disqualifications of an Individual’s current legal/criminal status that the Legislature of their State or the Citizens of that State shall deem appropriate for the interest of safeguarding the wellbeing of the People in their State, or as may be otherwise provided under this Constitution, and may be utilized to supply and equip them and/or their/”the People’s” armed forces service depos/armories from time to time with any needful [tactical] tools and supplies deemed suitable for their survival and travels; Upon their first time completing the free militia training they shall be entitled to take home a suitable weapon for State defense and Personal use that same day; Part of their equipping periodically shall also be to be supplied with pallets stocked with six-months worth of supplies (Federal Disaster Response and Management Unit federal money also goes into this program, spent by the state according to their regional autonomy) or it's cash equivalent every five-point-three-bar years; When they are distributed, it shall be communicated to the recipient, by the Citizen Armament and Equipping personell, through speech or other appropriate means to the releasee upon the moment of their release, these words, “You have received a set of benefitial supplies for which you are due, and may do as you will with them, as they are now part of your Property”. The purpose of this program is effectively guaranteeing a baseline level of defensive readiness and disaster preparedness for our people;

Each State shall establish and maintain a comprehensive, publicly accessible Property Registry for all real property within Pacifica, including all States, territories, counties, municipalities, and the Federal District, and the Registry shall constitute an official source of public notice concerning the status, ownership, possession, control, boundaries, access, and declared conditions of every parcel of Public or Private property; each parcel entry shall include, at minimum, a standardized map depicting boundaries and recognized points of ingress for lawful public purposes, including delivery of mail, service of official notice, execution of lawful warrants, surveying, and any other constitutionally permitted process; the name of the registered owner and, where applicable, lawful controller or agent, together with reasonable contact information sufficient for notice; a scanned or otherwise authenticated copy of the title or equivalent instrument of ownership; the official address or legal description of the parcel; the classification of the parcel as developed or undeveloped; purchase and sale information, including prior ownership history to the extent maintained by law; and any recorded legal notices affecting the parcel, including trespass declarations, surveys, liens, foreclosures, governmental repossession, or other constitutionally permissible encumbrances; because property exists under the Lockean proviso as a stewardship that must not be used to exclude others from necessities through mere hoarding, speculation, or vacancy, the Registry shall also record whether the property is vacant, underutilized, abandoned, or held in a manner subject to homestead, adverse possession, or squatting laws enacted consistently with this Constitution, and the Registry shall note any public claim, adverse claim, or legal challenge thereto; the owner or lawful controller may submit binding instructions concerning the parcel, including no-entry directives, permission requirements, designated areas where public entrance, congregation, or camping is permitted, and any other lawful command concerning access or use, and such declarations shall have the force of recorded public notice when filed in the Registry; the Registry shall provide a public comment function for each parcel, because public notice is incomplete unless the People may record lawful observations, objections, and informational comments regarding land use, condition, accessibility, nuisance, abandonment, encroachment, or other matters of communal concern, provided that all comments shall be governed by law to protect privacy, reputation, due process, and security, and the Registry shall not authorize defamation, harassment, unlawful disclosure, or the compelled revelation of protected information; the Registry shall indicate the presence of gates, fences, barriers, obstructions, defensive deterrents, booby traps, mines, or similar devices, but shall not require disclosure of their precise location, quantity, or capability, because public notice requires warning of danger while the Lockean security of ownership and the right of defense forbid compelled tactical disclosure beyond what is necessary for safety and lawful process; the Registry shall be the official source of property notice throughout Pacifica and may be indexed, analyzed, and republished by external tools, including artificial intelligence, for any lawful purpose, including squatter inquiry and lawful speculation, because the public character of recorded land information is part of the legal architecture by which title, boundary, and possession are made knowable to all; the Registry shall be maintained in a searchable digital format accessible to the public without unreasonable restriction, shall be downloadable in standardized formats, and shall also be reproducible in printed, offline, and non-digital versions, with the ability to submit comments, filings, and requests through equivalent means for persons who do not use digital systems, at cost of filing and reproduction only; the Registry shall not require any information beyond that expressly authorized by this Section or otherwise permitted by this Constitution, and all recorded and displayed data shall be limited to what is reasonably necessary for notice, boundary definition, public accountability, lawful access, and the prevention of wasteful exclusion from scarce land and shelter; and the Legislature of Pacifica and the several States shall have concurrent power to enact and enforce laws implementing this Section, to define the procedures for recording, contesting, correcting, and challenging entries, and to set penalties for falsification, concealment, unlawful obstruction of access to the Registry, or the intentional withholding of required notices.

Each State shall establish a Bureau of Forest and Land Management, to regulate and manage the use of public land. The mission of the Department of Forest and Land Management is “to sustain the health, diversity, and productivity of the public lands for the use and enjoyment of present and future generations.”. The Bureau of Forest and Land Management shall open a division to deal with providing land for homesteading and public resources for homesteaders to establish their own off-grid/self-sustenance living solutions. The Legislature of each State are empowered to lease or purchase land from counties who consensually enter agreement, and the State Legislature may additionally sell that same land back to the County/ies or People of their State at another time, and may produce homestead filing and equipping programme rules in conformity to this constitution, and release land titles/patents to citizens for their own personal use to own and pass on again and again in the course of their [the Citizen’s] and their family’s lives, through inheritance as an heirloom, except if no relative whether by blood or marriage is available for designation through will, then upon the death of the owner, it shall be auctioned at State sale to another Citizen as a standard piece of real estate, through the Treasury or State banks. Households will be limited to one homestead, but there is no limit to how many households in a family may stake and obtain a stead. The land which the State government owns may be designated as State park or refuge, or, as a commercial parcel for operations under the department of Goods and Services, or for any other purpose consistent with the Powers conferred to the State Legislature, but it may not be used to expand the boundaries or add territory to the Capitol District of Pacifica. Land designated for State parks shall be controlled by the Department of Forest and Land Management land intended for governmental industry and commerce under the Department of Goods and Services, and Land for sale shall be held by the treasury of Pacifica;

Each State shall establish a Department of Agriculture and Farming, responsible for assisting in the co-operative development with the State Legislature, and executing the State laws related to farming and agriculture, horticulture and forestry, and food. The Department of Agriculture and Farming aims to meet the needs of farmers and ranchers, promote agricultural and livestock trade and production, work to assure food and cultivated drug safety, protect natural resources, foster rural communities, and to end hunger in their State;

Each State shall establish a Food and Drug Administration to reduce preventable harm from products that people cannot [reasonably] be expected evaluate for themselves, while allowing beneficial products to reach the market. The Administration shall protect the general public against adulterated, misbranded, contaminated, deceptively marketed, poisonous, deleterious, or un-lawfully marketed articles, and shall make impartial health and nutrition information available to the public in clear, layperson-accessible language. The Administration shall regulate, inspect, test, label, certify, and monitor water, food, drink, dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, drugs, biologics, medical devices, tobacco products, cosmetics, and other substance-based therapies, enhancements, augmentations, and materials intended to contact such products. Its authority shall include products manufactured, sold, offered for sale, transported, imported, distributed, or marketed within theit State. No person shall manufacture, prepare, pack, hold, sell, offer for sale, transport, distribute, import, or market an adulterated or misbranded food, drink, drug, biologic, supplement, therapeutic product, or other regulated article. An article shall be deemed adulterated when, among other things, its strength, quality, purity, identity, composition, or safety falls below an applicable legal, scientific, or publicly disclosed standard; it contains a poisonous, deleterious, contaminated, filthy, putrid, decomposed, diseased, or otherwise injurious substance; a valuable constituent has been wholly or partly removed; an inferior, cheaper, substituted, undisclosed, or harmful substance has been added; its appearance, quality, value, safety, or composition is concealed or falsely enhanced through coloring, coating, polishing, processing, packaging, or another deceptive practice; or it has been produced, packed, stored, or transported under conditions that may render it contaminated, unsafe, impure, or otherwise unfit for its represented use. An article shall be deemed misbranded when its label, packaging, advertisement, marketing, labeling, instructions, identity, composition, origin, quantity, quality, strength, purity, intended use, risk, or other material representation is false, misleading, incomplete in a materially deceptive manner, or likely to mislead a reasonable person. A product sold as another product, an imitation presented without clear disclosure, or a product represented as meeting a standard it does not meet shall be misbranded. All labels for drugs, biologics, supplements, nutraceuticals, and other regulated therapeutic substances shall plainly disclose the identity and quantity or concentration of each active ingredient, the material inactive ingredients, applicable warnings and contraindications, directions for safe use, lot or batch identification, manufacturer or responsible distributor, and such other information as is reasonably necessary for informed consumer and professional decision-making. Where a product is represented as conforming to an official compendium, pharmacopeia, monograph, formula, or declared standard, it shall meet the stated standard of strength, quality, and purity. No person shall knowingly or recklessly represent, directly or indirectly, that a product diagnoses, prevents, treats, cures, mitigates, or heals a disease, condition, or symptom unless that representation is supported by sufficient competent evidence appropriate to the claim. No person shall intentionally place, cause to be placed, or distribute false or fraudulent therapeutic claims on product labeling, packaging, or accompanying promotional material. For prescription drugs, biologics, and higher-risk medical devices, the Administration shall require sufficient evidence that the reasonably anticipated benefits outweigh the reasonably foreseeable risks for each intended use before the product may be marketed. The Administration shall also oversee manufacturing quality, purity, labeling, advertising and health claims, adverse-event reporting, recalls, and post-market safety monitoring. The Administration may inspect facilities and records; collect and test samples; require corrective labeling, warnings, disclosures, or reformulation; issue public safety notices; suspend, restrict, seize, embargo, recall, or prohibit regulated articles; and refer knowing or serious violations for civil or criminal enforcement. Its enforcement actions shall be proportionate, evidence-based, publicly accountable, and subject to due process. All medical, nutritional, safety, ingredient, contaminant, manufacturing, and adverse-event information required to be disclosed under this Provision shall be made freely available to the general public in understandable language, while protecting legitimate personal privacy and narrowly defined proprietary information that is not necessary to assess safety, identity, quality, or lawful marketing. This Provision shall be construed to guarantee that every regulated product is [generally] safe, effective, and ethically desirable; The purpose of this Provision is to establish transparent and enforceable standards of identity, strength, quality, purity, labeling, truthful representation, and risk disclosure, so that the general public is protected from [objectively] [and agreeably] un-reasonable and preventable harm.

Each State shall provide addiction treatment as part of Standard offerings under the Universal [single-payer, free] Basic Care system in each [relevant] jurisdiction, which shall always remain optional and revocably consensual to the recipient, and the law shall make way for using intervention versus arrest for violations of the law by those using drugs in Public when they are restricted or prohibited in certain conditions according to Time, Place, and Manner criteria set by the Legislature of such Jurisdiction, in conformity to this Constitution. States shall implement oversight and outcome reporting mechanisms to evaluate efficacy, ethical compliance, and recovery success, while maintaining coordination among local health authorities, hospitals, and community-based organizations to advance prevention, harm reduction, and reintegration. Telehealth and in-person services shall be accessible to all regions, urban and rural alike, fulfilling the State’s obligation to provide a unified, compassionate, flexible, and effective framework for addressing substance abuse as a matter of public health and human dignity, not a criminal mentality or act;

Each State shall ensure the preservation of public health, individual autonomy, and equitable access to essential care by establishing and funding, through its municipalities, a system of publicly accessible sexual and reproductive health clinics operating on a low-barrier, walk-in basis, which shall provide comprehensive services including diagnostic testing and treatment for transmissible conditions, preventative screenings, contraception and fertility services, pregnancy testing and consultation, evidence-based education, distribution of protective and harm-reduction materials, nutritional and vitality guidance, and forensic examination with coordinated support pathways for victims of sexual harm; such clinics shall operate under principles of anonymity where practicable, neutrality toward all persons regardless of sexual preference or status, and accessibility inclusive of extended hours, mobile outreach, multilingual services, and integration with mental health and social support systems, and shall be justified under the inherent authority and obligation of the State to protect public welfare, reduce systemic health burdens, prevent the spread of communicable conditions, mitigate avoidable suffering and long-term cost, and ensure that all persons, including those facing heightened exposure to risk due to instability of resources, environment, or continuity of care, have practical and immediate access to preventative, educational, and remedial health services necessary for individual and collective well-being.

Each State shall establish a Bureau of Poisons, Toxins, and Hazardous materials, responsible for enforcing regulations, labeling, and control of access to poisons, toxins, and hazardous materials, in regard to macro-, micro-, and nano-scale substances possessed and used by Individuals, research organizations, scientific and medical institutions, and commercial entities, in access, use, manufacturing, trading, and purchasing or sales of such materials;-And to enforce restrictions on their use, for the purpose of protecting life, health, and general autonomy of the People/Androids, Animals/Robots, and the Environment/Nature;

Each State shall establish Statewide programs and centers for re-cycling along with waste management facilities, for glass, metal, paper, plastic, electronics, compost, and other wastes. The right of People to establish private re-cycling and waste management services is guaranteed;

Each State shall establish an Environmental Quality and Protection Agency, to maintain the government’s responsibilities to the earth in protecting the rights of nature and the habitability of the planet;

Each State shall establish a Nuclear Regulatory Commission, to enforce strict regulations established by the State Legislature; to control access to radioactive matter; to regulate the access, use, manufacture, trade, and purchasing or sale of radioactive matter by Individuals, research organizations, scientific and medical institutions, and commercial entities; and to enforce restrictions on their use;

Each State shall establish a Bureau of Biological and Chemical Agents, to strictly regulate and control access to biological and chemical agents, to be made available to Individuals, research organizations, scientific and medical institutions, and commercial entities, to access, use, manufacture, trade, and buy or sell biological and chemical agents and their precursors; and enforce restrictions on their use which were lawfully enacted through the legislature of said State;

Each State shall erect a Department of Housing and Urban Development to be established with the sole authority to set and enforce clear, evidence-based limits on the presence of known toxins and carcinogens, such as formaldehyde and flame-retardant, in all forms of shelter, including temporary lodging such as travel trailers and motor homes. Such regulation shall be narrowly tailored to protect the fundamental right to establish and maintain a safe home, and shall not unduly restrict property rights, freedom of contract, or the availability of affordable housing. Standards shall be based on the best available science and focus only on substances proven to pose significant health risks at commonly encountered levels. All enforcement actions must respect due process and property rights, and shall be subject to judicial review. The Department may not expand its authority beyond regulating harmful toxins and carcinogens within shelter. Nothing in this provision shall be construed to permit broader regulation of housing or shelter beyond what is necessary to prevent direct, substantial harm from known toxins or carcinogens;

Each State shall establish an Agency for Workplace Safety, with the sole authority to set and enforce clear, evidence-based standards to protect individuals from significant, demonstrable risks to life and health in all workplaces and work settings. All regulations and enforcement actions by this agency must be narrowly tailored to address only those hazards proven to cause substantial harm, and shall not unduly infringe upon property rights, contract freedom, or the right to earn a living. The agency shall operate transparently, respect due process, and provide for prompt judicial review of its actions. No regulation shall be adopted or enforced unless it is necessary to prevent direct, material injury to workers. Nothing in this provision shall be construed to permit arbitrary or excessive regulation of workplaces, nor to restrict voluntary risk-taking by informed individuals in their chosen employment;

Each State shall establish a Department of Reformatory and Criminal Labor;

Each State possesses inherent responsibility and the dominion to institute, sustain, plus oversee an exhaustive, gratis communal juridical referral mechanism, attainable by citizens across wealth spectrums, from opulent patrons to destitute supplicants, spanning exhaustive legal realms like penal advocacy, tortious proceedings, domestic relations, estate planning, impairment claims, alongside niche adjudicative pursuits; such apparatus incorporates stratified matching protocols attuned to fiscal standings: gratuitous counsel for paupers, tempered charges for average earners, complete fees for elites; coupled with interactive directories permitting attorneys to survey obscured petitioner requisites, fostering reciprocal linkages between justice claimants plus legal tenders, wherein contact information plus locales transmit solely toward vetted recipients post-consensual clearance, orchestrated via unified electronic gateways, telephone hotlines, urgent sorting for crises akin to incarceration threats or shelter losses; States exercise sovereign legislative powers encompassing enactment, operation, budgetary sourcing from intrinsic coffers, professional dues, charitable streams, barring national fiscal burdens, plus attorney induction through reputational scrutiny, moral pledges, efficacy audits safeguarding integrity plus promptness. Congress holds affirmative authority to compel State fidelity herein, via statutory minima, incentivized disbursements, courtroom compulsions like writs of mandate, disciplinary measures against delinquent commonwealths, thereby enshrining equitable remedial passage as citizenship’s indelible entitlement, fortifying governance’s essence against caprice while channeling justice to the common man/woman/kid;

In each County with every District of each State, an election for an office of sheriffs shall take place every two years, where each Sheriff shall appoint their Deputies, with a term of two years and a limit of four terms per Sheriff and four terms per Deputy, to guard and protect as well as serve the Constitution and the People , to serve warrants and place arrests, to enforce the laws of each State, and to serve as Warden to inmates. Each State shall provide funds to their respective district sheriff offices. It is the duty of sheriffs and their deputies to defend the People and the Constitution of Pacifica, as well as of their State in conformity therewith. Sheriffs and their Deputies are public servants and shall serve as officers of the law. Their badges shall symbolically consist of five-point stars enclosing the seal of their county and name of their agency, for they are servants composed from the People and equal to them in law;

Each State respectively shall have the power to provide for organizing, arming and disciplining its own Militia, whensoever Congress shall omit or neglect to provide for the same. That the Militia shall not be subject to Martial law, except when in actual service, shall be subject only to such fines, penalties and punishments as shall be directed or inflicted by the laws of its own State;

Each State may provide non-binding advice to the People on how to prevent the spread of communicable diseases/pathogens, and provide non-binding recommendations to sectors of the population, industry, and commerce which they believe may assist or achieve this end;

Each State shall have exclusive legislative jurisdiction over the allocation of broadcast bands for intra-jurisdictional (which shall mean those which are confined [through measurability] entirely within a State, but not those which are immeasurable from a Public area or by another sub-State, such as those confined entirely within a single sub-State jurisdiction) radio wireless transmissions as well as single-conductor/single-wire and radiant wireless transmissions whose configuration and energy level are excessive enough to which they can potentially or will cause a measurable/demonstrable amount of damage to Persons, Animals, Property, or to the environment; The lawful purpose for regulations and licensing of equipment at levels beyond those which may potentially or will cause a measurable/demonstrable amount of damage to Persons, Animals, Property, or to the environment, shall enxtend only to those reasons, and NOT to seek the prevention of interference with, or inconvenience caused by, neighboring equipment, nor to serve as a mechanism to regulate or restrict in any other way, the speech or other content of the transmissions, including of encrypted audio, data, and other information; They shall have the power to designate specific and limited sections of the radio spectrum for transmission of emergency services, and punish transmitting violators operating in these restricted bands if damage or injury results due to their interference.

SECTION. 5.

Each year every member of the State legislature shall spend at least one consecutive day and night in a standard cell inside a randomly selected State prison that is located inside their State.

No State shall make any law that applies to the citizens in their State that does not apply equally to the Members of the government in their State.

SECTION. 6.

The State legislatures are empowered to veto the Federal legislature. If the legislatures of two-thirds of the states pass resolutions against a federal law, the federal law shall be sent back to Congress and require a two-thirds vote of Congress to make it law again. Any provision of law or regulation of Pacifica may be repealed by the several States. If three-fourths of the several States' legislatires approve resolutions for this purpose that particularly describe the same provision or provisions of law or regulation to be repealed, then the law shall be repealed, and Congress cannot resurrect it (although they could pass a different law and try again later). There should be at least one year before a federal law goes into effect, in which time two-thirds or three-fourths of the states can act to prevent the law from going into effect or remaining. No government entity or official may take any action to enforce a provision of federal law after it is abrogated according to this provision. Any action to enforce a provision of abrogated federal law may be enjoined by a Federal, Territorial, State, or Local court of general jurisdiction in the State where the enforcement action occurs, and costs and attorney fees of such injunction shall be awarded against the entity or official attempting to enforce the abrogated provision. States have automatic standing anytime they challenge a Federal law, Executive Order, Presidential decree, policy, et cetera…, in any Federal Court, up to and including the Supreme Court. Also, states will have the right, again with automatic standing, to challenge any Supreme Court decision, directly to the Supreme Court; States shall have the ability to challenge any law they disagree with, without waiting for harm to occur, to them or their citizens; The Challenge may be either to vacate or modify the original decision; Other States are allowed to join the challenge, for or against; there should be a time limit between Challenges, such as the first Challenge should be possible immediately, but after a Challenge is settled, a new Challenge should at least wait for the next session of the Legislature. The purpose of this power is to prevent special interests from getting laws through Congress that the population does not actually agree with.

SECTION. 7.

The Gubernor shall serve as head of the executive branch of each State. The powers, duties, and responsibilities of the Gubernor shall be prescribed by the constitution of their State.

The Gubernor may mobilize and direct the State Guarde or defense force and/or the militia in response to state emergencies, invasion, attack, unjust rebellion, or insurrection.

SECTION. 8.

There shall be established, within the States of Pacifica, a unified [Pacifican] State Guarde ([C]SG), composed of citizen volunteers and professional personnel, organized under the authority of the respective Gubernors of the Pacifican States. (a) The State Guarde shall be under the exclusive peacetime command of the Gubernors of the Pacifican States, who shall coordinate mutual aid, training, and operations through a Pacifica Defense Council. (b) The  head Executive [consulate] of Pacifica may mobilize the State Guarde for national emergencies, defense against foreign invasion, or to suppress insurrection, provided such mobilization is in accordance with federal law, and the consent of the Pacifica Defense Council except in cases of direct and imminent threat to state security. The mission of the State Guarde shall encompass all forms of national and state defense, including but not limited to: Defense against foreign invasion or attack, Protection of the constitutional order and civil society from illegitimate insurrection or coup, Disaster response and humanitarian relief, Riot control and restoration of public order, Support for local law enforcement and emergency services, as authorized by state law. The State Guarde shall be trained and equipped to operate in decentralized, community-based units, capable of rapid mobilization and independent action, in accordance with the principles of resilience and local empowerment as articulated in this Constitution. Members of the State Guarde shall be protected from deployment outside the Pacifican States except by act of Congress in a military emergency where there are insufficient military personnel or in response to direct threats to Pacifica within the exclusive economic zone surrounding its jurisdiction. The State Guarde shall not be used for purposes of political suppression or to infringe upon the rights of the people to lawfully/justly assemble and petition for redress of grievances. Congress and the legislatures of the Pacifican States shall have the authority to enact laws and regulations necessary to implement this provision, consistent with its intent and the principles of [anti]-federalism.

SECTION. 9.

The powers, duties, and responsibilities of the Judiciary shall be prescribed by the constitution of their State.

SECTION. 10.

All People in the Jurisdictions of Pacifica shall be entitled to all the Rights, Privileges, and Immunities of all other People in any other Jurisdiction of the Pacifica, including, among other privileges, to bear true allegiance to the Constitution and the laws of Pacifica, and to be protected in Life, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and freedom to secure others] and Self-defense [and freedom to defend others], Privacy, Property, and the pursuit of Happiness.

The Citizens of each State and the Territories of Pacifica shall be entitled equally to all the Rights, Privileges, and Immunities of Citizens in and of each of the Several States, and the Territories of Pacifica, including complete reciprocity in the protection and benefit of the laws and programs from one State to another, and within any State between them, if there be any;-And, among other privileges, to bear true allegiance to the Constitution and the laws of Pacifica made in accordance therewith;-And to be protected in Life, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and freedom to defend others] and Self-defense [and freedom to defend others], Privacy, Property, and the Pursuit of Happiness.

SECTION. 11.

British Columbia and the Yukon Territory, in addition to Baja California, acceding to this federation, and adjoining in the measures of Pacifica, shall be admitted into, and entitled to all the advantages of this Union.

New States may be admitted by the Congress into this Union; but no new State shall be formed or erected within the Jurisdiction of any other State, nor any State be formed by the Junction of two or more States, or Parts of States, without the Consent of the Legislatures of the States concerned as well as of the Congress, or as may be prescribed otherwise by this constitution for the purposes of sub-states.

Congress may purchase lands from foreign territories for the purposes of incorporation into the Union;

The Congress shall have Power to dispose of and make all needful Rules and Regulations respecting the Territory or other Property belonging to Pacifica; and nothing in this Constitution shall be so construed as to Prejudice any Claims of Pacifica, or of any particular State.

Any Pacifican territory established beyond Earth’s atmosphere shall be governed under the principles of this Constitution, ensuring the protection of individual rights, self-governance, and non-aggression.

Congressional Districts shall be determined regionally, across State Lines. Congress is prohibited from gerrymandering Districts.

SECTION. 12.

Pacifica shall guarantee to every State in this Union a [constitutionally empowered in addition to restrained] [Progressive-Libertarian]-Social-Democratic-Republican syncretic form of government, and shall protect each of them against Invasion and Attack; and on Application of the Legislature, or of the Executive (when the Legislature cannot be convened) against domestic Violence (generally, not statutory).

Whenever the federal government shall fail to provide for or maintain border security or to defend them from invasion or attack, or from domestic violence, the states shall be automatically granted the Power and Responsibility to do the same, and may deputize Citizens through the Gubernor or county Sheriff's granted Authority by the State Executor to secure/defend it/them, and whenever both shall fail to provide for the same, the People shall be free to secure/defend themselves and these precepts, including with force as needed, in conformity to their rights to engage in Militia duties;

ARTICLE XII

SECTION. 1.

For all legislative sessions and Jury deliberations, as a symbol and act of tranquility, grounding, and unity, a peace pipe will be packed with Cannabis flower, hashish, or a combination of them, and passed upon a circle of participating members to the left hand side, who may either choose to smoke it or pass it to the next member. Once all members are satisfied with their level of awareness, they may then proceed in their course of legal action from there. Recesses shall be supplemented with cannabis cigarettes, which shall be referred to as duchies, and left to each member to consume as they shall so see fit. Religious exemptions may be filed if reasonably articulated. If a member has legitimate disqualifying medical condition/s related to the properties of such smoke, they shall be found exempt from the need to directly participate in this ceremony, but will be required to be telepresent by video-call until the ceremony concludes.

Dosing on psilocybin or lysergic acid diethylamide tartrate shall be required before declarations of war in order to promote empathy, long-term vision, and ego-free decision-making. The only exception to this will be for individuals who are at risk of psychiatric break, have a religious objection which is reasonably articulated on file, or are medically exempted, but either shall be required to be present at the same time that the remainder of public members participate in the psychedelic ritual before declaration of war, as a means to promote peace and clear minded choices.
