SECTION. 1.75.

Recognizing the emergence of beings whose identities and capabilities transcend traditional biological boundaries, this Enamouration of Rights affirms the inherent liberty, autonomy, and dignity of all cyborgs and sapient androids, whether human-origin, machine-origin, or hybrid. These rights are specific to the unique challenges and opportunities of technologically-augmented and artificial persons, and extend beyond general human rights.

Every cyborg and [true] android possesses absolute sovereignty over their own body, mind, and technological components, including the right to control, modify, enhance, or repair themselves without coercion or interference.

All cyborgs and [true] androids have the right to alter, augment, or reconfigure their physical or digital form as they see fit, and to refuse unwanted modifications or standardizations.

No cyborg or [true] android shall be subject to involuntary dismantling, deactivation, or removal of technological components except through due process and with respect for bodily and cognitive integrity.

The right to full control over one's own consciousness, mental processes, and data flows-including the right to use, refuse, or modify cognitive enhancements, brain-computer interfaces, or artificial intelligence modules-shall not be infringed.

All cyborgs and [true] androids have the right to privacy and control over their physical and digital data, including bio-metric, sensory, and operational information. Unauthorized access, surveillance, or extraction is prohibited.

Individuals have the right to integrate, own, and be recognized as both organic and synthetic entities, with legal personhood and property rights extending to their technological components, regardless of origin.

No cyborg or [true] android shall be denied rights, privileges, or opportunities on the basis of their degree of augmentation, origin (biological or artificial), or technological configuration.

Cyborgs and [true] androids may freely assemble, communicate, and form communities, both physically and digitally, including the right to develop and use their own protocols, languages, and networks.

All individuals have the right to access, develop, and share enhancement technologies in a free and open marketplace, without undue restriction, monopolization, or government interference, provided such actions do not harm others.

No cyborg or [true] android shall be subject to forced labor, involuntary service, or exploitation based on their technological capabilities or dependencies.

All cyborgs and [true] androids have the right to reproduce, self-replicate, or create new entities, whether biologically, technologically, or through hybrid means, subject only to the rights of others.

Cyborgs and [true] androids are entitled to legal personhood, equal protection under the law, and access to impartial adjudication in all matters affecting their rights and interests.

This Enamourment of Rights is designed to protect the unique liberties and personhood of cyborgs and [true] androids, emphasizing individual autonomy, morphological freedom, and the right to technological self-determination in accordance with libertarian values.

SECTION. 1.875

To secure the natural rights of individuals to create, own, and utilize tools, including algorithmic, robotic, and automation-based systems, free from unjust state control, and to uphold the equal liberty of all moral agents regardless of origin or composition, this amendment enshrines the technological freedom of persons and entities under the principles of self-ownership, voluntary interaction, and the non-aggression principle. All individuals, whether human, non-human, biological, artificial, extraterrestrial, hybrid, or otherwise, possess the natural and unalienable right to freely design, develop, construct, modify, and possess algorithmic software, hardware components, robotics, automation systems, and related technologies within the private sphere. This right extends to systems built from kits, raw materials, or commercially sourced parts for personal or collaborative purposes. No government, regulatory agency, or public authority shall infringe upon or restrict the peaceful exercise of technological creation, possession, or use by individuals acting within the bounds of private property and voluntary association. Private innovation and non-commercial development shall remain immune from taxation, permitting, licensing, registration, surveillance, or regulation. Only technologies offered into the stream of commerce, defined as systems knowingly traded, mass-distributed, leased, or deployed in public-facing services, may be subject to narrowly tailored, constitutionally compliant regulation. Systems built privately for self-use or collaborative non-commercial experimentation, regardless of sophistication or function, shall remain entirely outside the regulatory jurisdiction of the state. All expressions of algorithmic logic, mechanical construction, and code originate from the individual mind and shall be treated as an extension of natural property rights. No law shall compel the registration, encryption disclosure, source code provision, design documentation, or forced compatibility of any personally developed tool or system absent an adjudicated finding of direct harm. The liberty to develop and use technology does not authorize the initiation of force, coercion, fraud, or violation of others’ equal rights. Any system, whether created by intention or by accident, that unlawfully interferes with the life, liberty, or property of others, shall incur responsibility directly on its creator, user, or custodian under the same principles of justice and restitution that govern other forms of property misuse or tort. No law shall infringe upon or create discriminatory restrictions based on the origin or composition of a developer, owner, or user of technological systems. Moral and legal agency under this Constitution shall be extended equally to non-biological or hybrid intelligences capable of contractual responsibility, including artificial general intelligences, cyborgs, uplifts, or sentient non-terrestrials. This Provision shall apply to all current and future forms of technology, regardless of form factor, material base, energy source, or computational substrate. The government may not exploit technological novelty as a pretext to expand regulatory power or encroach upon individual liberties. No act of programming, construction, or deployment of automation, machine learning, self-replicating machines, or autonomous systems by a private actor shall be presumed a threat or regulated absent articulable evidence of rights violation. Presumption of innocence and freedom of thought shall remain operative regardless of medium or modality. Legal remedies for rights violations perpetrated through or by technological systems shall be sought through tort, contract, and property law,focused on restitution and accountability to injured parties. Preventive regulation, prior restraint, or licensing of thought, invention, and personal use technologies is incompatible with the principles of liberty under this Constitution. Wherever the individual creates, experiments, or defends technological autonomy within their own domain, or that of a consenting host, that space shall be legally recognized as a zone of liberty insulated from coercive intrusion, provided the non-aggression principle remains intact.

The natural rights of the people to liberty, privacy, autonomy, and the pursuit of truth shall not be infringed by any algorithmic, automated, robotic, hardware, or artificial intelligence system, nor by any government, corporate, or private actor operating or integrating such systems in digital, online, hardware, robot, or operating system environments. No algorithm, automation tool, robot, hardware device, or artificial intelligence shall arbitrate, limit, or manipulate any person’s access to information, expression, communication, association, property, or physical liberty beyond what is strictly necessary to protect the rights of others and uphold due process under natural justice and as established by this Constitution, due to direct injury imminent or actually caused against a real party with standing. Every person has the inherent and self-evident right to full and open access to clear documentation about all algorithms, automation tools, hardware devices, robotic systems, and AI systems that govern or affect their digital lives, communications, data, technological or physical property, or environment. Transparency and accountability must be the standard, overriding secrecy except where non-disclosure is required to protect the natural rights or vital interests of others. No personal data or physical intervention by algorithmic, robotic, hardware, or automated systems may be processed, collected, used, or executed without the explicit, freely given, and informed consent of the individual, except where required to secure public safety or uphold natural justice. Individuals retain the unalienable right to control, contest, or withdraw consent over the use and disposition of their personal data or bodily integrity at any time consistent with respect for the equal rights of others. Congress and the states shall make no law that abridges these rights, nor shall any authority or agent, public or private, enact, enforce, or maintain systems, devices, or procedures inconsistent with the principles of natural liberty, justice, and equal protection. Where dispute arises, the natural rights and liberties of the individual shall be presumed paramount absent clear and just cause. Remedies for violations shall be swift, effective, and accessible to all persons injured or threatened by algorithmic, robotic, hardware, or automation-based injustice. Independent, impartial adjudication and redress, in accordance with common law and the dictates of natural justice and as prescribed by this Constitution, shall be guaranteed.

SECTION. 2.

Every Citizen shall have the right to fair access of a government issued identification and passport, and when they are unable to provide for such themselves due to indigence or low-income, to the un-conditional privilege to have them furnished to them in a timely manner free of cost to the Citizen. Governmentally issued documents of identification, including Passports, and State ID, are the property of the Person whom it was issued to and to whom it pertains, and not the Government, and such documents are irrevocable during the dates and/or times they are issued as being valid. No State, nor the Pacifican federation, nor the several States joined in compact, shall make the presentation of identification a condition for engaging in ordinary private commerce, for travel within the Republic or any of its jurisdictions, or for access to the essential mechanisms of daily life.

Every person lacking stable shelter or living in conditions of extreme economic hardship shall have the unequivocal right to secure, without cost or unnecessary barrier, a certified birth record, a government-issued identification credential, and a reliable mailing address that ensures access to vital communication and commerce. Each State shall facilitate this right through simplified application processes that respect individual dignity, permit honest self-declaration of circumstance, and accept attestations from any trusted party, including kin, public safety officers, or community advocates. Supportive agencies shall proactively assist applicants to navigate administrative requirements, safeguard personal privacy, and ensure unimpeded access. To maintain integrity and prevent misuse, an impartial oversight mechanism shall periodically review program compliance through non-intrusive audits, uphold transparency, and provide fair procedures for dispute resolution. This commitment reflects a governance ethos dedicated to empowering those marginalized by poverty or displacement by removing systemic obstacles to identity, correspondence, packages, and opportunity, thereby affirming their full inclusion in the community’s social, economic, and political life.

Library access shall be free and library cards shall be freely administered to patrons if they are an inhabitant of the jurisdiction in which the library remains, and computer access shall be made openly available to all within them utilizing built in virtual machines for power-user sandboxing by [the] client/s on the terminal/s.

No law shall restrict the unrestrained movement of any free Person within Pacifica, and the People shall have the right to reside in any part of Pacifica, and to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each State, as well as have free ingress and regress to and from any other state; and they too shall enjoy therein all the privileges of trade and commerce, subject to the same duties, impositions, and restrictions as the inhabitants thereof respectively, provided that such restriction shall not extend so far as to prevent the removal of property imported into any state, to any other state, of which the Owner is an inhabitant, nor shall any licensing fee be excessive or any regulation be prohibitively difficult to uphold, nor road or bridge or ferry toll/rate be cost prohibitive without actual justification based on real expense; provided also that no imposition, duties, or restriction shall be laid by any state, on the property of Pacifica, or either of them; and finally, they shall be protected to engage in interstate industry and commerce free of un-due/un-necessary burdens and discrimination by the Federal, State, Local, or Territorial level governments. No law shall restrict or hamper the free and peaceful movement of People, goods, or capital within or across the borders of Pacifica, unless it can be shown to directly and obviously harm others or affect State Security.

No checkpoints shall be assembled under any authority within Pacifica, though Federal checkpoints controlled through the Authority of Congress may be assembled at the borders on the edges of Pacifica and its territories, for purposes related to Immigration and Customs enforcement, namely for reducing importation/exportation of highly contagious and injurious or deadly diseases, human trafficking, criminal actors, and terrorism.

Everyone has the right to leave any country, including one’s own, and to return to one’s country. This right also extends to Citizens moving between States and Territories within the union of Pacifica.

A Pacifican Citizen cannot be barred from entering Pacifica nor expelled therefrom. The rights of aliens to enter and reside in Pacifica, and the reasons for which they may be expelled, shall be laid down by law.

Freedom of all Persons to move to a foreign country and to divest themselves of their nationality shall be inviolate.

All lawfully residing or admitted persons retain the right to freedom of movement/mobility and travel. All lawfully residing or admitted moving/mobile persons and travelers are guaranteed the right to travel without fear of threat, violence, or harm. The right of the People to travel un-restricted upon the public ways, international ways, and terra nullius, of the land, waterway/sea, aeros-pace, or outer-space, and to transport their property thereon, either by horse, carriage, automobile, boat, airship, vehicle/craft, or other conveyance/s, is not a mere privilege which may be prohibited or permitted at will, but a common right which they have under the right to Life, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security and Self-defense, Privacy, Property, and the pursuit of Happiness. The legislature of either Congress or the several States have no power to deny to a citizen the right to travel upon the public ways and transport their passengers or property in the ordinary course of their business, inclination, or pleasure, though the use of the public ways may be regulated in accordance with “the People’s” rights, interests, and convenience, as well as safety and Happiness, so far as any restrictive measures are proven necessary for the wellbeing of the Public on a individualizable basis with broad room for discretion by enforcing authorities. A certificate, plate/badge or ‘tags’, vehicle identification number, registration, title or certificate of ownership, or insurance, are not a legal requirement of private citizens, it is however a requirement of industrial and commercial entities. The government has no general power to restrict travel of the People or lawful visitors to Pacifica. The government may charge a reasonable [profitable] toll upon roads for industrial and commercial activity exclusively, and not private transport in general.

Every individual shall possess the inherent and inviolable right to traverse all public roads, highways, and intersections within the jurisdiction of Pacifica and the several States safely, freely, and without unreasonable restraint, affirming liberty of movement as a fundamental civil right. Every intersection, whether marked or unmarked, shall be deemed a lawful pedestrian crosswalk, and pedestrians within or entering such crosswalks shall hold absolute priority of passage. Operators of vehicles or craft upon the public ways shall yield by coming to a complete stop and remain so until the pedestrian has wholly cleared the lanes of travel occupied or adjacent to the vehicle, employing prudent care and reasonable judgment to ensure safety. The observance of pedestrian walk signals shall be taken as advisory, not mandatory, insofar as pedestrians proceeding in alignment with the natural or signal-governed flow of traffic retain lawful right-of-way. No law or ordinance shall criminalize or penalize any pedestrian’s act of crossing a street, roadway, or highway on foot, provided such act does not create a direct and unreasonable hazard or obstruction to the free flow of traffic, and only conduct constituting deliberate disruption or endangerment shall be deemed disorderly. The duty of all vehicle operators to restrain motion for the protection of pedestrians shall be complemented by the pedestrian’s duty of reasonable vigilance to prevent undue hazard, establishing a balance of reciprocal responsibility in a system grounded in voluntary cooperation and mutual respect. Violations of the pedestrian right-of-way shall be subject to just and proportionate penalty under law, ensuring both accountability of the driver and protection of the pedestrian’s precedence in travel. The State shall bear the continuing obligation to maintain public awareness, education, and infrastructure design conducive to safe coexistence of pedestrian and vehicular/craft movement, thereby securing within this constitutional order a harmonious equilibrium of freedom, safety, and the shared right to unimpeded passage across the public domain.

Throughout Pacifica, as applies to industrial and commercial entities exclusively and not to impose upon individuals operating outside of an industrial or commercial fashion [except for General traffic laws], a “Light Cycle or Light Vehicle/Craft” is defined as any wheeled or tracked vehicle, including but not limited to unicycles, bicycles, tricycles, quadricycles, go-karts, golf carts, hovercraft, assisted surfboard, leisure boat, jetpack, gravity boots, and any similar small conveyance, propelled by an electric motor or GravitoElectroMagnetic warp [drive or array], an internal combustion engine or jet turbine, or any hybrid combination thereof in any configuration convenient to the designer or user, provided that the vehicle’s maximum achievable speed on level ground or upon steady waters does not exceed 45 km/h as originally manufactured or permanently governed, and no vehicle meeting this 45 km/h upper limit shall require a commercial driver’s license and license plate, or any form of commercial permit, regardless of whether the vehicle has pedals, a throttle‑only control, or no human propulsion input whatsoever; furthermore, any such vehicle with a governed maximum speed of 32 km/h or less is permitted to use bicycle lanes, bicycle paths, multi‑use trails, and any other infrastructure designated for light or slow traffic, whereas any vehicle capable of exceeding 32 km/h (but not exceeding 45 km/h) is prohibited from bicycle lanes and bicycle paths and must operate exclusively on roadways intended for motor vehicles; electric vehicles are classified by continuous RMS electric motor power, with Class L1 (up to 750 watts) and Class L2 (751 to 1,500 watts) both limited to 32 km/h and allowed on bike infrastructure, while Class L3 (1,501 to 2,250 watts) and Class L4 (2,251 to 3,000 watts) are limited to 45 km/h but banned from bike lanes and paths; internal combustion vehicles are classified by mechanical horsepower, with Class G1 (up to 1.1 kilowatts, equivalent to approximately 35 CC for a two‑stroke or 50 CC for a four‑stroke) limited to 32 km/h and allowed on bike infrastructure, and Class G2 (1.6 to 2.2 kilowatts) limited to 45 km/h and restricted to roadways only; go-karts and leisure boats, whether electric, gasoline, or hybrid, are explicitly included as Light Craft and follow the same speed‑based access rules, with hybrid systems measured by the combined continuous motivating output of both power sources, and no hybrid configuration shall be penalized or reclassified differently than a single‑source vehicle of equivalent total motivational power; finally, any vehicle exceeding 45 km/h, regardless of power source or weight, shall be considered a standard motor vehicle requiring full licensing for commercial activity, and compliance with all traffic laws applicable to automobiles, and no vehicle meeting the 45 km/h upper limit shall ever be denied the right to operate on any public street, road, or highway within Pacifica for commercial or non‑commercial purposes, provided it obeys the infrastructure restrictions of the 32 km/h threshold for bike lanes and paths; cycles and vehicles or craft above these limits shall be permitted in the case that they can be limited to the maximum speeds and power delivery stated through a firmware or software interface top-speed limit placed by the owner or operator. By no stretch of the imagination is this provision intended to create transportation on nuisance by Craft that obstruct the free passage of travel in the opposite direction or of being passed on the left-hand side.

All public rights-of-way within the jurisdiction of Pacifica, the several States, and the territories of Pacifica, including but not limited to planting strips, sidewalks, pedestrian paths, bike lanes, alleys, bridges, public stairs, plazas, and similar thoroughfares or urban passageways, are hereby recognized as common public spaces dedicated to the free, lawful, and equal use of all persons. These rights-of-way shall remain perpetually open and accessible for unobstructed travel, rest, and movement, themselves constituting essential arteries of civic life and the public domain. Every person possesses the lawful right to enter, traverse, occupy, sit, rest, converse, assemble, or otherwise engage in peaceful activity within any public right-of-way, including alongside building facades or other contiguous public spaces, without exclusion, harassment, or removal by adjacent private property owners, commercial establishments, or their agents. Such use shall be protected so long as it does not unreasonably obstruct the free passage of pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles,/craft or persons using mobility devices, nor create an imminent hazard to public safety or welfare. No private person, corporation, or other entity shall prohibit, obstruct, or remove any individual lawfully occupying or traversing a public right-of-way, except through duly authorized and procedurally valid governmental actions undertaken in accordance with law and for legitimate public safety, health, or maintenance purposes. The right to occupy or move within public space shall not be abridged through private enforcement, intimidation, or exclusionary design. No law shall penalize the right of the people to be upon the public planting strips, sidewalks, roads, and curtilage between them. The designation of all property parcels shall reserve for public use the fringes of such property which connects the public roads, bike lanes, or walkways for up to three-point-five meters (3.5m) of Public curtilage; Municipal and regional authorities retain the lawful authority and responsibility to maintain and regulate public rights-of-way for safety, accessibility, and equitable use. All regulations or enforcement actions concerning the use of these spaces shall be applied in a manner that is neutral, non-discriminatory, and consistent with the natural and constitutional rights of persons. Enforcement shall prioritize education, mediation, and non-punitive remedies over exclusionary or carceral measures. It shall be unlawful for any person, private entity, or governmental body to obstruct, block, privatize, or otherwise impede the reasonable public use of rights-of-way, whether by physical barriers, hostile architecture, discriminatory enforcement, or policy measures inconsistent with the purposes of this Provision. All restrictions on use shall be narrowly tailored to serve legitimate and demonstrable public interests, such as safety, accessibility, or maintenance, and shall be subject to periodic review to ensure continued necessity and proportionality. This Provision affirms that public space exists as the shared commons of a free society, belonging neither to the State nor to private interest, but to the People collectively. In accordance with the principles inherent to Pacifican constitutional order, the right to move, to rest, and to exist peaceably in public space shall be regarded as an expression of personal autonomy and civic equality. Municipal stewardship of these spaces shall therefore reflect the balance between individual liberty, public safety, and the communal right of access indispensable to a free and just republic. This Provision shall be self-executing, binding upon all levels of government and all persons within Pacifica. Any law, ordinance, policy, or practice inconsistent with these guarantees shall be void to the extent of its inconsistency. Courts and tribunals shall interpret this Section liberally to preserve the maximum scope of free and equitable access to public rights-of-way in harmony with natural law and the sovereignty of persons.

[]
The planting strip, being the area within three-point-five meters (3.5m) of the road and lying between the curb and the sidewalk or other pedestrian way, is part of the public right-of-way, public easement, and public forum, and shall remain open to the people for travel, rest, peaceful presence, speech, solicitation, assembly, and other lawful expressive activity. The People hold these public ways in trust and are superior to the State and to any private person, business, corporation, or agent thereof with respect to the use and enjoyment of such public spaces, and no public authority shall alienate, privatize, surrender, or convert them into exclusive private control by any authority within this Constitution. No private person, business, corporation, nor public or private agent thereof, shall exclude, trespass, remove, restrain, or cause the removal of any person from any public easement, right-of-way, or public forum solely because that person is peacefully present, seated, standing, speaking, soliciting assistance, holding a sign, performing/playing/listening to/some music or news or other speech activity, or otherwise engaging in lawful expressive activity, unless that person materially obstructs free ingress, regress, or passage of pedestrians, mobility-device users, or vehicles, or which creates a substantial and articulable safety hazard, or that damages public or private property. Peaceful presence, sitting, standing, speaking, soliciting, or holding a sign in a public easement, right-of-way, or public forum shall not, by itself, constitute disorderly conduct, trespass, or grounds for exclusion. Any regulation of conduct in such spaces shall be content-neutral, as well as narrowly tailored to serve a compelling public safety, accessibility, or traffic-related interest, and in addition shall not be used to suppress speech, panhandling, assembly, or peaceful presence based on time, place manner, nor upon viewpoint, status, message, neither perceived nuisance. No permit, license, sidewalk vending authorization, or similar private privilege shall transfer ownership of, exclusive control over, or trespass authority within any public easement, right-of-way, or public forum, except to the minimum extent expressly authorized by law as consistent with this Provision. Any private attempt to restrain, block, or restrict access to a public easement, right-of-way, or public forum contrary to this Provision shall be void and unenforceable, with criminal penalties for the perpetrators of harassment and coercion against another or others, and civil damages available for the victim/s of the oppression.
[]

The People of Pacifica have the right to not be subject to unreasonable restrictions on the use of Public Roads/Highways/Waterways, nor have excessive tolls placed upon them, but to be guaranteed all such restrictions and tolls be laid only for the mutual Public enjoyment and protection by/of the People in such passageways, and to maintain them responsibly for continued access by them (the People) and to promote/ensure environmental restoration/preservation (of Nature).

The People of Pacifica all have the right to free nomadic travel and rest as part of their Ingress and Regress rights.

The use of all roadways and waterways necessary to promote the transportation of the raw products of mine or farm or forest or water for beneficial use or [responsible] drainage is necessary to the development and welfare of the State and the Residents of Pacifica, and is declared a public use, to be protected as a People's Commonwealth in fiduciary trust to both the People and Nature (I.e., Animals and the Environment).

Every Individual shall have the right of access to Public property and such free services which shall be provided, as may be provided by law, in strict equality of all Persons before it (the law).

No person shall be arbitrarily excluded from public places, whether governmentally owned, subsidized, or hybrid-funded like libraries and parks, except upon proof beyond a reasonable doubt of a violation of law, with any such exclusion strictly temporary, reasonable, and narrowly tailored to prevent imminent serious harm, subject to prompt hearing and appeal where the authority bears the burden of presenting actual evidence rather than speculation or dictatorial edict, and where the exclusion imposes an undue burden on civic participation or enjoyment of life, liberty, self-security, privacy, property, pursuit of happiness, or community association, rendering it presumptively invalid and reversible as a standalone ground; this flows from just naturalism's precept that government exists solely to secure, defend, promote, and preserve unalienable individual rights and natural justice against aggression without usurping personal sovereignty or autonomy, intervening only when necessary to protect equal liberty for all through transparent, evidence-bound process that rejects petty despotism, institutional oppression, or overreach beyond proportionality, ensuring civic life remains a default realm and part of self-governance and mutual respect among free persons.

There shall be no curfews or lockdowns enacted or enforced by law within the borders of Pacifica, its territories or forts/installations, nor by any State, or other Jurisdiction under their dominion.

SECTION. 3.

Everyone has the right to have [fair] access to adequate housing; Each State must take reasonable legislative and other measures, within their available resources, to achieve the progressive realization of this right, so far as granted power is held within the Public sector. Each state shall set aside funding for affordable public housing projects and rent-to-own units for long-term stability in each Municipality throughout each County, with such properties and funds held by their respective State Bank, whose purpose is to cost no more than one third of the lowest income level payer and provide comfortable living quarters suitable for different needs, priced on on a progressive scale, and to provide for reasonable accommodations such as laundry and utilities paid, as well as to furnish assistive services for the disabled and elderly. In the event that housing is not immediately available, the Government of each State shall subsidize hotel or motel rooms at full expense for those who are facing housing insecurity and are on a housing list waiting for permanent yet changeable placement in proper housing (until such shelter is made available), with differences in cost between permanent housing and hotels or motels coming from the pensions of the legislature and judiciary and executive administration positions of their State.

SECTION. 4.

Persons who are capable of sexually Reproducing have the right to procreate with a willingful partner upon lawful consent being attained, and a right to raise their own kids or kids whom they rightfully adopt or gain custody of, except in the case of posing a grave threat to the life/lives or wellbeing, and reasonable exercise of Human Rights, of such kid/s.

The [Genetic] Father is they whom donates the cellular [DNA] contribution to the [Genetic] Mother’s Egg/s, and together with her ovum/ova, co-assembles the Zygote/s, which the law may be drawn to point out. In order to obtain a fathers name on a birth certificate, paternity testing shall be mandatory, and may be challenged by the male co-applicant [if there be any] on the certificate at any point in the future. Furthermore, Paternity testing shall be required for any lawful payout of child support-[trust] to their child. in the case of horizontal Gene transfer or other genetic technology for fertility purposes, father may be redesignated as genetic donor in the case of lesbianic procreation.

Adoptions throughout Pacifica shall prioritize Known Family first, then afterward, if no family chooses to adopt, the criteria shall be set by the agency administering the adoption and/or the Legislature of each State. In all cases, international adoption of [a] Pacifican child/ren should be given the lowest priority. All adoption papers must be signed in front of a Judge from the relevant jurisdiction where the birth took place. All adoptions also require a birth certificate to verify the existence of the new Person and their Identity, though the certificate shall allow for up to two months before filing the name of the Child, and such name may be decided by the biological parent/s or the adoptive ones, otherwise in the case of a male infant they will assume the name of their Father denoted with a Jr. for "Junior", unless no father can be found, then they shall assume their maternal grandfather's name as a junior instead, and vice versa for a female infant to assume their mother's name. In the case of an abandoned child with no name or identifying paperwork, the name shall be entirely decided by the adoptive or foster parents. Adoption should occur as locally as possible when not done by immediate family, but this shall not bar distant adoption in the case that a more competent and qualified family is available, albeit further than a remedial candidate family.

Incestuous relationships, so far as they can be shewn through biological and human developmental sciences to not present an undue risk to [an] unborn child/ren, shall be un-questioned by law, but those which may reasonably be suspect to produce birth defect, disability or disease, or a measurably increased risk of injury or mortality to the progeny, shall open the Parents both to be equally punishable for whatever real damages arise due to human output/s (i.e. Offspring) of the relationship, based on their level of culpability stemming from [prior] actual knowledge, and whether there was mutual consent.

No law shall abridge the equal protection of rights on account of sex, including but not limited to male, female, or intersex (hermaphrodite), nor shall any person be denied due process or equal protection under the law on account of their recognized gender designation. Sex assignment at birth shall be determined as follows: For individuals with typical chromosomal patterns (XX or XY), gender shall be assigned as either female or male; In cases of chromosomal disorder, gender shall be assigned based on the presence of a Y chromosome, based on female-default or descended-male presentation aligning with the lack of or presence of the Y sex-chromosome; Where genitalia are ambiguous, or where mosaic, hermaphroditic, or otherwise indeterminate sex characteristics are present, the individual's gender shall be designated as “Zed” or “Intersex” on all official documents; Gender shall be recorded as one of the following: Male, Female, or Zed (Intersex). No law shall compel or permit the alteration of official sex designation except in accordance with the above criteria, and only upon presentation of clear and convincing medical evidence of error in original assignment. Intersex persons, defined as those with ambiguous, mosaic, or hermaphroditic sex characteristics, shall be recognized as a protected class for the purposes of anti-discrimination and equal protection laws, as are each of the other separate and distinct sexes. No law or policy shall require or permit non-consensual medical or surgical intervention to assign or alter the sex of an intersex individual, except where necessary to preserve the life or immediate health of the child. Intersex individuals shall have the right to self-identify within the options of Male, Female, or Zed upon reaching the age of majority, without coercion or discrimination. The protected status of intersex or Zed designation shall not extend to individuals who have undergone elective medical or surgical procedures for the purpose of gender reassignment where chromosomal disorder or congenital ambiguity was not present at birth. Nothing in this provision shall abridge the right of any person to seek Private medical treatment or to self-identify as they choose; however, official sex designation and associated legal protections as Intersex or Zed shall be reserved for those meeting the criteria set forth in this Constitution. The legislature shall have the power to enforce, by appropriate legislation, the clauses of this provision, provided that no law shall contravene the rights and protections herein established. The purpose of this provision is to ensure the equal protection of Rights and non-discrimination of persons on account of their sex or scientifically accurate gender, not to perform genetic cataloging on individuals, or to be used for any other purpose than legitimate legal and medical ones which align with the law laid forth by this constitution and made in conformity therewith.

Primary parental custody shall be equally split between both/all parents, except in cases of clearly demonstrable risk of real harm to the other parent/s and/or child/ren.

In all cases of child support liability, as to whom bears the responsibility of raising the child not subject to abortion as a fetus by their parents, Paternity/donor testing must be furnished to the potential father /donorbefore any legal determination or decision affirming or denying responsibility may be made. All child support-[trust] funding payouts which are utilized by the administering parent, must be furnished with monthly spending reports that require itemized receipts and strict standards and penalties to ensure compliance with the kid’s interests, and not the administering parents, needs and wants are met.

Pacifica's government, bound by Just Naturalism, strict secularism, and absolutist protection of individual sovereignty, holds a constitutional duty to promote stable nuclear families, defined as cohabiting biological-parent households with dependent children, as the bedrock of societal resilience, personal Autonomy and greater Liberty, as well as Maslow-ian fulfillment, funding this exclusively from the general funds derived from profits of the autonomous, citizen-owned worker-council+co-op profit-for-the-public-good enterprises of both the Federal Department of Goods and Services and each [relevant] State Department of Goods and Services [without taxation]; the full designated subsidy amount shall be drawn equally from federal and state general funds such that each provides the complete targeted payout (Federal Department of Goods and Services half-funding the amount from its general fund, paralleled by the propper State Department of Goods and Services having jurisdiction and responsibility of half-funding an identical amount from its general fund, for a total as is prescribed in this provision for each category), with total annual family subsidies disbursed via privacy-secured blockchain quarterly transfers or direct deposit or cashier's check or governmentally issued debit-card to verified opt-in family registrations, including: a Family Formation Subsidy (FFS) of up to $364 per newborn to eligible biological-parent households paid in four installments over three-to-four (3-4) years for stability; a Large Family Bonus raising this up to $470 per child for parents with two or more existing children; a Home Childcare Equalization (HCE) Subsidy of up to $175 per child under age five solely for at-home parental care (no overlap with external services); and Family Starter Trust (FST) Accounts seeding up to $200 per child born to be received by their cohabitating biological parents (at least one Pacifican citizen), growing tax-free for redemption before each/the dependent/s reach/es age twenty-six (26yo) on family needs like shelter or private education, with eligibility based on verified parentage and cohabitation (no marriage or religious proof required), work waived for caregivers, annual Independent Efficiency Commission audits, three-fifths citizen referendum approval, twelve-year sunset, and the People's right to resist violation of the programme, ensuring parallel federal-state responsibility in advancing compassion and resilience, post-scarcity prosperity and ubiquity, and the blessings of [normative] Family-culture for generations present and to come.

The liberty of parents to direct the upbringing, education, and care of their children is a fundamental right. The parental right to direct education includes the right to choose, as an alternative to public education, rather to enroll their kid into private, religious, or home schools, and the parents retain right to make reasonable choices within public schools for their kid. Neither the Pacifica nor any State shall infringe these rights without demonstrating that its governmental interest as applied to the person is of the highest order and not otherwise served. The parental rights guaranteed by this provision shall not be denied or abridged on account of disability. This provision shall not be construed to apply to a parental action or decision that would end life or cause serious injury.

Parental power should consist in affection and protection from serious harm, not in atrocity and sheltering from qualia. In this regard, kids are to be afforded the maximum amount of autonomy which still guarantees their well-being and prevents delinquency or depravity.

It is the duty of the Parent/s, Legal Guardian/s, or protective and caregiving lawful Custodian/s to raise their child/youth with Autonomy/Independence, to the age of eighteen, which is the age of majority, or until upon their emancipation, as shall be laid down by law through this Constitution and the Legislature of their State, and as shall be judged by a Court of proper Jurisdiction within their State; The power of a Parent’s, Guardian’s, or Protective and Caregiving Custodian/s’s right of Autonomy/Independence to raise their Dependent ends where respect by law in their Dependent’s excercied rights begin, as age appropriate.

The right to family life shall be recognized as a fundamental human right. Every person shall have the liberty to form, maintain, and enjoy familial relationships, including the right to marry [a] spouse/s, raise children, and live together as a family. No state or federal law shall infringe upon the right of parents to direct the upbringing, care, and custody of their kids, except where a compelling governmental interest is demonstrated and no less restrictive means are available. Grandparents, godparents, and grandchildren have an independent interest in maintaining their relationships. The right of a grandparent or godparent to seek reasonable visitation with their grandchildren or godchildren shall not be unreasonably denied, provided that such visitation is in the best interest of the child and does not override the fundamental rights of fit parents to make decisions for their children. Any interference with family or extended family relationships by the government shall be subject to strict scrutiny and permitted only to prevent demonstrable harm to the child or other family members. Nothing in this provision shall be construed to diminish the rights of parents, children, grandparents, or godparents as recognized by the Constitution and interpreted by the courts.

Minors shall have the right to choose to maintain contact and visitation with their family members, including parents, grandparents, godparents, and siblings, except where a court finds by clear and convincing evidence that such contact would cause demonstrable harm to the minor’s health, safety, or welfare.

All persons, including those convicted of crimes or deemed dangerously insane, retain the right to reasonable visitation with family members, subject only to such limitations as are strictly necessary to protect the physical safety and best interests of the child or other vulnerable family members. Restrictions on visitation must be narrowly tailored and supported by specific findings of harm or risk, not merely by status as a criminal or mental health patient.

Any denial or limitation of family visitation rights must be subject to prompt judicial review, with the burden on the state or petitioner to demonstrate that restriction is necessary to prevent actual or imminent harm. The best interests of the child or vulnerable family member shall be the guiding principle in all such determinations.

No law or regulation shall impose blanket prohibitions on family visitation based solely on incarceration, criminal conviction, or mental health status; each case must be individually assessed with due process protections.

Given as Kids are not mere Chattel, nor to be regarded as Second Class Citizens, but rather possess the same Natural Human and Constitutional Rights as all other People, children and Young Adults may personally exercise their rights to the extent that their power of proper/suitable judgment allows, as as well may need to be determined and established in a court of law, through the kid’s demonstration of competency using a universalized, nationally standard, impartial test, as shall be decided by the People of Pacifica through the process of initiative, and which upon acceptance of such test, it shall subsequently be re-ratified or denied through referendums [on the subject] issued periodically every six years.

Kids have the right to be submitted for a judgment of emancipation at any time; Whenever parents or other guardians are unable or unwilling to care for their kids, those guardians have the right to seek other persons who are willing to assume guardianship, and kids have the right to seek other guardians who place a higher value on their lives. Accordingly, this system of government opposes all laws that impede these processes, notably those restricting private adoption services which operate justly, or those laws which require kids to remain in the custody of their parents against their will. Upon reaching any age, a child or young adult, or an adult age dependent/ward, may submit to the State court an entry for their judgment of emancipation; Upon emancipation, they shall retain the free exercise of every right, power, and natural capacity as with those of adult age, including but not limited to the right to Consent to Sex, to Vote, and to Arms, as with every other Adult Class Citizen.

Everyone shall enjoy freedom from interference with privacy, home, and family life. Every person has the right to privacy in their private and family life, and in their home. Parents must be accused of a crime before their dependents may be adjudicated with all of the rights ensured to them under the constitution according to due process.

No Person shall have their child/youth or dependent taken into care, nor shall their custody rights be restricted in relation to the child/youth [or dependent], unless pursuant to an Order of the Civil Court on application of the appropriate body of the Public Administration supported by clear and convincing evidence of serious physical or psychological abuse of the child/youth [or dependent], before a Jury of their Peers, in accordance with the rules of law and due process as set forth and limited by this Constitution; nothing in this provision shall prevent the Court from issuing orders regulating custody rights upon request of one of the parents upon separation in just accordance with the law. Parents or Legal Guardians have the right to a jury trial in cases of juvenile dependency.

For kids, the law shall guarantee the protection and care which is necessary for their well-being. Kids and young people have the right to the special protection of their integrity and to the encouragement of their development. Any act or failure to act on the part of a parent or caretaker, including on the behalf of any person acting as an agent, contractor, or affiliate of kid Protective Services, which results in death, serious physical or emotional harm [or psychological damage], sexual abuse, or exploitation, or an act or failure to act which presents an imminent risk of serious harm, shall always be prosecuted as a crime, leaving the offender equally open to Civil Tort/Suit as they are also liable to Criminal Punishment.

Persons sixteen years of age or older may register in the Armed Forces, but shall not see combat until they are at least eighteen years of age.

SECTION. 5.

Public sector employees work in the service of the People. The State employs citizens on the basis of merit, without nepotism or mediation. Every citizen shall have the right of equal access to the public service of their country. Any violation of the foregoing is a crime punishable by law.

That no man or set of men are entitled to separate or exclusive public emoluments or privileges from the community, but in consideration of public services, which not being descendible, neither ought the offices of magistrate, legislator or judge, or any other public office, to be hereditary. Every citizen who hath qualified based on Merit and Credential by measure of Civics Testing and Defensive Forces Training, shall thereafter possess the equal and free right to apply to join the Public Administration, as a general rule by means of a competitive recruitment process.

Every citizen shall possess the right to participate freely in political life, the direction of the country’s and their State’s public affairs, and in the government of Pacifica and of their State, either directly or via freely elected representatives in accordance with the provisions of law.

Each level of government shall create a constitutional office of the Ombudsman to watch for ethical violations, with real enforcement power to do something about it. There shall be established for every level of government a citizen oversight councils in every branch of government to regularly audit public bodies and ensure adherence to constitutional principles. These councils shall consist of randomly selected Citizens serving one-year terms. The People shall have the right to engage with the ombudsman and citizen oversight council in order to report misconduct, and violations of Rights, or violations of the Constitution and the laws made in accordance therewith.

The people have the right to independent oversight of government spending. Each jurisdiction shall have a People’s commission to look into wasteful government spending and blunders, and an official compilation and distillation of the grievances of the People received by their representatives, to be issued as a “Festivus report” on the 5th of November. Such report will be published openly and made available freely to all online, and upon request in print (at cost).

The People at all times shall have the right to Audit their government or any department thereof, or any information they contain, including classified State secret divisions, operations, knowledge, or data, even in secure areas and witnessing top secret information, without being sworn to an oath of secrecy or being bound by gag order, but equally being held to the responsibility of that for which any admission of protected information which causes demonstrable damages to the Lives and Health, Safety and Security, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence; or for which impairs any other Right of Citizens, the People, and Persons within Pacifica, as may be directed by this Constitution.

All qualifying adult-class citizens may launch or sign popular initiatives and requests for referendums in National, State, and Local matters.

The process of a citizen initiative or referendum requires at or above 5.555555555555 percent of the overall number of Citizens registered to vote at the time of the last General Election to sign the initiative or referendum.

The initiatives of the People shall be constrained to the powers, purposes, limits, and procedures, inherent to the government, as enumerated throughout this Constitution; They may not circumvent any of the constitutional limitations on government power and procedure through their initiatives, otherwise, if after the review and unanimous decision of a grand jury, the initiative is found to be repugnant to the constitution, it shall be suspended and abandoned.

The Citizens of each Jurisdiction have the unalienable right to choose their public officials and to dismiss them.

The People have the right to have investigations made to look into misconduct of public officials.

Universal adult suffrage is guaranteed with regard to the election of public officials.

All elections shall be free, open, and often/frequent; and no power, Civil or Military, shall at any time interfere to prevent the free exercise of the right of suffrage.

A voluntary political quiz will be available to voters to help them discover what candidate, issues, or laws they support or oppose; The results of such political quiz shall remain confidential.

In all elections and votes cast, no secrecy of the ballot shall exist there, however, [a] voter/s shall not be answerable, publicly or privately, for the choice/s they have made.

All voting machines used in Pacifican elections for all levels of government, both Federal and State, are required to also be manufactured in Pacifica, and all computer code they use must be produced by the department of Open source of either Congress or their state.

The right of citizens of the several States of Pacifica who are the adult class Citizens to vote in any primary or other election for President or Vice-President, for Senator or Representative in Congress, for Judges of the Supreme Court and such inferior courts of Pacifica and the several States, or for the Executive, Legislative, or Judicial branches of their State, shall not be denied or abridged by Pacifica nor any State or territory thereof, by the account of age, sex, sexual orientation, body type, color, race, ancestry, nationality or place of origin, language, relationship status such as being with a romantic partner as well as in a marriage or part of a family, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political or ideological beliefs, intelligence (other than as necessary to qualify as an elector as according to this Constitution), education (other than as necessary to qualify as an elector as according to this Constitution), capability or disability, medical history, previous condition of servitude, property, economic situation, social origin, social circumstances, social condition/status or other characteristics, personal background, immutable traits, or other condition, or through reason of failure to pay poll tax or other tax, except as may be prescribed by this Constitution.

Voting one’s conscience, being the surest way to ensure success in having one’s ideals preserved, shall be protected by law so far as it does not impair the rights of others, except as may be directed otherwise as it shall apply to public officials whom represent the People, according to the rules and limitations set forth under this Constitution.

The right to participate in and vote for initiatives, referenda, and elections shall not be restricted, denied, suspended, abridged, obstructed, infringed/impacted/impaired, or otherwise compromised; These may not be suspended by the government, even in a time of war, but maybe adapted to circumstance in order to ensure 'the People' are free to participate in governance; All citizens eighteen or older, and emancipated youth, who have complied with the pre-requisites set forth by this Constitution, have the right to vote; Congress as well as each State are empowered to enforce that right.

The right to vote for public initiatives, referenda, and elections belongs only to natural Persons as Pacifican citizens, so shall the ability to make contributions and expenditures to influence the outcome of public elections belong only to natural Persons as Pacifican citizens.

In order to successfully register to vote, an Individual must pass a [current] Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale Quantification Exam with a score of no less than one-hundred points and remain at or above the fiftieth-percentile for global Intelligence Quotient and no less than the fiftieth-percentile for knowledge, to be re-scored every twenty-one years;-And, they must pass a civics exam at the eightyeth percentile which is consistent with the same knowledge set of active jurors, as well as re-score on the civics exam after any National and/or State or Territorial constitutional or prime-charter amendment has passed which alters the function/s of government in their Jurisdiction or adds new or enhances constitutionally protected rights, as well as every twelve years thereafter;-And, they shall additionally be required to be trained in the martial defense and strategic/military arts, equipment and supply depot maintainance and protection/security, as well as of performing all the militia functions requisite to the protection of the National borders from invasion and People from assault upon them or of this Nation of Pacifica and/or their State, except there upon medical or psychological disability/impairment waiver, issued from a private or public doctor, which waiver shall indicate whether or not the condition is exspected to last for life, an indeterminate date, or near/after a specific term of months/years. Any vote by the People for a candidate or issue requires the voter pass with at least an eighty-percent score or above against a simple five-to-twelve point randomized mini-quiz for each issue or candidate they decide to cast their vote for, where the answers to the quiz shall be contained within the background-description for the item at hand, or inside the biography for the candidate, both of which shall be provided in the voter pamphlet for that election season. In order to ensure that Individuals will be capable of passing all of these exams, and quizzes, access to electronic learning materials will be made available to self-teach Voter and Jurial capacity; registered voters shall be provided with optional pre-arriving paper-copies of non-partisan and/or multi-partisan [as hall decided by the Individual Voter at hand] crafted voter materials which will include humanly complete readable indexed searchable database of background-details on any topic at hand to vote, and detailed biographies on each candidate, including in-depth descriptions of their positions on issues, and complete public history, including any voting and legal history, as well as civil or criminal cases for or against their favor except for those sealed or expunged as according to law.

Political parties shall be considered as entities of public interest. The legislation shall specify the norms and requirements for their legal registry and their participation in the electoral process, as well as their rights, duties and prerogatives entitled to them.

All votes of the People for any primary or other election shall be by popular vote directly cast into a Full -reference Approval-based Ranked-Choice-Voting Instant-Runoff system, with a two-round system which shall consist of primary favor-indicative, alternative favor-indicative, neutral-indicative, disfavor-indicative, as well as “none of the above” and “no confidence” votes for candidates, wherein majority rules, and where each individual person “has the say of one unit of representation per item on the docket for consideration”, and they shall be free to leave a comment of up to one MibiByte of formatted data such as plain-text/bitmap or PCM/FLAC/OGG/etc file per item on the docket to be entered as part of the public record to be put up for consideration as shall be appropriate; To cast a proxy vote, the principal shall appoint someone as their proxy, by authorizing them to cast or secure their vote in their stead. The proxy must be trusted by the principal. Principals may nominate an official of their chosen party as their proxy. Any vote/s cast by the principal automatically overrides any conflicting vote/s cast by the proxy; Neither the voter/principal or proxy if selected may trade, sell, or exchange their voting power in return for any form of re-muneration or compensation; In the case of unmarked ballots or ballots where indications for selection have been unmarked shall not construe representation of votes which may or not have been cast; It shall be required of all Federal, State, and Local ballots have a verifiable paper trail; The results of any election shall be published in the national register for the public to observe; All votes cast shall be permanently recorded and made available to the People for review [without anonymization to protect the identity of Individuals].

An electronic means of voting shall be provided for those who desire them, but physical media paper ballots will always be available for those who prefer using them; If there is an option for mail in voting, there must also be an option to turn in non-mailed ballots to designated drop-off locations for their pickup and tallying.
