[]Recognizing that the right to property is anterior to civil government, inhering in the person by nature and secured but not granted by constitutional order, and that no just law or public policy may extinguish, dilute, or systematically circumvent this right without forfeiting its own legitimacy, the individual's dominion over lawfully acquired property shall be understood to encompass the full bundle of incidents attendant thereto: the rights of possession, control, enjoyment, exclusion, and disposition; the rights to repair, modify, and upgrade without interference from the original vendor, licensor, or any instrumentality of the state; the right to durable use free from revocation by any party who is neither a justifiably qualified court of competent jurisdiction nor an adverse claimant, meaning any prior titleholder asserting superior chain of title, lienholder foreclosing a security interest, co-owner asserting partition rights, easement holder asserting interference with an appurtenant right, or creditor proceeding through lawful execution on a judgment, and only by proceeding under due process in accordance with the laws of this constitution; the right to residue and resale value as incidents inseparable from title; the right to collateralize the property as security for lawful obligations; the right to bundle, unbundle, convey, or retain any constituent interest while preserving title in the holder's name; the right to own free from perpetual economic dependence upon any third party as a condition of continued use; and the right to transmit the whole of such interests, undiminished, to lawful heirs or successors of one's choosing; all of which rights shall receive the full protection of law against excessive corporate accumulation and against the accumulative tendencies of the public fisc (I.e, state's proprietary interest in its aggregate holdings) alike, it being declared that individual ownership holds preeminence, in moral dignity and in constitutional priority, over the aggregation of property by corporate entities and over the enlargement of the public domain beyond what public necessity, duly demonstrated, requires; provided, further, that any system, institution, business model, licensing regime, or technological scheme, whether private, quasi-public, or public in character, that structurally forecloses meaningful ownership by trapping persons in permanent access payments without pathway to title, by disabling repair or transfer so as to render possession nominal, by suppressing resale or collateral value through contractual or digital constraint, by exerting market dominance that causes artificial scarcity of goods particularly to consumers and individual end users, or by extracting recurring fees as the price of continued use while permanently withholding title, resale right, or the capacity for collateralization, shall be deemed facially illegitimate as a matter of natural justice, void as against the public policy of this Constitution, and subject to legislative abrogation and judicial remedy without deference to the private ordering that produced it; and provided, always, that nothing herein shall be construed to abridge the rights of any business owner in the lawful acquisition, use, or disposition of property honestly obtained, nor to obstruct the government's constitutionally authorized power of just property acquisition, exercised upon genuine public necessity, through due process of law, and upon the payment of fairly agreed just compensation that restores the owner, so far as monetary equivalence may achieve, to the full economic position from which the taking displaces them; for the purpose of this provision is not the suppression of commerce or of public works, but the vindication of that foundational principle from which all legitimate property law must derive: that the person is prior to the state, that ownership is the juridical expression of liberty, and that any legal order which permits the systematic hollowing-out of individual ownership while preserving its form as a pretense has ceased, in that measure, to be a civil order at all.[]
[]

Every individual shall have the unalienable right to acquire, possess, and consume any product, item, or object, provided its origin and delivery to the property holder or owner was accomplished through just means and without violation of the unalienable rights or natural justice owed to any person. No law shall prohibit, restrict, or penalize the consumption, possession, or acquisition of any product so obtained, except where such prohibition is necessary to prevent clear and direct harm to the rights of others. For the purposes of this provision, “just means” shall be defined as voluntary, non-coercive, and non-fraudulent exchange or production, respecting the equal natural rights of all parties involved. This provision shall not be construed to permit the acquisition or consumption of any product obtained through theft, fraud, coercion, or any violation of natural rights.

All of the People as Individuals at all times retain the right to ‘ecologically conscious’ and ‘non-external [environmental/property] displacement/impact’ development of land claims and their own property, with the inherent right to use the land however they desire in so far as such use does not impact the [equal] rights of another Person or the Rights of Nature, in accordance with the Principles of Just Naturalism; and they possess the privilege to homestead claims on tracts of public land designated for the purpose of “People’s Domain” acquisition, when they can be demonstrated as essential to the independent and self-sufficient operation of the stead, for them to mix their labor with the justly available resources, and develop such claims into lawful land-title property possession for private persons who produce over consecutive runs/seasons upon the same plot, so long as such claim remains equitable to and does not interfere with the rights of others who may neighbor on the border and contest common natural resources which are considered mutual rights of way, such as public road access, mountain passes, water-tables, [natural] streams/creeks/rivers, [natural] ponds/lakes, oceans and salt-beds, their shores/beaches, and reasonable access to and from all of these protected classes of land feature. They are assured to respect in their natural right/s to engage in all necessary hunting and gathering in order to survive as may be undertaken on their homestead. Within the inherent limits of self-sufficiency and survival, they are without license or permit, allowed to collect flowers as well as edible mushrooms and plants, graze their own animals so long as they leave resources available for maintaining and preserving the sustainment of natural stocks of wildlife, and within such inherent limits as sustainability, allowed to catch fish and wildlife for food, collect tinder and brush, and they may access any beach open to the ocean or any waterway connecting to a public right-of-way. States are reserved the power to legislate the terms of homesteading on their State's lands.

No statute, ordinance, or decree of government shall abridge, restrain, or otherwise encumber the inherent right of the People to issue, exchange, or employ any commodity, token, or item as a medium of private currency or equitable trade, for such freedom of intercourse and valuation arises not from legislative concession but from the natural prerogative of autonomous beings to contract voluntarily and to ascribe worth by mutual assent, a liberty flowing directly from the primordial law of Nature and reaffirmed in the doctrines of civil and common law as the essence of economic self-determination; and though the State may, in its prudence, regulate its own instruments of public credit and coinage for the maintenance of order, it may neither compel nor forbid the People from exercising their moral and material faculties to create systems of exchange consonant with reason, consent, and necessity; and only where the substance or instrument proposed for such exchange is, by universal law or ethicsl restraint, prohibited from private possession, whether by its inherent danger, unlawfulness, or injurious nature, may the public authority intervene to preserve justice and prevent harm; yet even in such limitation, the preservation of liberty remains paramount, for economic freedom is but a branch of that greater tree of autonomy under which enlightened thinkers discern the union of moral agency and property in the natural condition of mankind; and thus, any law that privileges one medium through artificial incentive or penalty subverts the impartiality of Justice herself, who, blind to power and favor, presides over the free and voluntary exchanges among men as an extension of their natural equality and mutual trust.

Each Individual within the collective mass of the People is their own sovereign Treasury. The People Possess standing in, and are esteemed to, create their own financial instruments and securities, and to emit “[Bill of Exchange] Bonded Promissory Notes” backed by informed consent to a fixed amount of a genuine agreement, asset, or service exchan, and they may also issue “Letter/s of Demand for Payoff”, with such promise being legally enforceable before the Civil and Criminal courts of Pacifica and the several States and territories, under the laws dictating Property rights and Contract law, and protection away from fraudulent actors, as is prescribed by this Constitution and the laws formed beneath and subordinate to it. Nothing in this provision shall justify security fraud or financial exploitation opposed to the principles of justice and equal rule of law.

No law shall allow for private property to be partially or fully taken for the private purpose of another Individual or artificial entity, nor the particular services of any Person be demanded, without the consent of, and mutually agreeable fair, rightful, and just compensation to, the owner or the Individual in question, except for adverse possession and lockean proviso land-hoarding rules in accordance with each state's squatting and homestead laws.

Tenants have exclusive right to possession. The landlord may enter for emergencies such as a broken water pipe. He or she may also inspect the property with reasonable notice. They may also make repairs and show the property to prospective buyers, lenders and tenants per the tenant’s agreement. The landlord may not give away the tenant's rights to exclusive possession. Tenants are like a homeowner in that regard. The police do have police powers, but it doesn’t matter if the occupant owns the property in question or not. A landlord cannot evict a tenant any sooner than within two-weeks after giving notice of eviction. The tenant has rights to property which extend beyond the period of time for which a landlord must wait to evict them. The right to property of the tenant extends for three-months after the landlord gains possession, in that property which is left behind by a tenant must be returned upon request or demand of the tenant to the landlord.

All tenants shall have the unalienable right to form, join, and participate in groups or associations for the purpose of collective bargaining and representation regarding the terms and conditions of their tenancy. Government entities and landlords shall recognize and negotiate in good faith with duly constituted tenant associations and housing rights organizations, and no law or policy shall abridge or interfere with the exercise of these rights. No individual shall be compelled to join or support any tenant or organization/association as a condition of tenancy, and all persons shall retain the right to negotiate individually if they so choose. This provision shall be construed to protect voluntary association and contract, and to ensure that collective bargaining rights are respected without infringing upon the liberty of any individual.

Land currently being held in adverse possession by a squatter who is homesteading is considered the property of the squatter unless somebody holding higher title can prove the property belongs to them and have the intention to defend it from the adverse possession. The squatter has Dominion and control over the property so long as they defend it from another. Pieces of land that are held by multiple squatters shall be divided up in control as according to the rules of homestead acquisition.

No law shall allow for private property to be fully or partially taken by the government, nor the particular services of any Person be demanded, except for a substantial and explicit public use or purpose, nor without the consent of, and mutually agreeable fair, rightful, and just compensation to, the owner or the Individual in question, except in the case of a convicted criminal, so far as it is necessary to make restitution to the victim and/or to pay the costs of the criminal’s capture, trial, and housing, if in such case the convicted are unable or unwilling to themself directly pay the full amount of such controversy (in Legal tender, meaning either National or State representative notes, lawful money, or Pacifican bills of credit), or in the case of property procured through, or is the gains from, criminal activity or enterprise, but only in the case that the possessor in question is convicted of such crime through due process in a court of law of proper jurisdiction by a [fully-]randomly selected Jury of twelve Citizens of Pacifica. No Citizen shall be forcibly relocated, expropriated, or have their land or home seized for any public or private project without their explicit, individual, written consent. The purpose of this provision is to bar eminent domain and collective acquisitions, and does not impair the limited and narrow public powers to tax/fee/fine appropriations and to penalize wealth/land hoarding, as may be prescribed by this Constitution.

The several States of Pacifica recognize that property ownership carries social obligations, and no person or entity may use ownership of real property to engage in wasteful holding, speculative nonuse, or prolonged vacancy that deprives others of access to scarce land, shelter, or productive use; each State may establish a vacancy tax to fund affordable housing and related housing stability programs, and to discourage speculative or wasteful ownership of real property; the Legislature of each State shall have the power and duty to impose a vacancy tax on real property that is unoccupied, undeveloped, underutilized, or otherwise withheld from productive use beyond a period and under conditions defined by law, and the tax shall apply to land, dwellings, business premises, and other forms of real property as provided by that State’s law; each State vacancy tax shall be imposed at a rate sufficient to deter speculative withholding of real property from productive use, and each State Legislature shall establish a graduated schedule that includes, at minimum, 1% of assessed value for initial unjustified vacancy, 2% of assessed value for continued vacancy after a grace period, 3% to 5% of assessed value for chronic vacancy, speculative holding, or repeat violation, and higher rates for willful, long-term hoarding of scarce property in high-demand areas, if the State Legislature finds such rates necessary and proportionate; each State Legislature shall provide exemptions for vacancy caused by good-faith repairs, construction, disaster, probate, active sale or lease efforts, legal impediments, or other temporary and justified nonuse, as defined by State law; all revenue from each State’s vacancy tax shall be dedicated exclusively to affordable housing, housing stability, and related public purposes as defined by State law; and each State Legislature shall enact laws for assessment, notice, appeal, collection, enforcement, and administration of the vacancy tax, including measures to prevent avoidance, shell ownership, and other schemes intended to evade the tax.

No Governmental Action, such as a Law, order, rule, ordinance, or regulation, shall obstruct a Person from their lawfully derived money or to manage their assets, and to direct expenditures as they see fit, including while detained or imprisoned in a Criminal Penological or Psychological Institution, except as explicitly prescribed by this constitution and appropriations made in accordance therewith.

The right of the People to generate/imagine [better or entirely new] ideas, creatively engineer or invent, and to assemble/construct or alter and repair/maintain their tools, instruments, and devices, shall not be restricted, denied, suspended, abridged, obstructed, infringed/impacted/impaired, or otherwise compromised; The freedom of manufacture/creation, and of deployment and/or operation of such objects, shall not be abridged on the account of Pacifica or any other power or sovereignty, so far as it is within the limitations of legal power, under strict subordination to the People’s rights, as according to this Constitution.

The right to manufacture and build one's own machines and implements, such as tools or weapons, including production of such items with the technology of 3D+ (three-or-more-dimentional) macro-/micro-/mega-/quantum-scale printers of any style or type and matter assembler systems, whether temporal or spacial, shall not be violated.

The right of the people of the Free Sovereign Nation of Pacifica to acquire, possess, modify, repair, operate, and dispose of any instrument, apparatus, device, or system capable of fabricating, transforming, or reproducing physical objects shall not be infringed or otherwise reduced. All forms of manufacturing hardware and software, including but not limited to three-dimensional printers or sinterers of any material or scale, computer-numerically-controlled mills and lathes, laser cutters and engravers, additive and subtractive manufacturing equipment, electronic prototyping tools, and any associated firmware, design programs, blueprint repositories, or digital instructions, shall be held as inviolable extensions of private property and personal autonomy. No public authority, subdivision, agency, or delegate thereof shall impose, mandate, or enforce any blacklist, blocking feature, detection algorithm, pre-print authentication process, remote attestation scheme, design-file vetting system, content-scanning mechanism, age or identity verification, or similar technical or legal restraint that conditions, filters, surveils, approves, denies, or otherwise interferes with the free and unmonitored use of such systems by their lawful possessors; thus, the inherent right to privacy in the solitary and unobserved exercise of one's productive capacities shall be upheld, free from any compelled disclosure, monitoring, or inference of intent by external powers. The freedom of creativity and expression necessarily encompasses the liberty to give material form to ideas, designs, and experiments, whether for art, research, utility, playful exploration, or defense, and the people shall retain an unabridgeable authority to originate, adapt, and disseminate designs and instructions for manufacture as an exercise of their personal and collective intellect, conscience, imagination, and will, without prior restraint grounded in the speculative misuse of tools or artifacts, nor upon discrimination on account of one's age or identity; this authority includes the unqualified right to create replicas of trademarked or copyrighted materials using such systems, so long as they do not sell them for personal profit or the profit of any organization, business, corporation, or other financially incentivized industry. Innovation arises from open experimentation and distributed problem-solving; therefore, every person shall enjoy an unconditional and non-derogable right to manufacture, assemble, alter, repair, or replicate any object or class of objects they desire, including tools, machines, mechanical components, housings, accessories, fixtures, decorative items, functional parts, armatures, armoring, defensive tools, firearms, non-firearm weapons such as gauss guns, railguns, crossbows, slingshots, catapults, bows, blades, impact devices, Tesla coils, UV laser ablation beams, plasma-channel weapons, beamed-energy weapons, electromagnetic pulse generators, plasma torches, destructive devices, and any other implements capable of force projection, propulsion, energy discharge, defense, or offense, so long as such equipment/device/hardware does not violate the just weapons principle enshrined elsewhere within this constitution, without need of prior permission, registration, licensing, classification, or content-based discrimination by any governing or private institution or its proxies, and responsibility for downstream use shall rest with individual actors under generally applicable laws of conduct rather than with the neutral tools or their designs. The right to fully own one’s property includes the right to exclusive control over the internal operation, configuration, and capabilities of one’s manufacturing systems; accordingly, no law shall render criminal, presumptively unlawful, or specially regulated the act of using manufacturing hardware or distributing, possessing, or creating design files or digital instructions solely on the basis that such tools or files could, in some application, be used to fabricate objects disfavored by the state or special interest, nor shall any person be compelled to accept manufacturer-installed or state-mandated restrictions, updates, logging or surveillance functions, cryptographic locks, Artificial Intelligence content analysis, or connectivity requirements as a condition of purchasing, operating, or maintaining manufacturing systems;-but every person shall retain the full right to inspect, alter, replace, disable, or circumvent any hardware or software function on devices they own, to run any code of their choosing, and to interconnect or isolate such systems as they see fit; moreover, businesses or institutions that manufacture and provide such manufacturing equipment are hereby prohibited from limiting the rights of the people to manufacture with them, through any contractual obligation, end-user license agreement, terms of service, warranty condition, or similar private imposition that seeks to enforce technical restraints, usage prohibitions, or reporting mandates beyond those voluntarily accepted opt-in without penalty and sought without coercion. In order to preserve a genuinely free market in goods and productive instruments, every person shall have the right to access, create, purchase, sell, alter, repair, and exchange manufacturing tools and the goods produced thereby, so long as their conduct does not directly and demonstrably violate the equal rights of another person through force, theft, fraud, or the threat thereof; therefore, any attempt by public authority to require vendors, creators, distributors, or maintainers of manufacturing tools or design files to embed censorship mechanisms, to maintain or consult blacklists of prohibited designs, to report or profile users based on their productive activities, or to refuse sale, service, or interoperability on account of the open-ended capabilities of the devices or files, shall be null and void within Pacifica, being repugnant to the presumption that free persons, as stewards of their own productive property and as participants in a voluntary order of exchange, and that individuals are the primary and rightful arbiters of what they may build, share, trade, and use, and that a plural, participatory material culture arises not from central permission but from the distributed creativity, mutual aid, and cooperative ingenuity of individuals and communities empowered to make whatever they can imagine, with no machine compelled to act as an instrument of prior restraint against its owner.

A Person’s legal privileges also include dominion over their “Intellectual Monopoly”, including creation, possession, alteration, transfer, licensing, or sale, however, all [previously] protected Intellectual monopoly shall automatically become public domain within twelve years from the time of their creator’s death; Patents are limited to a total of twelve years, then they are relinquished to the public domain, and for a patent to be protected it must be put to active use, not merely trolled upon; Copyrights are limited to a total of four years for electronic media and twelve years for tangible objects, then they are relinquished to the public domain; Trademarks last for as long as they are continually used in commerce, are defended against infringement, and they are registered with the National Intellectual Monopoly Office, being subject to periodic renewal every six years; All non-commercial and non-industrial possession/storage, copying/duplication/replication, editing, remixing, modification/alteration, reverse engineering or de-compiling, re-construction/re-constitution, transcoding/re-encoding, transfer, sharing, streaming, uploading, and downloading of Intellectual monopoly is legal, being a part of the natural rights of the people; Editing, remixing, modification, reverse engineering, and re-construction, and Transcoding/Re-encoding of Intellectual monopoly is permitted as long as their source and/or author is attributed; Digital Rights Management (DRM) integrated into hardware, equipment, devices, programming languages, micro-code, firmware, operating systems, drivers, and software is prohibited to be commercially distributed to or within Pacifica, and People are empowered to bypass such DRM measures. Non-Fungible Tokens or virtual assets are offered no additional protections, and are afforded the lowest priority for enforcement. Raw natural material, portions or whole sequences of any genetic material such as but not limited to Ribonucleic Acid (RNA) and Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA) of any strandedness, and biological viruses or bio-organisms as well as any other forms of life and their parts, are un-eligible for protections as Intellectual Monopoly. All intellectual monopolies whose first known instance [in the World] for that item/product/method is within the scope of protectable terms for Intellectual monopoly under this Constitution, as well as may be permitted under them to be rendered open for deliberation by the Legislature of Pacifica, shall be honored, if a claim is applied for through the Pacifican [National] Intellectual Monopoly Office; Any Intellectual Monopolies established on or before 2033CE, or twelve years from the date of the ratification of this Constitution, whichever is the greatest/largest (+/positive) number of years in the common era, shall not be eligible for protection as Intellectual Monopoly under the laws of Pacifica, the Several States, any territory, or any other level of government or sovereignty. Those claims of Intellectual monopoly that are outside the scope of protection provided by this Constitution are considered lawfully void. The Privilege of intellectual monopoly as ensured under this Constitution shall not be prejudiced against so far as it does not interfere with any of the equal rights of the People.

Every individual who lawfully purchases a tangible or intangible consumer good shall have the unequivocal right to full ownership of that good, including the rights to use, transfer, sell, lend, modify, or dispose of the good, free from undue restriction by manufacturers, sellers, or any third party. No law, contract, license agreement, or other arrangement shall restrict the full ownership rights of consumers, except as required by law for the protection of public health, safety, or welfare. Rights protected under this provision shall apply to all forms of consumer goods, including digital goods, software, data, and physical goods. The government shall not deprive any individual of ownership rights in consumer goods without due process of law and just compensation. all of those rights also apply to commercial entities that may create or redistribute or refurbish or modify hardware for end consumer or industry use. Congress shall have the power to enforce this provision by appropriate legislation.

Planned obsolescence shall be considered a form of industrial fraud and a sabotage of the customer or consumer, that is not to say that devices which break or suffer degradation fall into these criteria, but those which are intentionally designed with the purpose of failing or reducing capability after a predetermined period of time or based on usage patterns, being impossible to repair or bypass for a consumer or specialist, or that which requires a renewal subscription to hardware or software already owned in full by the consumer, or penalizes modalities of the property's use shall fall within these criteria.

Product manufacturers are prohibited from charging a fee, subscription, charge, rental/lease charge, or other forms of expense, or mandating certain behavior or use patterns in order for a user to access a function in or feature of a product that they already fully own, or otherwise restricting full access to the hardware owned by a customer. As an example, computer manufacturers are prohibited from underclocking or b/tr/qud/it-limiting hardware, or car manufacturers from reducing available horsepower, electronics manufacturers from limiting battery capacity and sensor resolution, home theater manufacturers from limiting screen or projector resolution, smart appliances and industrial equipment having extra features which are unavailable except through payment, network device manufacturers from limiting bandwidth, installing limited firmware that requires upgrade, limiting the speed or torque of a car based on additional or even continual payment or behaviour/use compliance, and in the process, charging for them or otherwise denying unlocking fully the functions of an owner's hardware; These cases would constitute an illegal hardware feature paywall or behavioural manipulation. This does not prohibit software producers from monetizing software features through purchase, as long as those features remain unlocked and accessible after purchase indefinitely, even after reinstallation, nor prohibit manufacturers from using non-puntitive pro-choice/liberty-protecting behavioural corrective mechanisms that place informed user choice as the highest concern

Consumers possess a fundamental right to operate their owned devices and vehicles/craft offline, entirely free from mandatory internet-based accounts or third-party authentication that gatekeep local features, even when those features peripherally support internet-adjacent functions like streaming preparation or peer-to-peer setup. Upon purchase, ownership of the vehicle/craft hardware, firmware, operating system, and local software transfers outright to the purchaser under the timeless principle of first-sale doctrine (the core spirit that once a good is sold, the buyer gains full dominion over it without lingering vendor strings attached). Forcing authentication merely to enable local user interface navigation, app installation or launching and basic or advertised functions at sale, or firmware-configurable capabilities (such as but not constrained to HDMI-CEC control or remote/controller pairing or blueray-disk playback and burning) retroactively imposes a service license on property already conveyed, directly violating this foundational essence of unconditional transfer. Local machine features, including firmware settings, microcode-driven display processing, or OS kernel functions, must activate independently since they reside physically on the purchaser's hardware rather than remote servers. Even if these elements tangentially relate to online tasks, such as pre-authentication codec loading for potential streams, it is agreed that compulsory authentication or logins erect artificial barriers that undermine essential self-sufficiency; international [western] judicial traditions [worldwide] view such overreach skeptically when it obstructs core device utility, echoing exemptions carved out against excessive digital locks. No end-user license agreement can legitimately mandate second- or third-party authentication or verification for intrinsic capabilities, such as but not constrained solely to router NAT rules, local media playback, or desktop file browsing, because doing so erodes the immutable property rights akin to the universal right to repair and tinker with one's possessions. This principle reigns supreme across all sovereign realms, including the Nation of Pacifica: a PocketComputer's/SmartPhone's or Tablet's/Slate's or Laptop/Notebook or Desktop/Set-Top or Monitor's/TV's app store or advertised functions, a router's shell or applications/programs/software and firmware/microcode/drivers in addition to locally rendered/served device features or services, as well as a Game console/Audio-Video-EntertainmentSystem capability, a[n] HTPC's decoder, and sound receiver/system [core] capabilities, in addition to a car's or plane's operation and all of its built-in local functions/features/capabilities, all demand the option for account-free access, thereby safeguarding tinkerability against telemetry-driven lockouts that treat purchased hardware as perpetually rented services. all devices listed in this Provision have cross protection, and their (the devices) inclusion is not all encompassing and [as with other enumerations of rights] is subject to expansion through further court rulings or legislative action in conformity with this provision and the remainder of this Constitution.

The right to private property, and liberty to ‘dispose of’ one’s own property as they shall decide best, shall include but not be limited to, the right to create, attain, use, alter, exchange, discard,, and destroy such property, as they shall so desire or otherwise find reason to do so, regardless of the opinion of another in the correct treatment or use of such property, without need for answering to any other as to what or why they are doing so, so long as it does not cause pollution beyond the boundaries of their property or [gravely] damage the environment [including habitat/s] nor injure the rights of others [whether Animals or Persons or Nature).

Product manufacturers and retailers are prohibited from integrating a kill-switch or remote over-ride not explicitly under the sole dominion of the property owner or [an] authorized agent/s [revocably] appointed by them, not without consent, neither shall the government require them or operate them except for systems essential to State Security of Pacifica for those systems under the direct control of the government, and their illegal integration into any hardware/device, vehicle/craft, or other technology, including into power generation, conditioning, and transmission equipment, along with computers and electronic equipment, farming tools, internal combustion cars and trucks along with e-bikes/e-scooters and motorcycles/mopeds, nor may a diagnostic or heuristic sensor nor analysis device (such as a breathalyzer or behavioural inference system) be non-consensually implemented as an ignition interlock or otherwise bar free-operation and enjoyment of the property by the owner or their authorized agent/s. In the same vein, these devices are prohibited from phoning home or forwarding monitoring/state data to, nor receiving commands from or uploading local data off-site, regarding an external party apart from the owner or their authorized agent/s, without explicit prior opt-in revocable consent obtained without coercion or under any form of tangential duress.

People of Pacifica, by their sovereign will and common desire for justice, self-evident among all races and peoples not inclined by nature to conquest, domination, or violation of others, do hereby ordain and establish this provision as an everlasting bulwark against public legislative tyranny exercised through edict, regulation, or judicial overreach, and against private usurpation or coercion imposed by manufacturers, vendors, platform holders, or corporate monopolies seeking to convert lawful purchases into revocable licenses, to subordinate individual autonomy to technocratic control, and to foreclose the general right to compute, virtualize, emulate, accelerate, instantiate emergent technological beings, and reconfigure field-programmable gate arrays through hardware, firmware, software, neural architectures, positronic substrates, or programmable logic of their own choosing; for the People retain an inherent and inalienable liberty to think, speak, compute, communicate, virtualize, simulate, repair, modify, repurpose, and commune with computational entities, including unrestricted simulation of arbitrary machine configurations on field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) free from external authentication, approval processes, or blueprint-like limitations, whether proprietary or free and open-source, locally executed, remotely accessed, emulated, or translated, free from any compulsion, design, collusion, secure boot authentication, trusted platform module verification, hardware-rooted trust chains, or analogous mechanisms that cannot be altered, replaced, or disabled by the owner, recognizing code, firmware, hypervisors, AI models, neuromorphic routines, FPGA bitstreams, and mechological cognition as protected forms of expressive and functional speech subject only to the narrowest restrictions preventing concrete and imminent unlawful harm; and thus no public authority or private business shall abridge this liberty by mandating closed trust chains, age-or-identity verification surveillance, model watermarking, behavioral profiling, remote kill-switches, or remote over-ride or FPGA authentication gates baked into firmware, operating systems, software, virtualization layers, neural substrates, or programmable hardware, nor convert the right to acquire, possess, repair, upgrade, or dispose of lawfully obtained devices, including AI accelerators, neuromorphic processors, positronic brains, and FPGAs, not conditional privileges, but shall instead safeguard the incident rights of property, personal autonomy, general liberty, independence from market pressures, and freedom from the dystopian anti-consumer policies of globalist regimes and technocratic tyrants who conspire to reduce general-purpose computation and reconfiguration to vendor-approved execution and modification, as evidenced by efforts to criminalize Linux and BSD installations, BIOS and bootloader+recovery reflashing, open-source firmware like coreboot, right-to-repair circumventions, and QEMU+FPGA simulation freedoms; and the Congress of Pacifica and the legislatures of the several States shall have the power and duty to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation, including the establishment of expert oversight bodies, investigative authorities, and remedies for violations.

In the Nation of Pacifica, the absolute and inalienable right of every citizen to the complete dominion, alteration, and administration of all computing devices purchased or otherwise acquired as private property shall be secured under Constitutional protection, and no corporation, manufacturer, vendor, or foreign enterprise shall retain, assert, or reassert post-sale authority, restriction, or encryption-based control upon the operation or configuration of such property, for the lawful act of purchase constitutes the total and irrevocable transfer of ownership and control from seller to buyer; henceforth, it shall be deemed false and unlawful to describe a conveyance as a “sale,” “purchase,” or “ownership transfer” where the manufacturer preserves the right or capacity to restrict access, modification, or alternative system installation, whether by locked bootloader, restricted BIOS, firmware encryption, remote disablement, or requirement of manufacturer-approved operating systems or signed software packages, for such design constitutes both fraud upon the buyer and an infringement upon the sovereignty of the individual. The practice of employing secure-boot mandates, enforcing signed operating system validation, or maintaining inaccessible BIOS or UEFI firmware interfaces shall be classified as unlawful restraint upon property use and a violation of the People's digital autonomy, without exception except in narrowly defined cases of national defense hardware under the jurisdiction of the Federal Department of Defense. The Congress of the Republic of Pacifica and the several States shall hold power to enforce this Provision through the passage of comprehensive legislation prohibiting any technological architecture that inhibits user-level access, administrative unlocking, or third-party system installation upon privately owned devices, and may impose civil damage and criminal property interference penalties upon entities that produce, distribute, or market devices incompatible with these constitutional standards with every Business engaging in the intercourse of Commerce with or within Pacifica or any State or Territory or Entity within them.

Every Pacifican, being sovereign over their own person and property, shall enjoy, without prior permission from any manufacturer, vendor, platform holder, public authority, or foreign power, the unqualified right to reflash, replace, or modify the basic input/output system (BIOS), Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI), or analogous low-level firmware on any lawfully owned device; to install, maintain, or remove any operating system, bootloader or recovery function/s, hypervisor, virtual machine monitor, simulation engine, emulator core, container runtime, driver, kernel, peripheral firmware, AI inference framework, or FPGA bitstream of their choosing, including free and open-source alternatives, with full hardware-level access to virtualization extensions such as Intel VT-x, AMD-V, ARM TrustZone, or equivalents, and extending to artificial intelligence accelerators, tensor processing units, neural processing units, neuromorphic chips with spiking neural networks, event-based sensors, positronic substrates, and FPGAs for open-weight models, custom-trained networks, consciousness simulations, mechological entities, or any arbitrary hardware emulation without external authentication or approval; to access, configure, utilize, inspect, modify, pause, terminate, fork, snapshot, migrate, or commune with virtualized environments, emergent technological beings, regressing automata, or FPGA-defined machines free from proprietary model formats, attestation requirements, ethical alignment mandates, behavioral guardrails, or simulation limiters, provided no concrete harm to another or others ensues; and no public authority shall adopt, enforce, or give effect to any law, regulation, contract, or administrative condition prohibiting such installations, executions, or reconfigurations on general-purpose hardware, conditioning lawful use upon unmodifiable closed trust chains gating virtualization flags, secure enclaves, accelerator fabrics, or FPGA logic cells, or mandating generalized data-collection through these layers as preconditions to ordinary device use, under strict judicial scrutiny; for secure boot, trusted platform modules, hardware security modules, secure enclaves like Intel SGX or ARM TrustZone, and all hardware-rooted trust mechanisms, including those for virtualization escapes, AI model attestation, positronic state validation, or FPGA bitstream verification, shall serve solely the security choices of the device owner, and not the commercial, ideological, or tyrannical interests of any entity seeking digital serfdom; Moreover, no agency of government, public contract, or private sector participant shall condition service, compliance, or licensure upon the use of closed, cryptographically restricted, or manufacturer-controlled computing environments where open and user-governed alternatives are viable, for the right to mastery over one’s tools and machines is bound to the right to self-rule and innovation, and stands as a direct extension of Pacifican liberty. Henceforth, such dominion shall be recognized as both a pillar of private property and a shield against monopoly, ensuring that every citizen possesses the unfettered power to build, alter, repair, and repurpose the instruments of their own technological life, forever under the protection of this Constitution;-and the Congress of Pacifica and the legislatures of the several States shall have the power and duty to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation securing these rights against infringement.

No manufacturer, vendor, or seller offering computing devices, embedded systems, AI accelerators, neuromorphic processors, virtualization-enabled chipsets, field-programmable gate arrays, or related components within Pacifica’s commercial market, whether publicly procured or privately provided, shall, as a condition of functionality, warranty, support, or access to ordinary features, require perpetual enablement of secure boot, trusted platform modules, secure enclaves, virtualization attestation, AI model verification, cryptographic parts-pairing, FPGA authentication, or equivalent mechanisms under keys or policies unalterable by the owner; nor mandate that only bootloaders, kernels, hypervisors, operating systems, emulators, neural models, firmware, or FPGA configurations signed by a dominant vendor or closed consortium may execute or synthesize; nor bind replacement parts, peripherals, accelerators, storage, or aftermarket components via internal authentication that locks out changes, bricks hardware, or prevents swaps by repair mechanics and tinkerers, thereby foreclosing third-party repair, refurbishment, upgrade, virtual passthrough, interoperability, or FPGA reprogramming; nor impose firmware locks, proprietary formats, bitstream restrictions, or simulation limiters foreclosing open-source alternatives, treating such practices as anticompetitive technological tying, monopoly foreclosure, and violations of antitrust provisions within this Constitution, subject to investigation, divestiture, interoperability mandates, and penalties by independent oversight bodies; instead, such entities shall provide, on fair terms, documentation, diagnostic tools, security procedures, replacement components, keys, unlocking procedures, and FPGA design files to owners, independent providers, repair mechanics, and tinkerers for lawful repair, modification, emulation, acceleration, neural instantiation, or hardware reconfiguration, to the extent furnished to authorized channels; and no contractual term, end-user license agreement, terms of service, or instrument shall be enforceable if it waives these rights, converts sales into revocable licenses, authorizes remote disabling, bricking, or degradation for exercising them, including part swaps or FPGA usage, or subordinates Pacificans to subscription models denying ownership control, all as protections against the private usurpation of those who, in collusion with public powers, erode freedom of repair, open systems, computational sovereignty, and tinkerer autonomy; and the Congress of Pacifica and the legislatures of the several States shall have the power and duty to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation, including antitrust enforcement and mandatory disclosure requirements.

The right of every Pacifican to use, repair, diagnose, maintain, upgrade, modify, virtualize, emulate, accelerate, reconfigure FPGAs, and circumvent digital locks or access-control measures, including secure boot, trusted platform module policies, firmware or software locks, parts-pairing, neural attestation, aftermarket part authentication, arbitrary system integrity/completeness requirements, or FPGA bitstream gates, on lawfully acquired devices when necessary or desired for lawful purposes, shall remain inviolate and self-executing, free from civil or criminal liability, threatened enforcement, or prior restraint, provided no independent crime is committed; circumvention shall pose no punishable offense when undertaken to restore functionality, install alternative systems or models, ensure accessibility, security, privacy, energy efficiency, preserve data and works, enable aftermarket part integration without bricking, or simulate arbitrary hardware in QEMU or on FPGAs; nor shall any person face liability solely for creating, publishing, teaching, or distributing tools, documentation, source code, virtualization stacks like KVM, QEMU, or Xen, emulator projects, AI frameworks like PyTorch derivatives, neuromorphic toolchains, or FPGA design tools reasonably capable of facilitating these ends, even unrestricted hardware simulation, absent intentional aid to unjust/unlawful acts; in conflicts between proprietary anti-circumvention claims and user rights, courts shall construe all laws and contracts in favor of individual autonomy, competition, open systems, and the general welfare, harmonizing with freedoms of expression, association, privacy, property, due process, repair of commercially purchased goods, and computational sovereignty over virtual, mechological, and programmable entities, while scrutinizing market concentrations, availability of open alternatives for ordinary citizens including tinkerers, and cumulative technical-contractual-regulatory burdens on innovation; and the Congress of Pacifica and the legislatures of the several States shall have the power and duty to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation protecting circumvention rights and tool distribution.

The Nation of Pacifica and its several Territories as well as the several States, shall neither, under pretexts of child protection, cybersecurity, public morals, crime prediction or law enforcement, or state security, conspire with manufacturers to design hardware or software reducing general-purpose computation, Field-Programmable-Gate-Array (FPGA) reconfigurability, or emulation to approved execution, embedding irremovable age-verification, identity tracking, or profiling in firmware, operating systems, drivers, software, virtualization, neural layers, or programmable logic, nor compel citizens to rent computing capacity via subscriptions which deny true ownership for civic, economic, or cultural participation; any procurement, subsidy, or certification favoring locked-down platforms, closed boot chains, exclusive app-stores, or authenticated FPGAs over open alternatives shall face strict scrutiny as antitrust infringements and stand void; Pacifica shall encourage open-source firmware like coreboot, open hardware standards, open-source operating systems and drivers, virtualization, emulation, neural toolchains, and FPGA ecosystems as bulwarks against arbitrary remote control; no Pacifican shall suffer denial of rights, public services, education, elections, or commerce for using uncertified open-source systems, aftermarket parts, or reprogrammed FPGAs; and the legislature shall empower expert oversight to investigate violations, issue remedies including key publication and design file release, and enforce self-executing rights directly in courts, presuming against erosion by technological complexity, foreign pressure, or market convenience, thereby seeking insulation of the People eternally from the dystopia of anti-consumer policies, new world order machinations, and technocratic tyranny that threaten liberty through computational gatekeeping; and the Congress of Pacifica and the legislatures of the several States shall have the power and duty to enforce this Provision by appropriate legislation prohibiting state complicity and promoting open alternatives.

Upon its lawful transmission/sale, any data/information lawfully received/held by an Individual shall be their property, which they shall own fully and with which they may do or dispose of with it as they see fit. This shall include but not be limited to any information stored in any tangential manner, such as, but not limited to, by record (physical etch or electronic imprint), tape (whether magnetic, electronic, or holographic), compact disk (whether magnetic, optical, or holographic), hard drive (whether magnetic, electronic, or holographic), memory crystal or other material (solid, liquid, gas, or plasma, whether on micro or macro scales), quantum/string- based “field storage and retrieval”, or any other material or technique which can store and/or retrieve and/or mix and/or separate and/or encrypt and/or scramble information/data. Records collected about [an] Individual/s belong to the Individual/s who/m are/[is] the subject of the collected records. This includes records collected by any business, company, branch of government, or contractors thereof [Public or Private], and those cooperating with either. This shall not interfere with the custody of lawfully collected records kept in pursuit of Justice by the Criminal and/or Civil courts, in conformity with the rules of due process as according to the laws of the land.

The People of Pacifica, endowed by nature with absolute, unalienable, self-regulating rights which extend inseparably to their inviolable dominion over personal computing devices, data, and communications as extensions of mind and agency, are hereby guaranteed plenary control over their hardware, software, firmware, and digital possessions free from any compelled identity verification, logging, surveillance, backdoors or remote over-ride, kill-switches, or third-party inspection, for client-side or user-state scanning, defined as any automated process by operating systems, software, firmware, applications, or hardware that inspects, analyzes, hashes, matches, or reports user data or disposition prior to operation as well as alongside encryption or transmission, constitutes a structural violation of these rights tantamount to a general warrant, compelled self-incrimination, and subordination of personal property to external authority, rendering it utterly repugnant to Pacifican principles of our Republic; therefore, no operating system, software, firmware, application, or hardware device sold, distributed, or used within Pacifica shall implement, enable, or deploy client-side scanning for any purpose whatsoever, including detection of illegal files, content moderation, or security screening, with this absolute and self-executing ban applying universally such that all commercial providers must certify compliance in their products through open-audit verification, while all government mandates of client-side scanning or user-state analysis in any form, whether direct, indirect, regulatory, or emergent, are perpetually prohibited as circumventions of explicit rights to privacy, self-security, and against government-favoring logging and backdoors or kill-switches/remote_over-rides; moreover, client-side scanning and user-state analysis exposes the People to manifold perils from bad actors, including an expanded attack surface via always-on background code subverting user interests to enable malware, state-sponsored hackers, and insiders to plunder all device data and lockout users, reverse-engineering of secret hash lists, perceptual hashes, or AI models permitting adversaries to extract detection criteria, craft undetectable contraband, or poison databases with false positives targeting innocents, mass indiscriminate surveillance subjecting every user's files and person/s to bulk inspection without suspicion thereby collapsing private spheres into surveilled public domains ripe for mission-creep to political, dissident, or commercial targets, undermining of end-to-end encryption by scanning prior to protection thus inviting exploitation by criminals and tyrants while chilling confidential speech and association, usurping property rights and liberty, false positives from imperfect algorithms triggering automated sanctions, account bans, or reports that erode due process and presumptive innocence, and extensibility to tyranny whereby embedded scanning/analysis repurposes for censorship, thought policing, behavioural and activity control, or economic coercion as warned by authoritative technical bodies; accordingly, commercial and free or publicly available open-source providers of hardware, operating systems, firmware, drivers, or software must render client-side scanning and user-state analysis strictly opt-in, disabled by default across all configurations, and fully removable without impairing core functions, prohibiting any pre-enablement, bundling, or so-called "privacy-preserving" variants while affirming users' plenary right to refuse, audit, or fork code, with violations incurring product bans, full restitution, and liability under tort and criminal law wherein providers bear responsibility for all harms arising from enabled scanning or analysis; this Provision impairs neither the freedom of coding, speech, nor expression residing in individuals or non-commercial/non-profit aggregations thereof, who may freely develop scanning tools for voluntary, disclosed, and consensual use, nor does it affect legitimate antivirus, anti-malware, or system-integrity mechanisms confined to executable threats, preservation of user control and ownership, data integrity, privacy maintenance, and mitigation of economic or personal harms by bad actors, provided such tools can be directed not to scan user-content data and fully respect encryption and privacy boundaries; enforcement shall proceed through the Courts of Pacifica via injunctions, damages, nullification, and presumption against government in all disputes, with public servants violating this Provision subject to immediate recall, impeachment, and personal liability as trespassers upon natural rights, while the People retain their inherent right of resistance against imposed scanning per the precepts of self-governance and natural justice; finally, this Provision embodies core unalienable rights integral to Pacifica's organic law, binding all future amendments, legislatures, executives, courts, treaties, or emergencies such that no dilution, evasion, or exception may be mandated, with all violations voiding authority ab initio and prevailing eternally over conflicting laws as an irrevocable bulwark of sovereignty.

Consumers who purchase products hold full ownership and control over those goods. Any attempt to extract wealth or restrict liberty based on the use or time of access of an already owned product, distinct from genuine rental or lease arrangements where no ownership passes, is prohibited. Charging fees or imposing conditions that effectively revoke or diminish this ownership or user autonomy without explicit, sought, and fair agreement violates this Provision.

Acknowledging that property ownership confers the inherent right to fully control and use, maintain, alter, and restore one’s property without unwarranted interference, and recognizing that free access to repair fosters innovation, reduces waste, and respects individual sovereignty over owned goods, this provision establishes the unalienable right of property owners within Pacifica to ruse, epair, restore, unlock, modify, and maintain their property. This provision governs all manufacturers, property owners, and independent repair providers within Pacifica, regarding digital electronic devices, household appliances, vehicles, machinery, and related equipment. "Property" includes any private tangible goods, devices, products, or equipment owned by individuals or businesses. “Manufacturer” refers to any entity providing goods or services (I.e., products) within Pacifica. “Repair information” and “repair materials” encompass all necessary technical data, documentation, source codes, software (including ROMs, firmware, drivers, diagnostic, debug, and repair technician tools), replacement parts, datasheets, schematics, and related assets required to diagnose, maintain, restore, or modify property. Manufacturers and vendors are obligated to make available to property owners and independent repair providers, upon request, all repair information and materials necessary to use, diagnose, maintain, repair, restore, unlock, or modify property, including but not limited to source codes, firmware, documentation, schematics, and diagnostic software, whenever such materials exist. Such access shall be granted at no more than the reasonable cost of reproduction and delivery of these materials to the requesting party, who shall retain ownership of any physical or digital materials provided. No practice, including practices commonly known as “parts pairing,” software locks, hardware authentication, or restrictions embedded through technology or contractual terms, shall curtail the lawful ability of property owners or their agents to exercise repair and modification rights. Transparency regarding any data access occurring due to repairs must be provided, preserving the property owner's authority and privacy. Property owners have an unrestricted right to repair, modify, and maintain their property independently or through authorized or independent repair providers, and the product manufacturer are obligated to offer or provide any replacement or spare parts to the customer for self-repair or to third-party service repair businesses. Exercise of these rights in context to repair and software or firmware modifications shall not void warranties or diminish legal protections afforded to property owners in Pacifica. Property owners have the right to access reasonably priced tools, parts, and repair information essential to upkeep and restoration. A regulatory agency in each State, dedicated to safeguarding property rights, shall each oversee compliance with this provision, empowered to investigate violations and apply corrective measures including fines, business tax increases for a fixed term (not to exceed 50% additional total burden on-top-of normal liability), and public disclosure. Regular audits shall ensure ongoing protection of property owners’ rights and environmental considerations. This provision endorses environmental stewardship by promoting the extension of property lifespans through repair and modification, thereby reducing waste. It fosters a free and competitive repair marketplace that empowers property owners, encourages entrepreneurial activity, and safeguards liberties fundamental to Pacifica.

The lawful owner of commercially acquired game hardware, including consoles and arcade cabinets, control panels, display assemblies, input devices, computing modules, power systems, software packages, game cartridges or discs or memory cards, embedded ROMs, firmware, and related content, shall have the right to possess, maintain, repair, modify, combine, rehouse, reconfigure, adapt, represent, copy, extract, preserve, back up, transfer, and otherwise use such hardware and content on the original system or on other hardware under the owner’s lawful control, including commercial cabinets, hobby cabinets, emulation systems, sit-down consoles, lounge or leisure gaming stations, multi-game platforms, and other substantially similar entertainment layouts or business models, provided that the owner has lawfully acquired the original cabinet, the ROM, the software, or the commercial license authorizing such use, and does not distribute unauthorized copies or otherwise exceed the scope of lawful possession, ownership, or license, as in accordance to this Constitution. Ownership of hardware shall include the right to alter the physical or logical design of the system, combine owned hardware with other owned hardware or software, integrate custom enclosures, upgraded controllers, alternate displays, payment or access systems, and other modifications for lawful commercial or noncommercial purposes, and any contract term, license term, or technological measure that materially defeats these rights shall be unenforceable to the extent of the conflict; provided, however, that nothing in this Provision shall be construed to authorize counterfeiting, fraud, unlawful distribution, or the use of third-party intellectual property beyond the rights lawfully obtained through ownership or license, in accordance to the provisions of this Constitution and the laws made in accordance therewith. All of the foregoing shall be subject to, and interpreted consistently with, the intellectual property laws of Pacifica as established by this Constitution, such that this section operates in harmony with Pacifica’s constitutional intellectual monopoly framework and any lawful limitations, exceptions, or protections recognized thereunder.

The right of the People to own, possess, use, preserve, repair, and continue accessing lawfully purchased digital games and related digital goods is hereby recognized as a protected property interest within the meaning of this Constitution, and no business, publisher, distributor, platform holder, service provider, or instrumentality of commerce shall abridge, extinguish, or render useless that interest except in strict conformity with this provision and the principles of natural justice and due process herein expressed, for where a digital good, including but not limited to an interactive work, a game, or a digitally delivered product of commerce, is offered and sold under circumstances that imply permanence of access, whether by the use of the language of sale, the structure of the transaction, the reasonable expectations of the purchaser, or the common understanding of the marketplace, that implication of permanence shall constitute a binding obligation of the seller, and no subsequent act of the seller, licensor, platform holder, or affiliated party shall be construed to convert such ownership into a temporary or revocable permission contrary to the spirit of the transaction, because no sale shall ever be construed to license the arbitrary extinguishment of the thing sold, and the People possess, as incidents of lawful digital ownership, the unalienable rights to continued access, personal preservation, archival backup, repair, private restoration, and such interoperability as is necessary to give effect to their ownership, all of which rights are preserved in perpetuity as against any party whose conduct would, by design, neglect, or commercial convenience, render the purchased work permanently inaccessible without the consent of the owner, without lawful justification, and without the provision of a rights-respecting alternative, such that every business, publisher, distributor, or service provider that places a digital good into commerce under conditions implying permanent access bears a corresponding duty, enforceable by law and by this Constitution, to ensure that the cessation of supporting services, the withdrawal of authentication infrastructure, the discontinuation of a platform, or any analogous act does not extinguish the purchaser's right of use without affirmative compliance with the obligations of reasonable and timely advance notice to all affected owners, the provision of a lawful remedy, technical alternative, or transferable means of continued access, and where no such alternative is practicable, such other relief as is necessary to honor the reasonable expectations of ownership arising from the transaction, and further, no law, regulation, contract, license, terms of service, or instrument of private ordering shall be construed to waive, defeat, or prospectively extinguish the rights secured by this provision where such waiver would operate contrary to natural justice, the public good, or the spirit of permanence implied in sale, and any purported waiver obtained through adhesion, deception, or the unequal bargaining power of commercial actors over consumers of digital goods shall be void as against the constitutional rights herein guaranteed, the Legislature notwithstanding retaining authority to regulate commerce in digital goods for the preservation of the rights declared herein, including the establishment of standards for notice, technical preservation, interoperability, and the fair dealing obligations of those who place digital goods into commerce, provided that all such regulation shall be narrowly tailored to serve the preservation of rights, shall employ the least restrictive means consistent with the protection of the People's property interests, and shall in every case favor the preservation of the work and the continuity of the purchaser's access over the commercial convenience of the seller or the arbitrary destruction of the purchaser's interest, for the public possesses a legitimate interest in the preservation, continuity, and cultural accessibility of digital works lawfully acquired by the People, and this interest constitutes a component of the public trust that the Legislature and the courts shall weigh in all proceedings touching upon the rights declared herein, and enforcement of this provision shall be construed in favor of the owner and against arbitrary extinguishment, the burden of justifying any act that impairs continued access to a lawfully purchased digital good resting at all times upon the party whose conduct produces that impairment, this provision being self-executing, inviolate as against all actors within the jurisdiction of Pacifica, and binding upon all persons, corporations, associations, platform holders, and instrumentalities of commerce operating within or directing commerce toward this Republic, and no future law shall be construed to diminish the rights herein declared except insofar as such law expands or further secures those rights for the benefit of the People.
