This prohibition does not extend to non-“irradiating” and non-“nuclear” molecular, atomic, or sub-atomic particle beam (which shall be extended to include beta-electron and ultraviolet photon, even though they are ionizing), as well as towards [other] [non-ionizing] electric, magnetic, electromagnetic/photonic, or gravitic weapons, ammunitions, and destructive devices.

Congress shall have power, on territory under its exclusive jurisdiction, and State legislatures, on territory under their exclusive jurisdiction, to forbid unsupervised possession of ammunitions, destructive devices, or weapons, of mass destruction, for that each individual discharge of which can produce the death or injury of more than one-thousand Individuals over a space of one-thousand square meters and over the time of one hour.

Any person who knowingly causes a nuclear weapon test explosion, or any other nuclear explosion which produces measurable fallout lasting for more than one hour later is guilty of a Felony and liable on conviction upon indictment to imprisonment for life.

If the government has radiological, nuclear, chemical, biological, or massively destructive;-weapons, destructive devices, or ammunitions;-the government shall reduce their radiological, nuclear, chemical, biological, or mass destruction weapon arsenal by fifty percent or more every year, and attempt through sincere diplomacy to have other countries to do the same.

Upon the ratification of this Constitution, those who are, or were previously charged or sentenced under Pacifican statutes or rulings in conflict with and contrary to this section shall be immediately released from imprisonment, automatically granted immediate pardon and expungement for the false crimes for which they were convicted of, PLUS receive full pardon and reprieve from the Gubernor in the State or the President of Pacifica relevant to the Jurisdiction in which such offense was accused, as well as be restituted for the entire duration of time in which they were imprisoned, detained, or incarcerated;-And all Statutes and Instructions to the Jury, and any judicial ruling contrary to it shall immediately become invalid on their face, and be null and void, with no more effect.

SECTION. 20.5.

Arms and psychoactive substances may be restricted inside of penological and mental health institutions such as Jails, Prisons, and Secure Psychiatric Facilities, except by those who apply for a restricted-carry permit, thereby waiving such prohibition, which will require they score 9/10 ratio of no more than 20 questions about self-defense and laws surrounding rightful discharge of the arm, and be trained to arms for defensive combat by the Pacifican Armed Forces, so far as the defensive tool or weapon remains concealed except as needed to execute security or defensive duties; and Psychoactive substances may be carried into such institutions, so long as the possessor has a valid prescription or doctors recommendation for the substance, for their peaceable journey; The previous notwithstanding, to the prior right being due protection in accordance with keeping/bringing Arms and Psychoactive Substances may be into courtrooms, as long as they are possessed concealed and not used for smuggling purposes, without ever a need for such priorly stated restricted-carry permit. Security screenings, except for secure facilities, in general, require a warrant issued under probable cause supported by evidence in accordance to this and their constitution, in order for them to be lawfully executed as constrained by this and their constitution, and all such screenings must be performed by members of law enforcement within competent Jurisdiction in a manner remaining at all times in accordance to this and their constitution.

SECTION. 21.

In this Constitution all rights are immunities against the action of government officials, not entitlements to receive some service or benefit. Every immunity is a restriction on delegated powers, and every delegated power is a restriction on immunities. Delegated powers and immunities partition the space of public action. The exercise of a right is not subject to regulation, except to allocate use of a scarce resource, unless there is an explicit exception to the contrary, in this Constitution.

If there is any significant doubt concerning whether an official has a power, or a Person has an immunity from the exercise of a power, the presumption shall be that the official does not have the power, or conversely, that the Person indeed has the immunity.

All Persons have the right to a presumption of non-authority. Any Person may file, without prior consent of any court, as demandant, in the name of the People, in a court of competent jurisdiction, a writ of quo warranto, habeas corpus, prohibito, mandamus, procedendo, certiorari, scire facias, or other prerogative writ, including a demurral, and upon service of notice to the respondent, the respondent shall have three days, and not more than twenty days with cause, to prove their authority to do or not do what the writ demands. The writ filed shall be the summons, with no further action needed by the court, which shall not treat the writ as a petition or motion for injunctive relief. The burden of proof shall rest solely on the respondent. The court shall hold a hearing within five days of receipt of the response from the respondent, and ahead of any other business before the court except another prerogative writ. Either the demandant or the respondent have the right to trial by a jury of at least twelve, with twelve required to sustain the claim of authority of the respondent. On a writ of habeas corpus the respondent must produce the Individual held regardless of the legal or factual issues, and failure to do so, unless the medical condition of the subject requires otherwise, shall result in immediate release. The order granting the relief demanded shall issue by default if a hearing is not held or a decision not made. Only the Supreme Court of Pacifica shall have jurisdiction to decide a writ of quo warranto, upon impeachment, to remove from office for perjury of oath, fraud, or ineligibility, or restrict the exercise of power, of the President or Vice-president, a member of Congress, or a Federal judge of Pacifica, but any Pacifica court of general jurisdiction shall have jurisdiction for lesser officials, subject to appeal to higher courts, and the President and Vice-President have the right to a verdict by a jury composed of two adult citizens selected at random from each State.

ARTICLE XIV

SECTION. 0.

Congress and the States shall pass no law infringing upon any of the Natural Rights or Civil/Constitutional, Common Law, nor denying any part of procedure of Natural Justice; Contract rights may only be limited in accordance with the Principles of Roman Civil and the Common Law, and additionally as directed or permitted elsewise by this Constitution. The Congress and States may confer rights protected by law through legislative action.

Congress shall not pass any law to which a three-fifths [or greater] majority of the Electorate deems by referendum to be arbitrary, capricious, or un-reasonable.

Any part of the government of Pacifica, including that of the several States, shall be prohibited from implementing, querying, or otherwise engaging with any type of social credit system, from whatever source, whether it is through manual or automated means.

SECTION. 1.

No governmental or corporate power shall exceed the equal or greater power/s of the People, (whom are the origen and locus of power) whether as individuals or in aggregate, and no collective power shall exceed the equal powers of individuals. In honest admission, the Taxation Powers as are presently espoused by this Constitution are not strictly justified by Just Naturalism, but merely utilitarian and pragmatic in their approach to attaining maximal prosperity of Persons as Individuals, and protecting their natural capacity for generating property and wealth, as well as other productive means of self-expression and actualization, in addition to maintaining their good way of life.

No power applicable to an object, or any necessary and proper power derived from it, shall be extended to other objects with which it may be aggregated or causally connected, except to separate the applicable objects from the others.

SECTION. 2.

No government issued or required papers/articles, documents/files of identification, nor money, legal tender, or currency, may consist of or resemble RFID [an] tag/s, piercing/s, jewelr[y]/ies or collar/s, tattoo/s, stamp/s, implant/s, or other bodily modification/s, nor article of clothing or bodily accessory including but not limited to a patch or [appendage]-band; No government issued or required papers/articles, documents/files of identification, nor money, legal tender, or currency, may contain or resemble a microchip or smart device, WBAN, nor other identification signature technology other than a bar-code and/or QR-code and/or magnetic data strip, or electronic equivalent; No government issued government issued or required papers/articles, documents/files of identification, nor money, legal tender, or currency, may or shall consist of, require, or resemble background or security questions or multiple-factor/alternate-party authentication, e-pattern/e-trail/digital-fingerprint, digital-address or social-media alias/handle, planetary/stellar/galactic/universal/parallel_timeline/multiversal/omniversal positioning system coordinate of a Person, satellite coordinate, coordinates of vehicle/craft, nor shall it require any qualification of intelligence, education, or employment, neither those of bio-metrics, sampling, or sequencing of bodily and/or genetic material, nor medical history or listing of condition or immunity, or the lack thereof. All identifying “ID numbers/serials” shall not consist of words, even those which are randomly selected, no matter how low the bit entropy. Electronic Identification/s may not contain any additional attributes or capabilities beyond those equivalent to functions available in otherwise physical forms of Identification/, although such digital IDs may use secure networking and/or QR streams to enable handshaking and owner/user/citizen authorized. Identification/s may not be used for forms of tracking or surveillance.

No Private Individual shall be required to carry identification information or medical and psychological documentation about themself, for any reason, while in the ordinary just course of their lives [through their own inclination or pleasure], neither may they be demanded to provide their identity, except as is prescribed by this Constitution, as well as that of their State in conformity to this Constitution, or as may be prescribed by law underneath them.

No Individual shall be required to register or share information about their whereabouts, be it permanent or temporary, assets, be it tangible or intangible, or signed contracts, be it employment, commercial, or otherwise, unless pursuant to a Warrant; nor shall any Person be required to register or share information about any personal attributes such as medical conditions, bio-metrics, sampling or sequencing of genetic material, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political affiliation, or others, unless pursuant to a Warrant.

[]
The government at every level shall not require, create, collect, or use persistent hardware or software identifiers to fingerprint, track, correlate, or deanonymize persons, devices, or their communications; any network or device identifier used by government for essential technical functions, such as routing or defining, addressing or path-based location plus metadata-based lookup, or local network or storage management, must be temporary, changeable, minimized, and used only for that narrow technical purpose, never for surveillance, profiling, or identity linkage, and no warrant, emergency power, or other government authority shall permit the state to turn such identifiers into tools of tracking or compulsory identification.
[]

No law shall abridge the right of each Person to do as they choose with their own Person and property, so long as they do not interfere, by force, theft, or fraud, or the threat thereof, with the equal right of others to do as they choose with their own Person and property; A Person’s right to live their life the way that they choose to do so goes so far as to not impede another Individual’s right to do the same.

No law shall create victimless or consensual crimes; Every crime needs a victim, to meet the scrutiny of the law securing justice. If there is no injured party, or substantiated risk of harm to individuals, there is no crime. Therefore, for there to be due process in a case, there must be an injured party, or a true risk to injury, otherwise the authority of the court is a fasad. For a crime to exist, there must be an injured party (Corpus Delicti). There can be no sanction or penalty imposed on one because of this Natural Justicial right, without there being a victim whom is suffering or has suffered from deprivation of any of their rights. For there to be a victim, there must be a violation of rights of a Person or Persons, initiated by, or performed on the behalf of, the offender, or in the case of misconduct by government, this may be society at large, or, simply said, the People. If there is no injured party, or substantiated risk of harm to individuals, there is no crime; If there is no substantiated damage sustained as the result of an alleged ‘criminal offense’, there is no harm or injury which may be pursued by the court. With no injured party, a complaint is invalid on its face, and the government in general cannot be considered an injured party by the actions of another unless it directly impairs governmental function as prescribed by this Constitution and the laws made in accordance therewith, or performs an act of [un-just] force, [actual] theft, [real] fraud, or the threat/s thereof directly (but not speculatively or philosophically) against the Government. This provision shall not nullify those laws which are established to punish misconduct of public officials, which may leave no individual person as a victim, but rather subjects society as a whole to be the injured party. In every prosecution for crime it is necessary to establish the ‘corpus delecti’, i.e., the body or elements of the crime. Without Corpus delicti there can be no crime. In every criminal trial, the prosecution must prove the corpus delecti, or the body of the crime itself (i.e., the fact of injury, loss or harm, and the existence of a criminal agency as its cause). Accusers and witnesses have a duty to prove the damages against them or their property, or that of another. In order to prosecute someone for a crime, any entity has the burden of proof to show that someone aside from a consenting adult class Person, such as a Minor, an Animal’s rights, or the Environment/Nature, was harmed by their activity. Otherwise, to uphold justice, the charges must be dropped.

No law shall remove criminal nor civil liability from members of the Public Body which would not equally belong to the whole of ‘the People’ [at large]. The statute of liability shall be unlimited in cases where members of government violate the People.

Each Individual is the exclusive proprietor of his or her own existence and all products thereof, holding no obligations except those created by consent, except to obey the Laws of Pacifica and of their State.

No law shall exist within Pacifica or any other location under its Jurisdiction, except those which protect and/or promote the rights of the Individual, Animals, and Nature/Environment

No Law shall require a person to undergo medical or psychological examination, preventative measure, treatment, or procedure, and no person shall be subject to the same without their explicit non-coerced non-compulsed informed and voluntary consent, absent exigent circumstances, as is detailed through this Constitution.

No Voice stress analysis and polygraph testing shall be allowed by law as an instrument in investigations, interrogation, or in the hiring or firing of employees; This provision relates to the right to not self incriminate, or right to ‘not be forced to be hooked up to bio-receptive systems’. No law may allow behavioural analysis practices by the Government or contracted with or through them.

No governmental body within Pacifica shall have the authority to issue, enforce, or mandate any law, order, directive, or regulation that requires individuals to remain in their homes or otherwise restricts their freedom of movement, travel, or assembly, except as part of a lawful quarantine order applied only to specific individuals who are proven to pose a direct and immediate threat to public health. Generalized or population-wide stay-at-home orders, lockdowns, or shelter-in-place mandates are expressly prohibited, regardless of emergency, public health, or safety justification. Nothing in this provision shall prevent voluntary recommendations or the lawful quarantine of specific individuals based on clear and convincing evidence of dangerous infection or contagion, provided due process is afforded.

SECTION. 3.

No tax shall be levied on any printed materials, radio, television, the Internet, or any other medium of exchange of information. Nothing in this provision shall disable the power of the Congress to lease access to the [Public] inter-state networks to commercial entities for the conduction of regular business activities (not those activities which are leasing or selling access or services based on core dependency to the public network).

No law shall regulate any printed materials, radio, television, the Internet, or any other medium of exchange of information, other than for what is set forth specifically, in this Constitution; No law shall regulate the rules concerning uploading, transmitting, displaying, accessing, or publishing such information, other than for what is set forth specifically, in this Constitution; nor shall any law introduce licensing or registration to infringe upon these rights in Private persons, other than for what is set forth specifically, in this Constitution; Nothing in this provision shall prevent the Congress from protecting the interests of Minors or those lacking mental capacity; publishing or sharing information classified as State secret or related to the work of Agents of Law Enforcement operating undercover pursuant to a Warrant shall be subject to control as described in this Constitution; Nothing in this provision shall disable the power of the Public Administration and its agencies to regulate their own internal [Public] networks, and their effects, as they see necessary for their proper operation and effectual safeguarding/security, as long as it does not prevent or restrict the regular use of internet by those accessing it on connected/enabled Public networks, so long as that they are lawfully entitled to access those Public networks, and they are using them for lawful purposes.

The existence and use of an “Internet kill switch”, with control over Private network connections, by the government, is strictly prohibited. This shall not preclude the ability of the government to sever connections for its own [internal] network systems so long as it is for equitable purposes.

No person shall be compelled to possess, use, or interact with any digital or networked device or service against their will.

SECTION. 4.

No law shall impose any obligations as to pursuing or obtaining any stage of education by any Individual other than for Agents and appointed Members of the Public Administration; all Agents and appointed Members of the Public Administration shall be employed and/or appointed solely on the basis of their merit and successful completion of appropriate examination; no Member of the Public Administration shall employ, appoint, or enable employment or appointment of any Agent or Member who has not passed relevant tests.

No law shall regulate the content of any curriculum used by any private school or university at any stage of education.

No powers shall be granted within Congress or the several States that may authorize any institution or operation of which shall attempt to use the powers, resources, or money provided to them to produce or disseminate propaganda, nor shall they transmit or in any other way distribute propaganda to any Person within its borders or abroad.

SECTION. 5.

The services of the members of the public administration shall be compensated by a fixed salary no greater than one-and-one-third times the mean income in Pacifica. No member of the Public administration may receive tenure nor pensions. They shall be required to declare any other compensation and the public shall be privileged to access information relating to their banking, finances, or wealth.

No law, varying the compensation for the services of the Senators and Representatives, shall take effect, until an election of Representatives shall have intervened.

No person elected, appointed, or employed by the Pacifican government, or by any State or subdivision thereof, shall use, possess, trade upon, or otherwise profit from material, nonpublic information obtained by virtue of their public office or [public] employment. No such person shall buy, sell, or trade securities, commodities, real property, or other financial instruments using knowledge gained in the course of official duties, or by access granted solely through public office or [public] employment. All members of Congress, the Executive Branch, the Judiciary, and all officers and employees of Federal and State agencies shall place any financial holdings in a qualified blind trust, administered independently and without communication to the beneficiary, for the duration of government service. Any violation of this Provision shall be treated as a breach of the public trust and shall constitute grounds for immediate removal from office or employment, permanent disqualification from federal office, and criminal liability under law. No claim of legislative immunity or privilege shall serve as a defense. Congress and the States shall have concurrent power to enforce this Article by appropriate legislation, but no law shall diminish or delay the restrictions herein

SECTION. 6.

No law shall oblige any Person to pay palimony or alimony, nor dowry or other form of bridewealth.

No law shall oblige any Person to acquire any form of insurance or pension scheme, nor shall it provide any financial incentive in that respect.

SECTION. 7.

The monetary and financial system of the Commonwealth of Pacifica shall exist solely to serve the public good and the equitable development of the commonwealth, with the creation and issuance of money reserved as a sovereign function of the people exercised through transparent, democratically accountable institutions, ensuring that no private entity possesses the authority to create money, credit, or debt instruments functioning as legal tender without direct public authorization and oversight; thus, the practice of fractional‑reserve banking, which enables the issuance of credit beyond actual reserves or deposits held, is hereby prohibited within Pacifica, requiring that all financial institutions maintain one‑to‑one reserves for depositor funds or operate under cooperatively agreed lending models transparently backed by tangible assets, so that the savings of the citizenry shall remain their inviolable property and may not be lent, invested, or speculated upon without explicit and informed consent, nor shall inflationary practices or monetary policies that silently erode the real value of savings without legislative sanction and public approval be permitted, as such mechanisms constitute indirect taxation in violation of natural liberty and democratic consent. The Commonwealth shall instead promote the development of cooperative, mutual, and community banks whose operations prioritize the financing of local enterprise, sustainable production, and public works consistent with limitarian-distributist [moral] economics, requiring all such institutions to reinvest a substantial share of their revenues into local economies and to disclose the sources and uses of their profits in the public record. The charging of interest or fees exceeding a just and proportionate measure of service, risk, and inflation shall be defined as usury and prohibited, while equitable debt restructuring and relief mechanisms shall be established to prevent perpetual debt bondage and to secure the material basis of individual self‑determination. All institutions engaged in financial activity under the authority of Pacifica shall be fully transparent and publicly auditable, with ownership structures, lending practices, and political contributions disclosed, and any public official or agent of fiscal governance found to accept material benefit or employment from regulated banking interests shall be subject to immediate removal from office and criminal prosecution for economic-related corruption. The Commonwealth shall direct the lawful conversion of existing private banking corporations into publicly accountable credit institutions or community‑owned cooperatives, thereby ensuring restitution and redress for wealth extracted through predatory lending, monetary manipulation, or speculative fraud, while establishing constitutional remedies for communities demonstrably harmed by systemic financial exploitation through the authority of the Supreme Court of Pacifica. Each person within Pacifica is recognized to possess an inherent and inalienable right to economic self‑determination, freedom from involuntary debt servitude, inflationary confiscation, and exploitative financial manipulation, and the protection of this right shall be regarded as essential to liberty, justice, and the republican equality upon which the political and economic integrity of the Commonwealth stands.

The ancient evil of usury shall be prohibited throughout the Commonwealth of Pacifica. Usury shall be defined as the practice of imposing any charge for the use of money, whether interest, fees, or alternative payment schemes, that results in a loan carrying an effective annual interest rate demonstrably exploitative, abusive, or exceeding the level necessary for fair compensation of risk and administrative cost. To protect the public from economic subjugation through debt, Congress shall establish, maintain, and periodically revise a national usury ceiling for all forms of private lending, expressed as an annual percentage rate (APR), based on the following principles: Human Dignity and Economic Freedom; The interest rate must not undermine the equal right of all people to access credit without fear of long-term servitude, financial ruin, or debt-based coercion. Risk and Reasonability Balance; The rate must reflect a fair and legitimate compensation for the creditor’s actual risk and operational costs, as demonstrated by empirical economic evidence, not by speculative market forces alone. Indexed Base Rate; The lawful maximum APR shall be no more than a reasonable margin above a nationally recognized base index, such as the Federal Funds Rate or the median inflation-adjusted return on U.S. Treasury bonds, as determined by statute. Anti-Exploitation Clause; In no instance shall the rate be set so high that it results in practices recognized as predatory, deceptive, or structurally entrapping for the borrower. Public Review and Adjustment; The maximum lawful rate shall be reviewed at minimum every five years or upon signs of significant market distortion or increased financial distress among borrowers. Congress shall have the authority and duty to enact legislation to enforce this article, including the creation of regulatory agencies, penalties for violations, and oversight mechanisms to ensure public accountability and transparency in rate determination. Exemptions for specific types of lending may only be created through express Congressional approval subject to public interest findings. This provision is adopted in recognition of the inalienable right to economic liberty. No citizen shall be driven into permanent debt dependency, involuntary servitude through financial deception, or reduced to economic serfdom by institutions of credit.

No domestic bank or financial institution established within the territory of Pacifica or any State thereof, nor branches of foreign banks or financial institutions within the territory of Pacifica or any State thereof, may charge a fee and/or rate, for [a] Person/s, or an organization, institution, business, company, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity, having free, fair, and equal access of their own personal account’s ledger quantities of legal tender, currencies, or monetary wealth that is deposited or withdrawn.

No Person shall be compelled to disclose their lawful private economic transactions, assets, or the means of their savings and barter, except by individual probable cause warrant supported by sworn evidence of specific crime. Digital or physical currency issued by the State shall never include embedded logging, surveillance ,or control mechanisms which permit the restriction of private economic activity or punishment for exercise of rights.

No financial institution, payment processor, or digital service provider shall discriminate against, deny service to, or restrict the lawful transactions of any Person based on their political speech, religious belief, association, or ideological expression, nor in any other case except where such transaction directly violates the natural or constitutional rights of another.

Private Banks and other financial institutions such as credit card and mortgage companies in addition to brokerage firms and insurance companies, shall pay a community charge upon their profits at the same percentage as the maximum APR (as is used to prevent usury) accepted by law, to be dispersed into the public healthcare made available to Pacifican citizens, and public education system, including but not limited to libraries and web resources.

SECTION. 7.5.

No government issued currency may consist of, contain, or resemble RFID tags, piercings, jewelry or collar, tattoos, stamps, or other bodily modifications [including genetic modification or any epigenetic shifting technique or supposed “therapy” or “remedy”, to keep the people “clean, purified, cleansed, and made washed”], nor article of clothing or bodily accessory including but not limited to a patch or [appendage]-band; No government issued physical currency or cryptocurrency system may consist of or contain a microchip or smart device [other than necessary for the function of a cryptocurrency hard wallet], nor contain identification signature technology other than a barcode, QR-code, encoded holographic emblem, or magnetic strip, security fibre, or an equivalent.

No domestic bank or financial institution established within the territory of Pacifica or any State thereof shall require digital address, planetary/stellar/galactic/universal/parallel_timeline/multiversal/omniversal positioning system coordinate of a Person, satellite coordinate, coordinates of vehicle/craft, nor shall any qualification of intelligence, education, or employment, neither those of bio-metrics beyond a written signature or personal mark fingerprint stamp, neither shall shall they require the sampling or sequencing of bodily and/or genetic material.

No domestic bank or financial institution established within the territory of Pacifica or any State thereof, nor the representatives of the domestic bank or financial institution, neither branches of foreign banks or financial institutions within the territory of Pacifica or any State thereof, nor the representatives of foreign banks or financial institutions in Pacifica, may reveal the identity of an account holder to another Person, including any agent of government, nor to any Institution, Organization, or branch of the Public Administration, except upon investigation for severe criminal activity, and only upon presentation of a valid warrant issued by a judge of a court with competent jurisdiction.

No branch of the Public Administration shall finance, or partially finance, any private organization, institution, business, company, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity, or service contracted between any natural Persons, except as may be permitted by this Provision, through the legislature of Congress, as well as which is empowered to the Publicly-owned State banks by the State legislature through this provision; No assets shall be transferred by any branch of the Public Administration to any legal entity or natural Person, except in the case of State banks in the form of a loan, non-repayable grant, or popularly approved subsidy for open-source scientific research institutions, technology developers, and manufacturers, in addition to periodic disbursements in the case of social security and public welfare services or benefits such as Poor Relief and Emergency Basic Income, or unless as re-muneration for contracted goods or services necessary for the functioning of the Public Administration as envisaged in this Constitution, or the constitutions of the several States.

SECTION. 8.

No branch of the Public Administration shall contract with any legal entity or natural Person, State or entity for the purposes of acquiring data it itself is not entitled to acquire under this Constitution or any laws passed in accordance therewith; nor shall any branch of the Public Administration be allowed to procure any legal entity or natural Person to commit what it itself is not entitled to commit under this Constitution or any laws passed in accordance therewith.

The government is prohibited from owning stocks in any institution, business, company, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity which engages in a type of business as would otherwise be prohibited to it.

SECTION. 9.

No law or legal action may grant amnesty to illegal immigrants.

No branch of the Public Administration shall give any form of foreign aid to any State or entity, whether directly or via any international institution, be it a non-repayable grant, loan, or any other financial support; nothing in this provision shall prevent the Public Administration from meeting its financial liabilities flowing from the membership in any intergovernmental organization.

[]
Pacifica shall provide no military assistance, military personnel, nor subsidized weapons, munitions, neither provision of intelligence, training, transportation, financing, logistical support, military basing, security guarantees, or other defense-related aid to any foreign nation, foreign government, foreign military force, international military alliance, or external sovereign power. No office, agency, military body, public corporation, or representative of Pacifica may authorize, fund, facilitate, negotiate, or participate in any foreign war, armed intervention, occupation, forced settlement, proxy conflict, military coalition, or defense commitment on behalf of a foreign nation. The sole exception shall be voluntary defensive, humanitarian, peacekeeping, intelligence-sharing, training, logistical, or mutual-protection assistance provided to the Indigenous tribes, nations, bands, and traditional peoples of Pacifica, subject to their free, prior, and informed consent. Assistance authorized under this exception shall be strictly limited to protection of life, territory, sovereignty, treaty rights, cultural continuity, environmental security, and the collective defense of Pacifica and its Indigenous peoples. It shall not be used to initiate aggression, conquest, occupation, forced displacement, or coercive control over any people. No assistance to an Indigenous nation under this Provision may diminish its inherent sovereignty, impose military command over its people or territory, require political allegiance, or condition aid on the surrender of land, jurisdiction, treaty rights, or self-government. Any act, appropriation, treaty, agreement, order, or commitment contrary to this Provision is null and void from its inception and shall create no lawful duty, debt, obligation, or liability of or by Pacifica.
[]

SECTION. 10.

No government agency or member of the public body may be permitted to facilitate or engage in the commission of a crime, nor facilitate or operate a criminal enterprise.

Any member of the public body who has been convicted of a crime while under their term in office shall be automatically suspended without pay and un-eligible for re-hire in any part of government, until the next election; A Proxy shall take their place until a proper replacement for the public position can be made.

SECTION. 11.

No government agency, official, or contractor within Pacifica shall use, develop, procure, or deploy facial recognition, voice recognition, fingerprint, handprint, or any other biometric recognition technology for the purpose of surveillance, identification, or monitoring of the public, except solely to secure access to restricted areas of governmental facilities for authorized personnel. The use of image and audio recognition software by the government for surveillance, tracking, or identification of individuals is strictly prohibited, except as necessary for internal security of restricted government spaces and only for personnel authentication. No government entity shall create, maintain, or contribute to any bio-metric database or system, nor shall it contract with private entities to do so, for any purpose other than the limited exceptions stated above. Any evidence or information obtained in violation of this provision shall be inadmissible in any court or administrative proceeding. This provision shall be construed to uphold the rights to privacy, free expression, free assembly, and protection from mass surveillance, and may not be circumvented by emergency declaration or executive order.

No law shall prohibit video or audio recording where there is no reasonable expectation of privacy, including recording Agents or other members of the Public Administration; The people are free to record anything visible or audible from a public place, and with a single-party’s consent, from a private place, as long as they are authorized/permitted to be [rightfully] on [the] property, meaning they can lawfully record any conversation or interaction as long as they are a participant, even without the other party’s consent; The law shall protect the rights of the People surrounding Sousveillance; nothing in this provision shall be construed as to allow for general surveillance by the Public Administration. Single-party recording laws only apply to Private Persons and Businesses, and not to members of government, or government facilities/institutions. There must be the capacity to revoke consent when the government or its actors proceed to Audio, Video, or Radio record People, except vehicular and body camera footage from Law Enforcement vehicles, witnesses giving testimony in favor or against an accused party, vehicle and body camera footage taken by a third party of an accused defendant, inside of a jail/prison and its holding cells by both unit fixed as well as body mounted cameras worn by staff, or in courtroom proceedings for providing a permanent objective public record of all events taking place within [a] courtroom/s, where in all such cases, the interest of accurate public records requires that the interactions/events be objectively and completely recorded;

All Public Officials and Agents of 'the Public [thing]', when conducting public business or actions in person and interacting or engaging with members of the public in an official capacity ordering their official duties, shall wear and activate a body-worn camera that records audio and video along with GPS coordinates of such interactions for public accountability and record preservation. This requirement applies to all elected, appointed, and employed public officials and other agents acting under color of public authority or color of law, except where recording is prohibited by this Constitution or Statute made in accordance therewith, or where a narrowly tailored exemption is necessary to protect classified information, privileged communications, or clearly defined personal privacy interests. Recordings made under this Provision shall be retained according to law and made available to the general publicb(as 'the People') subject to reasonable redactions for privacy, security, and due process. The legislature of each State and of Congress shall enact laws to establish equipment standards, activation rules, retention periods, access procedures, [severe] penalties for non-compliance, and [extreme] remedies for misuse or destruction of recordings.

All Government officials must not tell any lie to anybody while they are under oath nor to the public while performing an official function of government, under maximum penalty of perjury.

All proposed and passed legislation must be non-secret as well as made public and be open for un-censored, un-redacted, full review, and re-distribution, by the People.

No classified intelligence agencies shall be operated by the government of Pacifica. Intelligence gathering shall be open-source and public domain. Data accessed, duplicated, examined, or analyzed for foreign intelligence purposes shall not be used for unrelated civil or criminal matters.

No Person shall be convicted of an illegal disclosure of classified information if that piece of information proves or could be reasonably believed to be proving that any member of any branch of the Public Administration has breached, remains in breach or intends to breach the law.

Any Person retains the Rights of whistleblowers to share information about things that endanger society, or which otherwise are in ‘the Public’s’ interest, in both Private and Public enterprise, and that of Public Departments, actions, or information, must be supported. Every whistleblower charged with espionage, or any other crime, for their act of admission to another of classified information or official misconduct, have the right to tell a jury why they did what they did, and how they believe it serves, assists, advances, or otherwise benefits the needs or will of the Public Interest of the Pacifican People. A whistleblower need not be a Public official to have legal protections under law, and all such protections shall be equal in either case.

No law shall criminalize Journalists or other Individuals learning, knowing, retaining, and sharing or disseminating classified information to themselves or the general public.

No merger between Public or Private power or other function shall be established or otherwise formed [in {every} {and} all cases] nor privatization or subcontracting of public government functions, neither shall any governmental department or power be combinated with another without the express consent of Congress, nor shall inter-departmental law enforcement co-operation exist without a specifically and narrowly tailored Warrant within a limited scope specific to an individual suspect or Criminal case, in order to preserve the separation of Powers and ensure that the Rights within this constitution and the limitations on governmental functions remain intact.

No law shall force any Person, household, or community to adopt digital-only systems for communication, commerce, voting, or governance. Access to physical, paper-based, analog means for everyday life, including cash and coin, mail and packages, print media and art, face-to-face meetings, and unconnected devices, shall remain a permanent right to guard against technocratic enslavement. This right must be enforced to the maximum degree humanly possible.

SECTION. 12.

No branch of the Public Administration shall establish any standing army; nor shall it declare war or carry out military activities other than in defense of the border or interior lands or parcels therein of Pacifica, its territories, or any of ‘the Several States’ in reaction to an act of armed aggression against Pacifica which has already taken place or is imminent; nor shall any branch of the Public Administration invite any Military source of any other Nation/State/Government or organization into the jurisdiction of Pacifica except for a reasonable number of security personnel accompanying a foreign visit.

SECTION. 13.

The laws extending to the classification, treatment, and legal endowment of sovereign foreign Citizens shall apply in the discovery of an extra-terrestrial alien race or other sentient form of intelligence from whom the disposition is considered to be Sapient.

No Person, machine, or vehicle/craft may interfere with the normal development of any alien life or society, before they become part of an interstellar community with other intelligent life-forms from other planetary organismic lineage/s; however, this provision shall not prevent free intercourse and fair trade with a sufficiently advanced civilization capable of establishing and maintaining inter-spacial or inter-organive relations and cohesion, nor shall anything within this Constitution authorize Pacifica to intervene in matters that are essentially within the domestic jurisdiction of any planetary social system or require the members to submit such matters to settlement under this Constitution. In circumstances where a verified mass extinction event threatens the continued existence of sentient or ecologically critical life on a planetary body, Pacifica may authorize intervention strictly limited to the preservation or restoration of such life or environment, subject to oversight and post-action review under interstellar law. Any unauthorized interference shall remain a felony punishable by life imprisonment without the possibility of parole, and nothing in this principle shall prejudice the application of enforcement measures under this Constitution.

SECTION. 14.

No gravitoelectromagnetic drive nor “warp” drive or wormhole device for transportation of people as well as material or energetic supplies and vehicles/crafts, neither string theorem machine capable of manipulating, transceiving, or traversing dimensional distributions, nor cross-timeline or multi-verse browsing device, neither Lentz soliton n-Dimensional phased-arrays, nor resonant-space teleporter [cavity-confiner/expander], shall ever be owned by or operated by any governmental agency or office, [acting] member of the public body, or government hired contractor of Pacifica, at any place, or upon any Person, place, or thing, regardless of its purposes in peace or war, or for law enforcement, transit, or communication. The right to operate equipment including but not limited to gravitoelectromagnetic and “warp” drives, Lentz soliton n-Dimensional phased-arrays, resonant-space teleporter [cavity-confiner/expander], wormhole devices, string theorem machines, and cross-timeline or multi-verse browsers, is insured to the People [as Private Persons].

No Person, machine, or vehicle/craft in any temporal displacements and voyages through time, shall interfere with the natural progression of historical or past-like events/positions, nor may they reveal knowledge of future developments, so as to preserve the integrity of the established timeline and its super-similars/parallels; provided, however, that in the event of an imminent mass extinction event threatening a significant portion of sentient life, intervention shall be authorized solely to avert such catastrophe. No temporal conservation/integrity agency with temporal interposition or timeline-[2]/[4]nD{+}-brane-navigation capacity shall ever be erected through any legislation, or by a member of the public body or under any office held, nor shall they possess cross-timeline jurisdiction. All charges for violations of historical or past-like timeline preservation shall be high felonies punishable only in timeline of the Pacifican Federal or State governments having jurisdiction for Origin to the perpetrator of the crime, or of one fleeing such a crime into Pacifica, it States, or Territories, by life in prison without the possibility of parole; And, that nothing in this principle shall prejudice the application of enforcement measures within this timeline at the point where/which the time-modification took place.

No cross-timeline or other inter-dimensional co-operative or temporal agency alliance/connection shall ever be established by Pacifica, nor assented or otherwise entered into compact by the Pacifica, and Pacificans reserve the eternal right to exit any temporal or inter-dimensional 'bind'/connection/interlinking/confinement or other equivocal imprisonment or trajectory steering.

SECTION. 15.

The government shall only possess reasonable and just as well as specific limited powers, and not merely implement any and all ideas related to the exercise of a delegated power, without elaborating and engaging in representative discourse, as well as impugning based on their (the idea's) absurdity in relation to the specific issue being addressed.

Government shall exercise no power within the territory of Pacifica, based solely on a treaty without requiring legislative conferral, not otherwise delegated to it by this Constitution, other than powers to administer trust territories or protectorates.

SECTION. 16.

No member of the public body or aggregation of such members endowed with the power of appointment may assign a member (appointee) to a position of greater power or authority than the installing member or commissioning group of members (appointer).

No position in the government shall be without reasonable term durations and term limits, which shall be prescribed by law.

No person shall be eligible to serve in any capacity as an officer, employee, or agent of the Pacifica, or of any State or political subdivision thereof, except as an advisor, if such person has attained the age of eighty-five years. Congress and the States shall have no power to waive, alter, or suspend the Clauses of this Provision. Nothing in this Provision shall be construed to abridge the rights of any person to participate in private employment or enterprise, nor to restrict any other rights secured by this Constitution.

All legislation from the Federal, Territorial, State, or Local governments must have an expiration date; The longest time that legislation may stay enacted is twelve years (12 annum), though shorter terms may be prescribed through each individual piece of legislation, and all legislation must be re-passed by the legislature after this period, otherwise it shall end until it is lawfully re-enacted.

No emergency power may be exercised by any level of government without a clearly stipulated and rigid limitation on the term of time in for which the power may be duly exercised.

SECTION. 17.

No regulation, ordinance, or other rule issued as anything but an act of Congress or State legislature shall have the force of law on the People, but may be applied only to government agents or other members.

Congress or a state legislature shall not enact legislation with criminal penalties without support by a vote of four-fifths of the members, not just of the members present and voting.

No law shall be passed applicable to a Citizen of Pacifica that is not equally applicable to the government and its employees, or, jurors in tribunal.

No function of government shall be automated without oversight and audit, nor shall any law be proposed that has been written fully or in part by artificial intelligence without first being audited by the individual who proposes such legislation, and all members of the public body shall be sworn to act without autonomy and not under the direction of automation or artificial intelligence. For the purposes of this public charter, cybernetic governance shall be defined to mean governance which uses feedback loops voluntarily provided by and from the People in order to correct their representatives and participate in government functions as enshrined by this Constitution; People have the right to be free from coercion into participating with cybernetic governance systems to whatever degree they desire personally or collectively.

SECTION. 18.

No member of government, whether elected or appointed, shall use their official authority, position, or resources to influence, interfere with, or affect the outcome of any partisan political campaign, election, or activity. It shall be a crime for any government official or employee to engage in partisan political activity while on duty, in any government facility, or while using government property or resources. No government official shall solicit, accept, or receive political contributions, or coerce or encourage any person to participate in partisan political activities, by virtue of their official position. Violations of this provision shall be subject to criminal penalties, including removal from office, disqualification from future government service, and any other penalties prescribed by law. Nothing in this provision shall be construed to prohibit government officials from exercising their individual rights to free speech or political participation in a personal capacity, provided such activity does not use official authority or resources.

No member of government, nor any public agency, may own, fund, or influence any news or information outlet, save for a transparent public information service accountable to an Independent Media Council elected by journalists and citizens, except when doing so in their own private capacity with their own money for that which they lawfully control in such capacity.

No person holding any government office shall use, or attempt to use, their official position, authority, or resources for personal or financial benefit. Any such act shall constitute a misdemeanor offense, subject to criminal prosecution. Upon conviction, the offender shall be subject to immediate impeachment, removal from office, and disqualification from holding any future government office. This provision shall not be construed to prohibit the receipt of lawful compensation for official duties as established by law, nor to restrict the exercise of rights held in common by all citizens.

It shall be a criminal offense for any public official, whether elected, appointed, or employed in any capacity, to use, leverage, or exploit their position of power or authority to directly or indirectly enrich themselves, their family, their friends, or the families and associates of their friends. For the purposes of this Amendment, “enrich” includes but is not limited to: Financial gain, gifts, contracts, employment, or favorable treatment; Preferential access to information, resources, or government programs; Any act or omission that results in a benefit not equally available to the general public. Any citizen shall have standing to initiate a complaint or criminal action against a public official suspected of violating this Amendment. All such cases shall be tried before a jury of the People, who shall have the right to exercise jury nullification if they deem prosecution unjust or politically motivated. All investigations, proceedings, and evidence relating to such alleged self-enrichment shall be fully transparent and open to public scrutiny. No immunity, secrecy, or privilege shall shield officials from accountability for violations of this provision. Conviction under this provision shall result in immediate removal from office, full restitution of any ill-gotten gains to the public treasury, and criminal penalties as prescribed by law. Repeat offenders and conspirators shall face enhanced penalties. No law, regulation, or executive order shall create exceptions, waivers, or immunities for violations of this Amendment. Any attempt to do so shall be null and void. This provision shall be interpreted in the broadest manner possible to prevent corruption, cronyism, and abuse of power, reaffirming that all government exists solely to serve the People and to protect their natural, civil, and constitutional rights-not to benefit the ruling class or their associates.

No member of government, whether elected, appointed, or employed in any capacity, shall exercise any power, authority, or official discretion in a manner that creates, furthers, or perpetuates a conflict of interest, whether direct or indirect. No law, regulation, executive order, contract, appropriation, or governmental act shall be enacted, issued, or enforced that confers any special benefit, privilege, or exemption upon any member of government, their family, associates, or affiliated entities, unless such benefit is equally available to and for the general welfare of the People as a whole. Any government official found to have participated in, authorized, or knowingly benefited from a conflict of interest shall be subject to immediate removal from office, full restitution to the public treasury, and prosecution under the law. All proceedings, investigations, and records relating to conflicts of interest shall be fully transparent and accessible to the People. Any citizen shall have standing to challenge, in a court of law, any government action alleged to violate this Amendment. The judiciary shall give such cases priority and shall have the power to issue immediate injunctive relief to halt any action found to be in violation. No branch, office, or agent of government shall have the authority to waive, suspend, or delegate the requirements of this provision under any circumstance. Any attempt to do so shall be null and void. This provision shall be construed liberally in favor of liberty, transparency, and the absolute prohibition of self-dealing and corruption in government. Any ambiguity shall be resolved to maximize the protection of the People’s rights and the integrity of public service.

SECTION. 19.

No branch or authority of the government of Pacifica may shutdown the government, except for that power of 'the People' during times of governmental insubordination.

ARTICLE XV

Section. 1.

Immunities of 'the People' provided under this Constitution include but are not limited to:

Not to be denied Public judicial process.

Not to be violated in the protections for which the separation of powers and Co equal branches of government were established, nor to be impeded to fair access of the Public system. For in that, all members of the Public body shall also be held accountable and not be empowered to displace their duties or responsibilities to another individual or department, branch, et cetera.

Not to be denied due notice of time, place, manner, parties, and subject of any proceeding with sufficient time to respond.

Not to be denied fair hearing and decision on the legal merits, with timely and effective redress for [justicible] grievances, including damages, property, or, injunctive or declaratory relief.

Not to have just remedies made inaccessible or excessively difficult or costly.

Not to be Tried or Convicted “En Absentia” nor in a Secret or Hidden legal proceeding for Civil or Criminal liability.

Not to be denied mandated testimony of accusors and witnesses.

Not to be denied unimpeded access to courts, court filing, and inquestries, subject only to routine scheduling.

Not to be subject to administrative rule, order, or other manner of false legislative or supreme dictarial executor power, nor may the legislature confer such similar powers or capacities to another entity or branch of government, neither department, agency, or other governmental compartment.

Not to be denied direct presentation of complaints to an inquestry without the presence of any other government actor except with the consent of the inquestry.

Not to be denied standing to privately prosecute a public right without having been injured or expecting personal injury.

Not to be subject to retaliation.

Not to have admitted any plea or testimony induced by a plea agreement.

Not to have any real property or chattel taken or forfeited without civil or criminal judgment in a trial, with possession presumed to establish title unless proved otherwise.

Not to have the exercise of any immunity taxed, disabled, or restricted by statute or other rule except to allocate a scarce resource among competing claimants, unless one is a minor, which by default shall be any Individual under the age of eighteen unless the disabilities of minority are extended or reduced by court order.

Not to have the exercise of any right, privilege, or immunity disabled or restricted without a court order following a jury trial.

Not to be denied indictment by twelve members of a randomly selected inquestry of twenty-four who elect their foreperson, upon a finding that the court has jurisdiction and that there is sufficient evidence for a trial, except for Persons subject to armed forces (military or militia) discipline, or foreign praedones.

Not to be denied service as prosecutor upon receipt of an indictment by an inquestry, subject only to consolidation by the inquestry if more than one Person seeks to prosecute the same offense.

Not to be denied trial by a randomly selected jury of twelve sworn to uphold applicable Constitutions in criminal cases for which the penalty is more than seven days.

Not to have imposed excessive bail when there is little flight risk, nor withheld from pre-trial release, unless there is a demonstrable danger to their victim or the general Public; In the case of indigence or inability to raise bail, release under Personal recognizance should be offered in lieu of bail, where reasonable.

Not to have imposed excessive fines upon oneself or others.

Not to have excessive bail, nor excessive fines imposed, nor excessive terms of incarceration, nor any other excessive form of criminal punishment, nor torturous, cruel, degrading/demoralizing/dehumanizing, or unusual treatments or punishments inflicted.

Not to be denied speedy and public case and fair trial before an impartial jury of the State and district previously defined by law, wherein the offense shall have been committed, and to have the location of commitment be deemed where there was concurrence of mens rea and actus reus.

Not to be twice prosecuted for the same offense or same facts under the same or different jurisdictions.

To be informed of the nature and cause of the accusation; to be confronted with the accusors and witnesses against theirself; to have compulsory process for obtaining witnesses in their favor, and to have the assistance of counsel for their defense, but not to have counsel or an attorney imposed on him without their consent.

Not to be compelled to be a witness against himself or herself.

Not to be disabled in the exercise, or deprived, of Life and Health, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-security [and freedom to secure others] and Self-defense [and freedom to defend others], Privacy, Property, or the pursuit of Happiness, without first being irrefragably proven through supplementation of irrefutable evidence to have denied or intended to deprive the equal right/s of another Person or other Persons, and only through due process of law, by unanimous verdict of a jury of twelve.

Not to be impeded in the presentation of all evidence by the defendant, without being subject to a motion in limine.

Not to be impeded in the presentation of all legal arguments to the jury, up to the final instructions to the jury, except for argument on a motion in limine that cannot be made without disclosing evidence properly excluded.

Not to be impeded in the presentation of all pleadings, alternative instructions, and certified copies of applicable laws and Constitutions, to the jury.

Not to have a sentence that does not separately disable the exercise of the immunity, and order deprivation of it, within the scope of that disablement.

Not to be deprived from the right of trial by a randomly selected jury of twelve sworn to uphold applicable Constitutions and laws in which the amount at issue, including costs, exceeds the equivalent of at least 15 troy ounces of pure silver.

Not to be impeded in an appeal from a jury verdict on a writ of error or habeas corpus, as according to the rules under this Constitution, and of the Roman Civil Law except as may be directed otherwise by this Constitution, or if neither, prescribe a course or remedy, as according to the customs of Common Law, or Contract law (under Pacifican Principles) rights, or in none such case, as according to legislative conferral by Pacifica or the several States, or through the legal customs of United States law as under the Articles of Confederation except as may be provided otherwise by the 1787CE Constitution of the United States, and additionally through conformity to the Bill of Rights of 1789CE, as they were originally proposed.

Non-authority shall be presumed for any claim to authority, to be strictly proved by an unbroken logical chain of derivation from the Constitution or Constitutional law.

Not to have any government actor exercise a power not delegated, regardless of whether one may be personally injured by such exercise.

Not to have government actors exercise powers on the pretext of being “necessary and proper” when they are not incidental to perform their official duties or to get a desired result beyond such duties.

To have delegated powers construed as narrowly, and rights, privileges, or immunities construed as broadly, in the Spirit of the Laws [over the Letter of the Law], as the language of the Constitution was meant and understood when ratified permits.

Not to be subject to unreasonable or onerous public area regulations, such as but restrained to park rules, nor to be denied notice of such regulations/rules in a plain and straightforward way which is visibly and disability (I.e., blindness user) accessible to all users of the public area without the need to specially visit a public department/building or access a public website to view them; Neither to be denied the free exercise of Rights in such public places.

To have priority docketing of all prerogative writs filed by a any Person as demandant in the name of the People with a court of competent jurisdiction and served on the respondant, within three sederunt days, unless the respondant requires more, but not more than 20 calendar days, including but not limited to, demurral, quo warranto, habeas corpus, procedendo, mandamus, prohibito, certiorari, and scire facias, and to have default judgment even if no proof is presented or a hearing is not held.

Not have communications, including speech, press, and education, punished or impeded, except such as instigate or direct a felony, misdemeanor, high crime, tort, piracy, or treason.

Not to impede peaceful assembly and exercise of rights in concert with others.

Not to impede assembly as militia for organizing, training, and response to threats to public safety, subject only to direction by State militia officers during a call-up.

Not to restrict Persons in owning and/or possessing/keeping, carrying, manufacturing and/or modifying, buying and/or selling, and bearing of weapons, equipment, and supplies commonly used by military forces, or suitable for militia, subject only to court order of disablement for being a threat to others, or to the lawful orders of militia officers during a call-up.

Not to impede or punish petition for timely and effective redress of grievances.

Not to impede or punish devotion or practice of [a]spirituality/[a]religion, or have preferential support of such by public funds, that does not instigate or direct a felony, misdemeanor, or tort.

Not to have government actors intrude onto or into one’s real property, body, or use of one’s personal property, for search, seizure, or for any other reason, without consent, unless through a declared State of war or emergency threat to public safety as may be prescribed by law, or, a valid warrant supported by an affidavit of [unassailable] probable cause, and always with just compensation for any losses incurred, for each incident.

Not to impede or punish access to observation and recordation of any government proceeding except trial and inquestry deliberations or their equivalent, or deliberations on matters of security requiring secrecy.

Not to impede or punish receipt of records of all proceedings, and accounting for all receipts, loans, debts, and expenditures, and reporting thereof, for eventual examination prior to an election in which the issues may be reviewed.

Not to be denied accurate recording, counting, and reporting of all votes cast by eligible voters in any public election without protection regarding open-disclosure of how each voted.

Not to be denied access to all information about oneself, and either copies at cost of all documentation or to make one’s own copies using one’s own equipment.

Not to be denied effective low-cost remedies for getting information about oneself corrected, and use of such information restricted to that for which there is consent by oneself.

Not to be subject to illogical or impossible demands.

Not to be subject to meddling, without a clear, present, compelling, and rationally-based public need.

Not to impede or punish association and contract to do things not unlawful, including practice of a profession or occupation, marriage, procreation, and acceptance or denial of medical prevention or treatment.

Not to impede or punish formation, conduct, and revision or dissolution of corporations, partnerships, and other trusts, in which settlor, trustee, and beneficiary are distinct Persons who may not be impeded or penalized from directly appearing in any court in such capacities.

Not to have some accorded special privileges or protections that favor them over the rest of the People, in ways not essential to the performance of public duties.

Not to impede or punish travel by a citizen within, to, and from the Union and any State, territory or locality.

Not to be removed from the location of one’s birth or lawful residence, or impeded from returning thereto.

Not to be subjected to involuntary servitude except as punishment for a crime, but excepting jury and witness duty.

Not to be impeded or punished for voting if one is a Citizen of Pacifica and a Resident of the jurisdiction in question, on grounds of being age eighteen or above, sex, sexual orientation, body type, color, race, ancestry, nationality or place of origin, language, relationship status such as being with a romantic partner as well as in a marriage or part of a family, [a]spirituality/[a]religion, political or ideological beliefs, intelligence, education, capability or disability, medical history, previous condition of servitude, property, economic situation, social origin, social circumstances, social condition/status or other characteristics, personal background, immutable traits, or other condition, or failure to pay a tax.

Not to be denied custody and care of close relatives who are non-citizens.

Not to be neglected or abused while in custody.

Not to be denied any right, privilege, or immunity for failure to have or present a name or other form of identification.

Not to be deported without proof that one has not been natural born or naturalized as a citizen, unless one is born to a Person not subject to the jurisdiction of Pacifica, such as a foreign diplomat or an invader.

Not to be subject to a penalty for not doing something, such as not paying a tax, if government agents or other members refuse to allow it to be done, such as not accepting payment of a tax.

Not to be subject to a penalty or tax for failure to take some action one has no public duty to do.

Not to be denied relief from some government action for lack of an appropriation to process the application for relief, or having an official to receive the application, and to fail to recognize the demand for such relief as being granted by default.

Not to be required to procreate or to refrain from procreating, but this immunity may still prohibit abortion on account of the interests of the child after the fetus reaches the stage of development where they are viable outside the womb.

Not to have imposed upon one any unwanted belief or expression of devotion or to be pressured into conformity with such.

Not to be excluded from any Public area without just cause and due process, only in accordance with law, and no such exclusion shall be permanent.

Not be subject to oppressive surveillance, intrusive information collection, or having to present government-issued identification to exercise rights.

Not to be subjected to Arbitrary or Capricious treatment, rulings, or determination by government; To be guaranteed all decisions are explained as to why they were reached and to the Points & Authorities supporting or empowering them.

Not to be penalized or punished for defending against any individual or entity, Private or Public, acting unlawfully or in error in a which violates any of the rights/immunities, privileges, or guarantees provided under this Constitution.

Not to have medical or psychological therapy treatment, or therapy/counseling imposed as a treatment or penalty for or not doing something, nor as a criminal punishment, nor as a stipulation or condition [for compliance] to predicate a release.

Not to be denied the opportunity to display relevant evidence lawfully acquired, including character evidence and evidence of contingency in for/an action that is under judicial scrutiny.

Not to be subjected by a person or association of persons, business/es, or institution/s, who knowingly [directly] assist, or otherwise [directly] act in a way which, aids or performs in, the deprivation of any rights as protected under the constitution of Pacifica.

Immunities do not include entitlements to a sufficient amount of a scarce resource.

The foregoing list is not exhaustive, and further rights, privileges, and immunities are to be found in the historical record. The rule of expressio unius est exclusio alterius shall not be applied.

ARTICLE XVI

Section. 1.

We the People of Pacifica declare:

We the People recognize that our communities are under siege from the corporations that cause economic, cultural, environmental, and public harm; our confinement in a system of laws that grants greater rights to corporations than to residents of our communities; This system grants corporate minorities the legal authority to override the community majority right to choose that which secures its health, safety, and welfare; The legal system has conferred unequal power on the basis of property ownership so that those holding the most property obtain and wield superior rights; This system of law hinders and obstructs our ability to adapt to economic, cultural, and environmental change; Corporate control of legislation and governance denies our right to an authentically equally represented Local, State, and Federal representation necessary to protect our communities from corporate harms; Our health, safety, welfare, and survival of our Local businesses, farms, ecosystems, and neighborhoods depend on restructuring the current system of governance, because it favors corporations over community-based, democratic decision-making; Because a republic means “governance of, by, and for the People” and “consent of the governed”, a [democratic] republic shall exist in our communities, States, and within Pacifica at large;

Therefore, we now exercise our inherent and unalienable right to create an authentic republic in our communities, municipalities, and counties within our States; and We the People call on communities across the States of Pacifica to:

Enact Local laws and adopt charter amendments that recognize community rights for residents of the States and preserve the inherent rights of natural ecosystems to exist and flourish; Include in those Local laws and charter amendments direct challenges to the system of laws and legal doctrines that secure greater rights for corporations than for residents of our communities or natural ecosystems; Build a Statewide network of Local rights-asserting communities involved in changing our legislature to incorporate the inherent self-governing authority of the People; Join together with other State community rights networks in and all other States demanding the National Constitution will elevate the rights of People, communities, and nature above the possibility of the illegitimate “rights” of corporations and the governing authorities they may control.

Persons, Communities, Peoples, and Nations are bearers of rights and shall enjoy the rights guaranteed to them in this and each State’s Constitution and in international instruments. Nature shall be the subject of those rights that this and each State’s Constitution recognizes for it.

The Environment/Nature, or Pacha Mama, where life is reproduced and occurs, has the right to integral respect for its existence and for the maintenance and regeneration of its life cycles, structure, functions, and evolutionary processes. All Persons, communities, Peoples, and nations can call upon public authorities to enforce the rights of nature. To enforce and interpret these rights, the principles set forth in the Constitution shall be observed, as appropriate. The States shall give incentives to natural Persons and legal entities and to communities to protect nature and to promote respect for all the elements comprising an ecosystem.

The Environment/Nature has the right to be restored. This restoration shall be apart from the obligation of the States and natural Persons or legal entities to compensate Individuals and communities that depend on natural systems affected by the other party’s activities. In those cases of severe or permanent environmental impact, including those caused by the exploitation of non-renewable natural resources, the States shall establish the most effective mechanisms to achieve the restoration and shall adopt adequate measures to eliminate or mitigate harmful environmental consequences.

The protection of the environment is of general interest. Persons must abstain from any act that causes grave depredation, destruction, or contamination to the environment. The legislation of each State shall regulate this provision and may provide sanctions/punishments for transgressors.
