Digital Identification as may be issued by the government, shall not require bio-metric information or be used as a means to track purchases or shopping locations, nor otherwise be used to track, surveil, or otherwise intrude upon the privacy of the Individual. For all intents and purposes they are merely digitized versions of normally physical identification to make sure that authentic user interactions are verified such as for banking or the purchase of psychoactive substances, without logging nor query by government except upon a narrowly-tailored specifically-issued judicial warrant for such information for a specific period-of-time as designated in the warrant, and promote transparency for its use in purposes such as electronic voting. They may not be used as a means of control outside of those which are already lawfully permitted by normal physical forms of identification to restrict access to products intended only for adults or to ensure access is only granted to someone with a verified identity. No Person shall be compelled to adopt or carry a bio-metric ID, digital identification or passport, submit to behavioral or ideological assessment or participate in any civic scoring system nor personal reputation index or conduct rating neither social profiling or societal trust framework nor community standing tiers or approval level, or any form of universal tracking credential to access public spaces, essential services, or to engage in business or trade, communication, travel within or outside of Pacifica, vote, or to exercise any other right. Participation in digital identity systems must be fully voluntary, opt-in, and revocable at any time, without penalty or loss of other rights for abandoning its use or refusing to use it in the first place.

“Biometric information” means an individual’s physiological, biological, or behavioral characteristics, including but not limited to information pertaining to an individual’s deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), or of their medical and psychological data, that is used or is intended to be used singly or in combination with each other or with other identifying data, to establish individual identity. Bio-metric information includes, but is not limited to, scans or imagery of the retina or iris, DNA, fingerprints, facial geometry, hand and palm scans, vein patterns, voiceprints and voice recordings, and other unique biological information, from which an identifier template, including but not limited to those such as a faceprint, a minutiae template, or a voiceprint, can be extracted, and keystroke patterns or rhythms, gait patterns or rhythms, along with sleep, health, or exercise data, and behavioral or psychological profiles and evaluations, that contain identifying information.

Smart-devices and Smart-software distributed or Smart Cities built and/or managed by the Pacifican or several State governments must not use signal monitoring and reporting technology, nor violate the privacy of their users, whether through spying, tracking, or general surveillance, neither ship with integration to data sharing in the aims of external advertising, artificial intelligence training and characterization or other non-local implementation, nor behavior analysis or prediction and 'persona-sprites' for simulations.

A "Smart City" shall be defined as any urban or suburban settlement that deploys integrated, connected, automated, or data-driven technologies to manage energy, transportation, utilities, communications, housing, policing, or resource allocation, including but not not limited to AI-managed public services, drone delivery systems, or environmental monitoring. No Person shall be compelled to reside within, work within, or transact solely within a Smart City jurisdiction without full, informed consent. All residents shall retain the unconditional right to exit any Smart City at any time, with guaranteed access to non-digitized regions or communities within Pacifica. Any attempt to impose mandatory digitized residency or force relocation into or out of Smart City zones shall be prohibited and prosecuted as civil coercion. Every Smart City shall be required to provide and maintain robust, non-digital, non-tracked, cash-based, and analog options for all basic utilities, public services, public businesses, transportation, voting, and civic participation. No smart city may confine people to a geographic area, use biometric or AI surveillance of individuals, eliminate or restrict Private car transportation, enforce digital tracking or automated fines, monitor electricity usage or product consumption and quantize carbon footprint, implement cashless-only payment systems, promote population control, or transform urban living into a controlled prison like existence. Every person shall retain the right to live ["an analog life"] un-connected from digital infrastructure, to transact in physical currency or barter, the physical forms and legacy media formats where available, and to decline integration with any ‘smart’ or algorithmic urban environment or infrastructure, without loss of civil or economic rights. Any critical infrastructure and resources/s controlled by automated or algorithmic system/s shall include a permanent, non-networked, fully mechanical override under the sole authority and direct control of a randomly selected body of ten sovereign persons local to the system/s, capable of shutting down such system/s in the event of abuse or failure.

"Attractive Feature" means any natural or artificial feature on private property that reasonably draws, invites, or facilitates entry or use, including natural water features, pathways, open terrain, and unoccupied or unsecured structures. In the absence of lawful and objectively apparent measures of exclusion, such feature shall be deemed an implied invitation to use the property in accordance with its apparent character and ordinary use.

“Citizens’ court” shall mean a court composed entirely of Private citizens who do not otherwise hold any position of power within the government, or have any conflict of interest that would interfere with the separation from governmental influence and impartiality of their decisions, which shall be called into service under the same rules for summoning jurors, upon such the court shall operate through due process within the law of the land under this Constitution. The Citizen’s Court shall be assembled of a Consular Praetorial body composed of three members serving as one in unanimous consensus as a bench of lawful authority, and a Consular Jurial body composed of twelve members serving verdicts under Unanimous Agreement or else no conviction shall be held. The operations of the Citizen’s court shall be performed openly in Public and scrupulously recorded by at least two Citizens independently operating as court receptionists for transmission to ‘the Public’.

Trial by jury in criminal cases is not a right that may be waived by the defendant. It is a mandate even if the defendant pleads guilty. The number of jurors in all cases must be twelve. They must be randomly selected from the general body of citizens. They may not be asked about their knowledge, experience, or opinions about the law in voir dire. They must be unanimous to convict but not to acquit, and failure to convict shall be deemed acquittal. This provision applies to all civil or criminal cases, national, state, or local.

“Fruit-of-the-Poisonous-Tree doctrine” is the rule that evidence derived from an illegal search, arrest, or interrogation, is inadmissible because the evidence (the “fruit”) was tainted by the illegality (the “poisonous tree”). Under this doctrine, for example, a murder weapon is inadmissible if the map showing its location and which was used to find it, was seized during an illegal search or arrest. Along with “Fruit-of-the-Poisonous-Tree”, the legal principle of “Water-of-the-Poisoned-Well”, or “Aquam ex puteus venenoso”, shall apply throughout Pacifica; The principle shall represent: Charges derived from a victim’s response to an originally illegal action of, on behalf of, or benefiting, law enforcement, or, by wrongful accusation (“water”), are non-binding to the defendant and are to be immediately dropped, because they would not had otherwise occurred without the provocation/injustice, and only happened to exist in reaction to the original false charge or violation of the rights for the accused, which was tainted by the illegality (the “poisoned well”); Under this doctrine, for example, an “Assault against a public officer” is permissible if they were to enter a home to place an arrest without a warrant for either or missing the other, or violated any of the Rules of Due Process, or any of the rights of Persons as well as the additional benefits/entitlements bestowed upon Citizens in such a case.

No Person, citizen or otherwise, regardless of wealth, identity or status, nor public office or private position of power, shall be above the law, nor intended by errors in law to circumvent the spirit of natural Justice or violate rights of any[one].

No person shall have no authority to order, impede, or influence criminal or civil investigations involving themselves, their family, or their private interests, but this shall not bar their rights of criminal or civil complaint about injury to rights or damages stemming therefrom.

All communications between any member of government or those contracting beneath them in a Public function, and the Department of Justice, regarding ongoing cases, shall be public record.

"Tabula Rasa" (also known as a "blank slate") shall mean the condition by which any Citizen of the [not property-ownership contingent] Commonwealth of Pacifica who has duly performed verified active wartime service during a conflict formally declared/authorized by the National Congress, and who has been released therefrom under honorable discharge or equivalent administrative certification, in addition to in the unfortunate event of their honorable death in service to the Nation and our People, shall, upon confirmation thereof, receive the complete and permanent expungement of all criminal records existing prior to the commencement of such service, together with the discharge of all civil judgments and liabilities not founded upon fraud or intentional misrepresentation, and the forgiveness of all unsecured debts incurred prior to engagement in said wartime service, said relief being granted in furtherance of national interest, civic restoration, and the reintegration of wartime citizens as unburdened participants in civil life; provided that this definition shall not extend to or be construed as granting relief for any attempted or actual murder nor repeat/serial rape, war crime, act of treason, or offense committed subsequent to honorable discharge; provided that eligibility under this definition shall be established through an administrative process reliant upon official certification of honorable service, without necessity of judicial intervention except where allegations of fraud or misrepresentation arise.

No President or Gubernor, nor other Executive/Administrative officials, neither Legislator or Councilman, nor Judge or Jury member or Prosecutor, neither Law Enforcement or Guard/Technician of Wards/Patients, or any other member of the Public Body in a position of Authority, shall claim or receive immunity from criminal or civil prosecution for acts committed before, during, or after service in office or to justice. The office, bench, badge, key, or other position of trust confers no exemption from subpoena, indictment, or trial.

Any individual convicted of high crimes against Pacifica, including but not limited to corruption or espionage, incitement of insurrection or sedition against the state, or obstruction of constitutionally restrained Republican and Democratic processes along with the excercise of Just Authority, shall be permanently barred from office and public trust.

“Detainment camp” shall mean a facility operated for the imprisonment or confinement of People, with the benefit of due process and the rights of the detained. “Internment camp” shall mean a facility operated for the imprisonment or confinement of People without the benefit of due process or rights of the detained. “Concentration camp” shall mean an Internment camp that engages in the mandatory labor of, un-informed and/or non-consensual hazardous experimentation on, torture of, or routine killing of, the detained. Any of these camps can also be considered centers, therefore detainment, internment, and a concentration camp can also be described interchangeably with detainment, internment, or concentration center, the primary difference being whether or not they're open air or enclosed.

The exceptions to appellate jurisdiction of only mean original jurisdiction, not no jurisdiction. There must always be some court somewhere open to hear and justly decide any judicial question, original or appellate.

The terms “cases” and “controversies” shall not be limited to parties with a direct stake in the decision, but shall include any case for which the court can grant relief, including declaratory and injunctive relief, private prosecutions of public rights, trustees representing their trusts, and prerogative writs.

States and juries may nullify bad legislation which is not in line with the Natural and Constitutional Rights and Justice of our People.

A person may be pardoned only after conviction, and the pardon does not nullify the conviction. It is only a declaration that the executive will not enforce it. A declaration by a President or State Gubernor that they will not enforce a criminal conviction against a person, does not bar enforcement by another person to whom a warrant to do so may be issued by a court of competent jurisdiction.

“Private ‘Jurisdiction’” is self-inherent authority that an individual rightfully has over themself, or for a “thing” (property”) that is under their lawful ownership or control. “Public ‘Jurisdiction’” shall be defined as an authority conferred upon a court (thus making it competent) to hear and determine cases and causes.

“Free Speech” and “Free expression” are the right to impart and receive ideas and information from inside and outside of Pacifica, and that the government cannot Control its flow to ‘the Public’, whether kept private or public in ‘priviledge’/confidence.

“True Threats” are statements where the speaker means to communicate by means made verbally, in writing, or by telephone or electronic device, a serious expression of an intent to commit an act of unjust force to a particular individual or group of individuals, though the speaker need not actually intend to carry out the threat/s. Even a statement that appears to threaten violence may not be a true threat if the context indicates that it only expressed political opposition, was emotionally charged rhetoric, hyperbole, or issued statements uttered in jest, or as part of a character for a creative-expressive performance; Defensive posturing including issuing [a] verbal statement/s of intent to use defensive force is not a ‘threat’, but a [non-obligate] “warning” against a[n] [potential or actual] aggressor. A true threat requires a reasonable Person to: Foresee that the statement would be objectively interpreted in such a manner by both the maker and those whom the maker communicates, as to a statement of a serious expression of their intention to aggress against the rights of another; That the defendant/offender [subjectively] intended [and seriously expressed] to threaten unjust force/injury/harm/assault and communicated so in an unconditional, unequivocal, immediate, and specific manner, as to be received as an actual threat, in order to instill fear in the recipient, which is not induced under intimidation or duress;-And that the threat placed the victim/s in a state of actual, reasonable, and sustained fear. The essential elements of any real threat are as follows: 1) [A] Directed party/target, or receiver, of the threat; 2) An implement or means of achieving the threat; 3) The Substance of which constitutes the clear [willfull] threat of unjust force, theft, or fraud itself; 4) Imminency, immediacy, or [a/n] [unjust] triggering condition/s; 5) A reasonable and actual belief that the issuer would be capable of carrying out the aggression.

For the purposes of this Constitution, “Aggression” is in the context to the [mutual] non-aggression principle, and shall be defined as [truly] threatening or initiating any forcible/coercive interference with an Individual, or Individual’s property, or the exercise of any of their rights/immunities, freedoms, privileges, or guarantees therewith. The non-aggression principle does not forbid defensive posturing or forceful defense. “Force” (or Compulsion/Coercion/Extortion) is defined as Taking/Damaging/destroying or threatening to Take/Damage/Destroy someone else’s Life and Health, Liberty/Freedom and Autonomy/Independence, Self-Security [and freedom to secure others’] and Self-Defense [and freedom to defend others’], Privacy, Property, and the Pursuit of Happiness.

“Non-intervention” shall mean a foreign policy holding that political rulers avoid alliances with other nations but still retain diplomacy, not to engage in interference in the external affairs of another nation without its consent, or in its internal affairs with or without its consent, and to avoid all wars unless related to direct self-defense of Pacifica, its officers, or any of its People or the Persons thereof.

There shall be defined by the legislature of their jurisdiction a strict scrutiny test for any restriction of rights insofar as they are narrowly tailored on a rational basis to achieve a compelling governmental interest prescribed by this Constitution and guided under a rational-basis without disproportionate burden.

“State Security” shall mean the freedom from military threat and political compulsion, coercion, or extortion from both external and internal forces, as well as the protection or the safety of a country’s secrets and its citizens. Due process shall always take prescedent over the preservation of State Security.

The primary meaning of “militia” shall be “defense activity”, and only secondarily to those engaged in it, or obligated to engage in it. Jury duty shall be regarded as a form of militia duty.

A declaration of war shall specify the state or organized body that is the enemy, the casus belli or casus foederis requiring its issuance, the commencement date, and the terms for its conclusion. The identification of the enemy shall be sufficiently explicit to allow persons of common understanding to recognize them, and not be left to executive officials to define the boundaries of who is included.

The definition of the term “Firearm”, as encompassed under the set of the broader group [“armament”], means any “Frame” or “Receiver” that is complete, assembled, operable, or converted/restored to a functional state, where it is then capable of firing a bullet or other projectile by means of exploding Powder, ‘Cotton’/Fibers (E.g.: gun-cotton/nitro-cellulose), Cord (E.g.: Cordite NQ), Gel (E.g: Collodion), or other similar type of material. Incomplete/unfinished “receiver/frame blanks/dummies” or “0%/80%/99% firearm parts/fabrication kits”, any firearm precursor/s, or incompletely assembled and non-functioning guns or launchers, are not considered “firearms” by definition, no matter how exhaustively inclusive their included parts, materials, and/or other components may be, as well as jigs, tools, adapters, bit, or other milling equipment, along with detail sheets, instructions, and/or manuals, in addition to accessories or complimentary gifts, or other items which may be, nor in regard to how readily they can be made to function, so long as they are not assembled in a completely functional way, and as such, in such state, they are not subject to regulation as armaments or restriction to certain legal statuses of People, as according to this Constitution. “Frame” and “receiver” refers to the part of a firearm which provides any housing or holding structure for a hammer, bolt, bolt carrier, breech-block, cylinder, trigger mechanism, firing pin, striker, or slide rails, along with any other firing mechanism, and which is usually threaded at its forward portion to receive the barrel, whether or not it is of modular and/or split/multi-part design.

The term “Antique firearm” means any [non-restrictable] firearm (including but not limited to any firearm with a matchlock, flintlock, percussion cap, as well as any weapon which incorporates a firearm frame or receiver of any style/[fashion], or any other similar type of ignition system [which is]) designed/meditated or manufactured/made in or before December 31st 1999CE @ 23h:59m:59s:65999999ticks or one-hundred-and-eight years before the ratification of this Constitution [whichever is the greater/larger number of years or oldest date which is dated in the Common Era]; this shall be expanded to include any machine-guns whether or not they are low-power casual, intermediate-power assault, full-power battle, or [any] other form of handgun, rifle, or cannon compliant to the prior criteria; or any modern/current replica/duplicate of any antique firearm or firearm pattern using antique ammunition if such replica/duplicate is not designed or re-designed for using a more recent enhancement than available on or before the year/date specified in this provision, and additionally, it shall include [for any year, including beyond the year/date specified in this provision] all muzzle loading or break-barrel muskets or rifles, muzzle loading or break-barrel shotguns, or muzzle loading or break-barrel pistols, revolvers and cylinder-fed carbines, and cannons, which are designed to use black powder, or a black powder substitute, regardless to whether or not they can use fixed ammunition, or to their state or type of rifling/boring and flash-suppression or muzzle-breaking, neither raising concern about threadings nor other included or incorporated attachments that may themselves be more modern than the year/date specified in this provision; The term “Antique Firearm” shall extend to include any firearm which is converted into a muzzle loading weapon, or any muzzle loading weapon which is converted to fire fixed ammunition (designed on or before the date used in this definition of “Antique Firearm”), by replacing the barrel, bolt, breechblock, or any combination thereof; “Antique firearms” shall not preclude those Arms which are with or without a fixed, folding, or collapsing attachment bayonet or anchoring point, a carrying handle, or bipod/tripod/quadpod/etc; [An] “Antique firearm/[s]”, including their munitions or ignition and propellant systems, cannot be restricted in any way for or against any status Individual [except an actual prisoner during a lawful term of incarceration], nor for any other purpose/reason, and neither Criminal nor Civil penalty may rightfully forfeit a Person’s fundamental and unalienable absolute self-regulating natural right to weapons for the just purposes of self-security and self-defense, as well as to hunting for survival and self-sufficiency, and thereby are excluded from any form of control against their naturally rightful possession unrestrained within the confines of Just laws.

“Ammunition” shall be defined as any completely constructed “round”, consisting of one or several (bullet, cartridge, powder, primer, fuse or striker-cap, or some combination); The term “Antique ammunition” includes all non-restrictable ammunitions, and means any ammunition designed/meditated or manufactured/made in or before December 31st 1999CE @ 23h:59m:59s:65999999ticks or one-hundred-and-eight years before the ratification or this Constitution [whichever is the greater/larger number of years or oldest date which is dated in the Common Era], or any modern/current replica/duplicate of any antique ammunition if such replica/duplicate is not designed or re-designed for using a more recent enhancement than available on or before the year/date specified in this provision, and additionally, it shall include but not be limited to any black powder or similar explosive Powder, ‘Cotton’/Fibers (E.g.: gun-cotton/nitro-cellulose), Cord (E.g.: Cordite NQ), Gel (E.g: Collodion), (or other similar type of material) fired muzzle or break-barrel loaded ammunition, or, any fixed ammunition including but not limited to those loaded from a clip, magazine, belt, drum, or strip feed.

A “noise suppressor”, “silencer device”, or “complete muffler”, along with “telescoping stocks”, “stowaway stocks”, “folding stocks”, and “bump-fire stocks”, or any combination thereof, in addition to clips, magazines, belts, drums, feed strips, or similar devices, and also including “barrel shrouds”, “accessory rails”, and “bayonet lugs”, as well as “pistol-to-carbine or revolver-to-carbine conversion kits”, and “rifle-to-machine-pistol or rifle-to-machine-revolver conversion kits”, are legally considered either “parts”, “attachments”, or “modifications” to “armaments”, and as with all other forms of parts/attachments/modifications to armaments, are not subject to regulation or restriction, nor to requisite of registration or permission/permit, for all free Persons; Individuals who are otherwise legally restricted or temporarily barred from certain classes of weapons or to live ammunitions, and destructive devices or certain classes of projectile propellants, shall not be obstructed from their right to access, possess, own, share, alter, or otherwise interact with or control these items, as in accordance to this Constitution.

“Radiological weapon” shall mean weapon or dispersion device that is designed to directly or secondarily cast emissions of ionizing radiation or radioactively decaying (nuclearly disintegrating) particles, whether or not through the use of radioactive material, which is intended to kill and/or cause disruption, to cause radiation poisoning, or radiation/radioactive_material contamination of an area with radiological sources. This includes all: [dirty] munitions, shells, missiles, and bombs. Radiological emissions include gamma rays, x-rays, positrons as well as positronium, alpha particles, charged nuclei, positrons/anti-electrons, fast protons, and fast neutrons; Specifically excluded from the definition of radiological weapons are beta/electron particle and ultraviolet photon based implements, such as ammunitions, bombs, beams, and matter teleporters and/or disintegrators based upon or functioning in conjunction with them.

“Nuclear weapon” shall mean an explosive device that derives part or all of its destructive force from nuclear reactions, either fission (fission bomb), fusion (pure fusion weapon), or from a combination of fission and fusion reactions (thermonuclear bomb).

“Biological weapon” shall mean a bacterium, virus, protozoan, parasite, fungus, other organism, their toxins, or genetic modifier [including but not limited to a gene drive or infertility/terminator gene], or a specialized munition containing the same, which can be used purposefully as a weapon in bio-logical warfare or bio-terrorism, or any agent exhibiting gain of function or other enhancement to their infectious properties.

“Chemical weapon” shall mean a specialized munition that uses any toxic/poisonous chemical or its precursor formulated to inflict serious injury, permanent harm, or death to people. A chemical weapon is a toxic/poison chemical or its precursor contained in a delivery system, such as a bomb or shell. It shall not extend to non-toxic/non-poisonous agents which cause temporary incapacitation or sensory irritation through their chemical action, and which do not inflict long-term harm upon their individual/incidental usage.

"Psychotronic Weapon" shall be defined as energy-based weapons, using means such as electromagnetic radiation (such as the microwave auditory effect {See "Voice-to-Skull"}), radar, electronic surveillance techniques, and other developments, which are designed to alter the ability of the human body to process stimuli, such as remote EEG and neural-signal injection, remote as well as near-field along with direct-contact manipulation of Central Nervous Systems, non-consensual Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation or Bio-Feedback system, and other technologies for altering Brain-state or remotely modifying other bodily functions, whether or not they are through implant or other means, which are not explicitly consensual before and during their use nor severable during use.

In order to maintain continuity of government, there shall be constructed a series of emergency shelters/bunkers for certain members of the public body, as shall be determined by law, and the government are mandated to build shelters for the People with earthquake- and nuclear-blast-proof underground tunnels for connecting them to each-other. The shelters shall be designed to withstand NBC attack and sustain regular life of the people for moderate periods of time, with an emphasis on overcapacity to provide for additional extensions of service and supplies as may be necessary.

“Misdemeanor” shall mean any crime whose term of punishment lasts for one year or less, and shall be housed in different containment quarters, grounds, and other common areas than the felonious offenders. Felon” shall mean those whose term of sentencing is beyond one year, even when indeterminate sentencing is applied. “Jail” shall be the name of the dedicated holding grounds for [a] “Misdemeanor offender/s” serving their sentence, as well as [a] “Felon/s” being held temporarily, to immediately [upon reasonable ability of their wardens] be transferred to a “Prison” for the purpose of serving their remainder of sentencing, as may be directed by the Jury and handed down by the Justice of the Court.

“Piracy” shall consist only of warlike acts committed by a non-state actor against persons or property of a country foreign to him. Letters of marque and reprisal make the person to whom they are issued a state actor, and under a declaration of war all citizens are to be regarded as state actors with respect to the foreign state defined in the declaration.

The legislature shall be empowered, by general law and upon findings of fiscal necessity, to establish temporary and proportionate reductions in pension benefits payable to persons who have separated from public employment and whose benefits are otherwise constitutionally or statutorily protected, provided that no such reduction shall impair the underlying pension right beyond the limits expressly authorized herein, and provided further that any reduction shall be limited to a maximum of twenty-five percent (25%) for persons no longer serving in the government position from which the pension was earned, and to a maximum of fifty percent (50%) for persons who remain capable of gainful employment, with the precise tier, duration, hardship exemption, and equitable formula to be determined by the legislature in a manner that gives the lowest-benefit recipients the greatest protection and that accounts for actual living costs, subsistence needs, and other material circumstances; all sums withheld pursuant to this Section shall constitute a continuing public obligation and shall be repaid in the exact nominal amount withheld at a later time according to a repayment schedule, priority rules, and enforcement procedures established by law; and this Section shall be construed as a clarification and rule of interpretation requiring the government to provide immediate and effective fulfillment of essential public duties, including emergency shelter and temporary housing when permanent housing is unavailable, so that public policy does not unlawfully defer basic human necessities, perpetuate avoidable suffering, or create conditions that predictably lead to trespass, injury, or other harm.

"Marxist" refers to the political and economical philosophy of Karl Marx, who posited that all class struggle is between the property owners and the working class, and that there should be established a socialist system abolishing private ownership of the means of production in order to eventually attain communism as the absolute state power over markets, property, and individuals, which would abolish privately owned business and property entirely, and only state allotments of 'personal property' would be permitted by law, where the people would be considered a unit of resource to be allocated, subject to Public central management. It is a form of collectivist totalitarian authoritarianism which abolishes individualism, in favor of centralized mandates and power over People. Pacifica is actively opposed to this ideology.

"Capitalism" is the private ownership of the means of production. Ownership of property is requisite to means of its production. Pacifica affirms that capitalism itself is not an issue, merely the corruption and greed of individuals and their associations, and that by only valuing money rather than serving a higher purpose [such as common good], there have been great undercuts to our good way of life and to the heritage we leave our posterity and of theirs as well. It is opposed to socialism which serves as the abolishment of the private ownership of the means of production.

"Distributist" refers to the quality of an economic system that favors individual actualization and prosperity, in favor of small, local, family business. It is the belief that property ownership should be widespread and not highly concentrated in small numbers of holders. Pacifica affirms that this is the ultimate form of capitalism, when mated with maximized laissez-faire system which also balances against human, animal, and environmental rights. Pacifica seeks to establish and maintain this system of economics for all of the People.

"Limitarian" refers to a taxation philosophy which punishes greed and wastefulness, through setting upper limits or burdens on large volumes of assets, whether financial or real property. It attempts to instill John Locke's proviso on spoilage, but does not hold to imperishable money absolving the crisis of wastage and damages to others through hoarding. In some manner, it is also a component of some social democratic political theories. This is considered an extension of the Social Democratic principles of Pacifica and not a core Republican virtue.

A "Moral Economy" is a system of economic organization in which markets, property, and exchange operate within a framework of moral constraints that ensure every person can participate to the extent of their abilities while no one is left below a secure baseline of material necessities (such as food, shelter, health care, and essential services) required for survival and basic human dignity. Within this order, private ownership and entrepreneurial initiative are preserved and encouraged, but deliberately bounded so that concentrated wealth and entrenched privilege cannot distort competition, block opportunity, or reduce large segments of the population to dependence or marginalization. The economy is structured so that productive assets are widely dispersed, work is rewarded with fair returns, and the institutions of finance, labor, and trade are oriented toward sustaining families, communities, and small enterprises rather than serving only remote capital or speculative bubbles. When resources are redistributed from those with excessive surplus toward zero‑ and low‑income individuals, the aim is not to erase differences of wealth or ability but to restore effective participation, expand demand, and unlock latent economic activity, since poorer households typically spend a far greater share of additional income, thereby stimulating broader markets and employment. This approach explicitly rejects the zero‑sum mentality that frames wealth as a fixed pool in which one person’s gain must equal another’s loss, instead embracing the dynamic reality that human creativity, cooperation, and investment can enlarge the total value available when more people are able to work, trade, and consume with some measure of security. In a moral economy, guarantees of basic subsistence are treated not as entitlements severed from responsibility but as enabling conditions that allow individuals to contribute, build skills, and engage in productive exchange, thereby reinforcing work, family life, and civic responsibility rather than undermining them. Ultimately, a moral economy is a market‑based order arranged so that widespread ownership, genuine opportunity, and a secure baseline of survival are treated as mutually reinforcing requirements of a free, stable, and flourishing society rather than competing or optional ideals.

"Social democracy" is a political ideology that champions individual liberty within a robust capitalist economy, where private property rights and free enterprise (especially for small business owners) enable self-actualization, innovation, and the creation of personal wealth as fundamental human rights; It harnesses progressive taxation and targeted regulations to fund universal welfare programs, ensuring broad social mobility and general welfare without dismantling market competition or coercing individuals into collectivism. Unlike social democracy, democratic socialism rejects capitalism as inherently exploitative and antithetical to human rights, advocating the democratic abolition of private property in production to impose collective ownership, often through state planning or cooperatives; This contradicts natural individualist principles by subordinating personal agency to group control, stifling self-reliance and risking authoritarianism. Both prioritize democratic reforms, strong welfare states, labor protections, and reduced inequality, but social democracy achieves this via capitalist incentives, whereas democratic socialism demands systemic overthrow and intends the eventual abolition of private ownership over the means of production, and eventually, communism, which is the abolition of private property including ownership of the individual over themself.

Works in the Public Domain are not re-licensable at a later time but instead remain accessible to all freely including when they are re-encoded in other formats; That does not go to say that Public Domain works cannot be sold on their own or in compilations, merely that it must be the medium being sold and not the work as a re-licensing, such as being free to sell a book or a compact disc or even access to a private torrent repository or tracker containing the work and charging for the cost of the book or compact disc or internet servers and potential profits of the business model, but not for the Public Domain work itself.

“To regulate” is to “make regular”, that is, to facilitate the free flow of goods, but not, except in cases of danger, to prohibit the flow of any good. “Make regular” is analogous to “make usual” or “make ordinary”. Regulations should be the least restrictive and most permissive which can still effectively reach the essential goal or outcome set forth in the purpose for such regulation.

The interstate commerce power does not reach activities that are “indirect and remote”, the power applies to those activities which have a “close and intimate effect” on interstate commerce. The power to regulate shall consist only of the power to restrict the attributes or modalities of the object regulated, and not to prohibit all attributes or modalities, or impose criminal penalties. To satisfy strict scrutiny, the government’s regulation must relate to a sufficiently important governmental interest and be sufficiently “tailored” to achieve that interest; The government’s interest must be “compelling” as well as founded upon a “rational-basis”, and the regulation must be “narrowly” tailored to achieving it.

Commerce shall consist only of transfers of equitable interest and possession of tangible commodities, for a valuable consideration, from a seller or leassor to a purchaser or leasee. It shall not include transport without such transfer or interest, nor extraction, primary production, manufacturing, possession, use, or disposal, nor shall it include the other activities of those engaged in such transfers. It shall not include energy, information, nor financial or contractual instruments. Commerce among the States shall not include sales or leases within a State. Equal exchanges are not considered commerce. Commerce specifically requires a purchase be made from the markets, not the lack of interaction with these markets (as in growing one’s own plants/fungi and raising animals for [personal or familial] self-sufficiency or [private] communal-sufficiency).

A “Commercial entity” shall be viewed with regards to their having profit as their chief aim, beyond being the standard meaning entailing end-distribution and sale/s to the consumer and/or purchaser.

"Commodity flow surveys", as may be conducted by the Pacifican Department of Commerce, shall not be compelled upon another, and shall remain voluntary for all persons and businesses, including those engaged in commerce, with various levels of specificity available for the Individual/Entity to determine of their own volition what they are lawfully willing to participate in of their own consent.

The definitions of: “Money” shall be recognized as commodities which the Constitution delineates for such purpose; “Legal Tender” which is composed of redeemable receipts for a fixed amount of commodity that include representative notes;-and “Currency” which is a medium of exchange which is not backed by anything except faith in the one issuing it or which is backed in debt.

The monetary unit of Pacifica's Nation-State, hereinafter referred to as the “Dollar,” shall derive its pegged value from one troy ounce of silver bullion; All monetary valuation, issuance, and redemption shall ultimately resolve into silver weight equivalence. Each representative note and coin of legal tender, known generally as a 'commodity-back' shall be backed and redeemed according to the proportional purchasing power of its commodity basis as measured freely against said troy ounce of silver in the open market. The value of all commodity monies shall be maintained in equitable relation to the silver standard, reflecting their real market equivalence without coercive valuation. The inclusion of plating, alloy metals, or other materials in coinage, or the containment or encasement of commodity monies, shall constitute surplus material and shall not be counted toward the declared or minted face value of the Dollar. Certain commodity monies may need to be provided in larger increments than a single dollar to be redeemed through representative note legal tender, depending on practical needs and pragmatic utility.

The "Enerback" shall be the Pacifica unit of accounted-money based upon a fixed scientific energy standard derived from the measured energy content of one standard barrel of fossil-sourcex crude oil or qualifying biocrude produced through synthetic gasification or pyrolysis, and shall not necessarily constitute a claim upon, redemption right to, or direct monetary backing by oil or biocrude, though this may be authorized by Congress through a constitutional financial act; one standard barrel shall mean equal to 158.987294928 liters at the designated reference conditions, and the energy standard shall be fixed at 5,861,520,000 joules, while the particular form or source of energy recognized for issuance, settlement, reserve, or public use shall be prescribed by Congress, including electricity, stored energy, thermal energy, mechanical energy, chemical energy, nuclear energy, or another scientifically measurable form authorized by law, provided that every recognized form is converted and valued according to its measured joule content and that no legislative designation may alter the Enerback’s fixed joule equivalence; the market relationship between one troy ounce of fine silver bullion and the Pacifica dollar may be used to establish or adjust the Enerback’s monetary valuation, but silver shall not replace the joule as the underlying scientific standard, and fossil oil or biocrude may serve merely as the physical reference from which that standard is derived insofar as it is in accordance with the laws created in conformity with this Constitution, so that the Enerback remains an energy-based unit of account whose legally recognized value must always correspond to the joule content prescribed by this Provision.

No government official or other member of the public body shall retain ownership, direct or indirect, in any business or property deriving profit from domestic or foreign governments, except their personal social security in accordance with law. All such interests shall be divested into a true blind trust prior to inauguration and restored to them after leaving office.

“Independent contractor/s” shall be distinguished from “[an] Employee/s”, and shall itself be defined to mean a person, who while performing work for an employer: A) Is free from the control and direction of the hiring entity, both in contract and in fact; B) Performs work that is outside the usual course of the hiring entity’s business; C) Are customarily engaged in an independently established trade, occupation, or business of the same nature as the work performed.

“Dark pattern” means a user interface designed or manipulated with the substantial effect of subverting or impairing user Autonomy/Independence, decision-making, or choice, as further defined by regulation. "Deceptive design" is any object, device, mechanical, user interface, communication, architectural, or interaction design that is deliberately engineered or 'patterned' to steer, deceive, coerce, or manipulate individuals into making choices that are contrary to their best interests, preferences, or expectations, typically for the benefit of the designing party. This definition encompasses but is not limited to the following: Deceptive Design Practices: Interfaces or flows that mislead, disguise, obscure, or withhold critical information necessary for informed consent or decision-making, including but not limited to: misdirection, disguised advertisements, confusing language or visual design, hiding opt-outs, or making certain options less accessible. Manipulative Defaults: The use of pre-selected or opt-out based defaults intended to exploit cognitive biases such as status quo bias or loss aversion, where consent or selection is presumed unless actively changed by the user, especially when such defaults would not align with a typical user's affirmative intent or best interests (Examples may include automatic enrollment, pre-checked boxes for additional purchases, un-consented modules or features or software and packages/data, or retention of personal data). Coercive and Emotional Techniques: Designs employing pressure (nagging, confirmshaming, fear, or guilt tactics) to override user autonomy or to induce decisions users would not otherwise make in a neutral, transparent environment. Obstruction and Friction: Introducing unnecessary steps, delays, or barriers preventing users from accessing, changing, or opting out of certain choices (e.g., making cancellation or opt-out harder than enrollment or opt-in) or functions. For a design to qualify as a dark pattern under this definition, it is sufficient that the effect of the interface or product itself, regardless of intention, is to substantially subvert or impair user autonomy, decision-making, informed consent, or product/device functions, particularly where users’ preferences or welfare are undermined to benefit the controller or third parties. Opt-out based defaults, where user inaction is treated as tacit consent to terms, enrollment, or sharing, are considered dark patterns unless justified by transparency, necessity, and alignment with actual user expectations and interests.

For purposes of this Constitution, a "Public Place" shall be defined as any location, indoor or outdoor, that is accessible to the General Public by right or by invitation, including but not limited to streets, planting strips, sidewalks, highways, rest stops, parks, plazas, public buildings, commercial establishments, and facilities of public transportation, whether publicly or privately owned. The access of the Public, not the ownership of the property, shall be the determinant factor in establishing a location as a Public Place. This definition does not extend to areas designated for private use, including private residences, private clubs, or spaces requiring exclusive membership or special permission for entry. Laws, rights, and obligations pertaining to Public Places under this Constitution shall apply to all locations as defined herein.

The Phrase “general public”, shall be defined to mean all of the People, as well as their guests, and all other lawful visitors to Pacifica. All “Public entities” are members of the “Public body”, and vice versa.

Militia refers to the body of citizens eligible for military service, traditionally divided into two categories: The organized militia consists of able-bodied citizens who are formally enrolled, regularly trained, and equipped for military service by the government, in the Age Range of eighteen (18) to sixty (60) years old. The disorganized (or unorganized) militia includes able-bodied citizens who are not formally enrolled or regularly trained but are nevertheless eligible for [consensual] call-up in times of emergency, in the Age Range of sixteen (16) to fourty-five (45) years old. It is the duty of Congress to train and arm members of the militia, whether organized or disorganized.

All Publicly funded projects must be fully disclosed in scope and breadth, as well as purpose and intent, all goals, and any projected effects, clearly stating the intended affect, and have a plan in place to roll back any or all potential issues to the People or the openly announced and line-ratified/ line-vetoed agenda, with the Power of the Citizenry to suspend these projects in part or full entirely for any reason whatsoever per their prerogative.

All federally, State, and Territorially derived funds cannot legislatively or contractually or bindingly-require in agreement to control the autonomy of any branch or division of government receiving or imparting them.

The phrase "facially illegitimate" is deliberate, it signals that the structural deprivation is itself the violation, independent of intent.

The term “General Welfare” means not special. The government shall exercise no power [other than stated in the next sentence of this provision], including the powers to spend, in ways intended to burden or benefit one part of the population over another, except in minor ways incidental to the proper exercise of delegated powers. The State governments shall be capable of exercising power to spend in ways intended to [specially] benefit a sub-set/part of the population whose income level is zero or low through State welfare services and programs, which serve to reduce their barriers to being productive members of society, or normalize the quality of their well-being with that of the general population (as a whole, on average), and not empowered to subsidize an organization, institution, business, company, firm, corporation, or other artificial entity, except for exemplary practices that serve the commonwealth and benefit the welfare of the environment as well as the People, including but not limited to those practices which benefit the homeless/unsheltered and poor.

“Standard of living” refers to the level of necessities, comfort, material goods, and wealth commonly available to the People in Pacifica.

“Quality of life” shall mean the general well-being of individuals and society. It observes life satisfaction, including, but not limited to, physical health, family, friends, education, employment, wealth, safety, security, freedom, [a]religious beliefs, and the environment.

“Legal tender” is a receipt for a quantity of money, as defined under this Constitution. It is synonymous/equivalent in the language of this constitution to [a] “representative note/s”.

The phrase “through due process of law” is synonymous with “by the law of the land”.

A power shall be construed as “necessary and proper” only for “carrying into execution”, that is, to make a limited, reasonable effort strictly necessary for a proper public purpose as defined in the Preamble, and not to do whatever might be deemed convenient to get an outcome for which the effort might be made. The powers to spend and promote, regulate, and prohibit (or punish), shall each be construed as distinct, with none derivable from any of the others, and none shall be exercised as a way to avoid the lack of a power to do one of the others. For further explanation of "necessary and proper” power, refer towards the legal principles known as “principal” and “incidental”, in the context to the norms of law in the early history of the Union of Pacifica of [North] America.

This Constitution recognizes that the peaceful transfer of power, the legitimacy of elections, and the rule of law, not raw power or loyalty to leaders, are essential conditions of liberty. Any attempt to undermine these foundations, through deceit, coercion, or force, shall be treated as an attack upon Pacifica itself. Congress shall have power to enforce this pillar of civil governance through appropriate legislation.

“Propaganda” shall mean information that is not objectively true, and is used primarily to influence an audience and further an agenda, furnishing information which is purely subjective in nature as if it were objective, by presenting facts selectively to encourage a particular synthesis or perception, using loaded language to produce an emotional rather than a rational response to the information that is presented, reaching a conclusion using logic which does not apply universally, or disinformation, which is false information spread deliberately to deceive.

"Orwellian" is an adjective denoting the characteristic features of totalitarian social control (ubiquitous surveillance, historical revisionism, manipulative euphemism, and the enforced acceptance of contradictory "doublethink") as fictionalized in Eric Arthur Blair's Nineteen Eighty-Four (1949CE) (and Animal Farm {1945CE}), yet the term's resonance derives equally from the author's own deliberate self-effacement; born into a colonial middle-class family, he chose a nom de plume as George Orwell specifically to sever his private identity from his public polemics, sparing his parents the stigma of his bohemian career while also granting himself the psychological freedom to indict the very class that raised him. This pseudonymous shield was not mere vanity but a strategic necessity, for his sharpest critiques targeted the hypocrisy of British imperialism and the hollow rhetoric of progressive politics, subjects that could have endangered his familial relationships and future employment. Blair/Orwell understood that language itself is a battlefield, and by adopting a new name he performed the very act of linguistic redefinition that he later warned against, using a fabricated persona to expose fabricated truths, though his goal was clarity, not obfuscation, as artists use lies to tell the truth. Consequently, "Orwellian" now applies to any Orwellian (in the sense of resembling his themes) misuse of official language, such as calling civilian casualties "collateral damage" or mass surveillance "public safety," because he demonstrated that corrupted diction precedes corrupted governance. The pseudonym also allowed him to write with an unflinching directness that his birth name, with its class connotations, might have undermined, effectively making him an outsider within his own society, a position that sharpened his observational acuity. While the term is often overused as a lazy pejorative for any disagreeable policy, its precise meaning remains tethered to Orwell's core insight: that power perpetuates itself by rewriting reality, and that the first casualty of tyranny is the honest word. Thus, the ultimate definition of "Orwellian" is any condition in which truth becomes a function of authority, and the adoption of Eric Arthur Blair's pen name, a quiet act of rebellion against his own origins, foreshadowed that lifelong war against the debasement of meaning.
